abbottina-rivularis.name: Chinese false gudgeon
notes: Item 4: "Kemungkinan dibutuhkan akuarium dengan ukuran alas minimal 150 × 45 cm" is fine, but "±304 liter" is OK; no real issue. Minor: "batu-batu sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu sungai berbagai ukuran yang halus karena terkikis air".
Item 7: "merumput alga" is awkward; use "memakan alga dan biofilm" or "mengerik alga".
Item 8: "makannya sangat lahap" is fine, but "mengalahkan" for outcompete is better as "mengungguli dalam berebut pakan".
Item 1/2/10: "cyprinid" and "tribus" are left in English or foreign form; consider "ikan famili Cyprinidae" and "tribe" as written. Minor.
Item 1: "sama sekali tidak boleh dilepas" is fine; "Chinese false gudgeon" has no Indonesian name, so keep it and add "(gudgeon palsu Tiongkok)" if desired.

aborichthys-elongatus.name: Red-tailed Squirrel Loach
notes: Item 3: "minor rivers" is translated as "anak sungai", which means a tributary. Use "sungai kecil" or "sungai berukuran kecil" instead.
Item 3: "caves" is translated as "celah", which duplicates "crevices" and loses the meaning. Use "gua kecil" or "rongga/gua-gua kecil".
Item 9: "body bars" is translated as "garis tubuh tambahan". Use "pita/belang tubuh tambahan", because "bars" are vertical bands and not lines.

Item 10: "Unreported in aquaria" is translated as "Belum ada laporan pemijahan di akuarium". "Pemijahan" is added. If the section is about breeding this is acceptable, but "Belum pernah dilaporkan di akuarium" is more literal.
Item 8: "cukup suka berkelompok" is slightly loose for "loosely sociable". "Agak sosial/cenderung berkelompok longgar" is closer.

abramites-hypselonotus.name: Marbled Headstander
notes: Item 7: 'idealnya mencakup sayuran, berupa alga segar, buah, sayur, ...' mistranslates 'greenery' (bahan nabati/hijauan) and is redundant with 'sayur'. Use 'bahan nabati (hijauan)' instead.
Item 8: 'robust' is dropped from 'robust cichlids' in the English, but the Indonesian has 'yang tangguh' so this is fine; however item 1 omits 'robust' (acceptable)—no fix needed.

Item 1: the intro says the fish 'may nip long or trailing fins and eat soft-leaved plants'. The Indonesian keeps this, but 'Ikan ini termasuk generalis secara ekologis' is stiff. Consider 'Ikan ini generalis secara ekologi'.

Item 11: 'dua ciri. Pertama... Kedua...' adds structure not in the source (a minor restructuring); 'Banyak spesies dikenal dengan posisi makannya yang miring dengan kepala di bawah' is clumsy. Consider 'posisi makan miring dengan kepala menunduk'.
Item 4: '~108 litres' is correct for the volume, but the Indonesian 'akuarium paling kecil yang layak dipertimbangkan' is slightly awkward. Consider 'ukuran minimum yang sebaiknya dipertimbangkan'.
Item 10: 'Belum ada catatan tentang keberhasilan pemijahan' adds 'keberhasilan' (success). The source says no records of captive breeding exist at all. Use 'Belum ada catatan pembiakan di akuarium'.
Item 2: 'Menurut pengelompokan yang diakui saat ini' changes 'As currently recognised' (taxonomic status) to 'grouping'. Use 'Berdasarkan taksonomi yang berlaku saat ini'.

acanthicus-hystrix.name: Lyretail Pleco
notes: Item 11: the added "(di sini juga dikenal sebagai sapu-sapu)" is not in the English. Drop it, or write "sapu-sapu" as a plain local name without the commentary.
Item 7: "lancefish" is left in English. Use an Indonesian name or a gloss, e.g. "ikan lance (sand lance)".
Item 5: "Kadar oksigen terlarut yang tinggi wajib dijaga" is stiff. Something like "Kadar oksigen terlarut yang tinggi wajib dipertahankan" reads more naturally.

acanthocobitis-botia.name: Zipper loach
notes: Item 1: "Dulu ikan ini lama dianggap" is awkward; use "Ikan ini lama dianggap" or "Dulu dianggap".
Item 5: "beech, oak" are left in English; use "daun kering beech (Fagus), ek" or similar.
Item 5: "aufwuchs" is left untranslated with no gloss; add "(lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)".
Item 5: "setup" is used repeatedly; "tata letak akuarium" or "aquascape" is more natural.

acanthocobitis-pavonacea.name: Peacock Loach
notes: Item 11: the final sentence 'Thanks to Steve Grant.' is omitted. It's an acknowledgement, not a byline or bio, so translate it ('Terima kasih kepada Steve Grant.') or confirm the omission is intended.
Item 3: 'We've been unable to obtain any detailed information' is rendered as 'belum ada informasi rinci yang bisa diperoleh'. This is acceptable neutral phrasing and no change is needed.
Item 8: 'teman satu akuarium yang sangat kecil sebaiknya tidak disertakan' is slightly stiff. 'Tankmate' is more naturally 'penghuni lain' or 'ikan lain yang sangat kecil sebaiknya dihindari'.
Item 1: 'Dengan panjang 120–156 mm SL' mixes a Latin abbreviation into the Indonesian. Use 'panjang standar (SL)' consistently with the spec list.
Item 5: 'setup' is left as English in several places. 'Tata letak' or 'akuarium' is more natural, though 'setup' is common in the hobby.
Item 5: 'batu besar yang permukaannya halus terkikis air' is wordy. 'Batu sungai besar' is more natural.

acanthocobitis-rubidipinnis.name: Redfin Loach
notes: Item 5: "stronger stomach-circumference" rendered as "perutnya yang lebih gemuk" is fine, but "berwarna lebih pekat" is OK; no change needed here - ignore.

Item 6: "13 1/2 hingga 15 1/2 jari-jari sirip bercabang" is a literal carry-over; the half-ray notation is awkward in Indonesian, so consider "13½–15½" and explain it, e.g. "jari-jari sirip bercabang (13½ hingga 15½)".
Item 6: "masa birahi" for "reproductive mood" is too strong and informal; use "saat siap memijah" or "masa berbiak".
Item 4: "terus-menerus beraksi satu sama lain" is unnatural; use "selalu aktif dan saling berinteraksi".
Item 4: "Paracanthocobitis rubidipinnis tidak cocok digabung" is fine, but the original "not acceptable" is softened; consider "tidak boleh digabung".
Item 1: "Loach" is left untranslated; use "ikan loach" or "botia" as hobbyists do. The same applies to "Loach yang cantik ini".
Item 3: "gua" for caves is too grand for a tank; use "liang" or "gua kecil". "ikan lain" is acceptable.
Item 2: "suhu ruang" is acceptable; no change needed - ignore.

acanthocobitis-zonalternans.name: Zipper Loach
notes: Item 2: the neotype locality quote is left in English ('4 kilometers south of Amphoe Mae Ramat on road 1085 ... Tak Province, Salween basin, Thailand'). Translate the descriptive words, e.g. '4 kilometer di selatan Amphoe Mae Ramat di jalan 1085 ... Provinsi Tak, cekungan Salween, Thailand'. Keep the place names.
Item 5: 'daun kering beech, oak' leaves the English names in place. Use 'daun beech (Fagus) dan ek' or add a short gloss.
Item 5: 'setup' and 'hill stream' stay in English. 'Setup' is common, but 'tata letak/penataan akuarium' and 'akuarium tipe sungai pegunungan berarus' read more naturally.
Item 5: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated. Add a gloss such as 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan biofilm)'.

acanthodoras-cataphractus.name: Chocolate Raphael
notes: Item 10: translation ends with an ellipsis ('apakah pengasuhan oleh induk …'), so the sentence is cut off. Complete it to match the source, even though the English is itself truncated ('caesews'), or flag it.
Item 1/8: 'Ukuran maksimum: 115 mm SL' – 'SL' is left unexplained. Consider 'panjang standar (SL)'.
Item 1: 'lele doradid' / 'sebagian besar aktif di malam hari' is a bit awkward. Consider 'umumnya aktif malam hari (nokturnal)'.
Item 11: 'garis keturunan utama' for 'lineages' is acceptable, but 'klad' is left unexplained. Add '(clade)'.
Item 11: 'Ini merupakan perbedaan yang signifikan dari hipotesis sebelumnya' – 'departure' is better rendered as 'menyimpang jauh dari hipotesis sebelumnya'.
Item 9: 'bertubuh jelas lebih gemuk' is awkward. Use 'tubuhnya tampak jelas lebih gemuk'.

acanthodoras-spinosissimus.name: Chocolate Talking Catfish
notes: Item 10: the English source is itself cut off ('caesews'), and the translation ends mid-sentence ('kemudian berhenti'). It reads as unfinished, so it should be flagged or completed, e.g. ('belum jelas apakah perawatan oleh induk berhenti setelah ...').
Item 4: 'Volume: ±108 liter' is fine, but the final sentence 'Disarankan akuarium dengan ukuran alas minimal 120 × 30 cm' repeats the line above it. This follows the source, so it is not an error.
Item 11: 'sisik keras (scute)' is imprecise for an infranuchal scute, which is a bony plate rather than a scale. Use 'lempeng tulang (scute)'.
Item 11: 'klad' and 'sister group' are left technical. Use 'klade' (the standard Indonesian spelling).
Item 11: 'tulang panggul mungkin berperan dalam memperkuat bunyi' changes 'projection of the resultant noise' to 'amplifying'. Say 'menyalurkan/memancarkan bunyi'.
Item 11: 'Hal ini sangat berbeda' for 'significant departure' is acceptable, but 'konon karena' for 'ostensibly' reads as hearsay. Use 'tampaknya karena'.
Item 3: 'perairan mati di tepi sungai (backwater)' is awkward. Use 'anakan/rawa tepi sungai' or just 'backwater'.
Item 9: 'bertubuh jelas lebih gemuk' is awkward. Use 'tubuhnya tampak jelas lebih gemuk'.
Item 8: 'cichlid' and 'karasin' are fine, but 'Pada dasarnya ikan ini suka berkelompok' is slightly redundant. Minor.

acanthopsoides-molobrion.name: Dwarf Horse-faced Loach
notes: Item 11: "seorang hobiis, Mark Duffill" names a forum member and drops the "SF member" attribution; consider a neutral "seorang hobiis" without the name.
Item 12: "Lokasi tipe" and "duri sub-okular" are stiff; "lokalitas tipe" and "duri di bawah mata" read more naturally.
Item 12: "Ikan hias" is fine, but "tuberkel kawin" and "kromatofor" could use a short gloss for hobbyist readers.

acanthopsoides-robertsi.name: Dwarf Horseface Loach
notes: "5,2 sampai 7,2 dalam panjang kepala" and "2 sampai 2,5 dalam panjang kepala" read awkwardly. Rephrase as "5,2–7,2 kali dalam panjang kepala" or "panjang kepala 5,2–7,2 kali diameter mata".
"batu yang halus terkikis air" is clumsy. Use "batu yang halus karena terkikis air" or "batu sungai yang halus".
"bintil-bintil kawin kecil (breeding tubercle)": "bintil pemijahan" is more usual; the bracketed English is fine.
"danau tapal kuda" for oxbow is acceptable but could be "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" or "kolam bekas meander sungai" for clarity.

acantopsis-dialuzona.name: Horseface loach
notes: Item 12: "sirip ekor yang sedikit bercabang" and "sirip ekor bercabang atau berlekuk dalam" translate "forked" with "bercabang". That also means "branched" (as in branched rays), so it is ambiguous. Use "bercagak" or "berpangkal dua" instead.
Item 3: "sebagian besar (kalaupun ada)" renders "a significant percentage (if any)" as "most", which is stronger than the source. Use "persentase yang signifikan (kalaupun ada)".
Item 3: "dari setiap kajian yang mendetail" is a bit loose. Use "dari kajian yang mendetail".
Item 6: "batu yang tergerus air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks". Use "batu sungai yang halus terkikis air" or "batu kali".

acarichthys-heckelii.name: Threadfin Acara
notes: Item 1: "hobinya menggali tanpa henti" is odd, because "hobi" suggests a pastime. Use "suka menggali tanpa henti" or "penggali yang tak kenal lelah".
Item 8: "tidak akan memangsa ikan yang ukurannya lebih dari beberapa sentimeter" is ambiguous. Rephrase to "tidak akan memangsa ikan yang lebih besar dari beberapa sentimeter".

acentronichthys-leptos.name: Acentronichthys
notes: Item 7: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is the older Indonesian rendering. The common current term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Terendah". Same wording in item 1.
Item 5: "menghuni sungai" and "anak sungai dan sungai kecil" is slightly clumsy. Consider "menghuni aliran sungai" and "anak sungai kecil di pesisir".
Item 4: "Negara Bagian" is acceptable. "Negara Bagian Santa Catarina" appears here but not in item 3, so use it consistently.
Item 7: "dinilai sebagai satu entitas spesies" is stiff. Use "dinilai sebagai satu spesies tunggal".
Item 7: "ancaman yang tersebar" for "diffuse threats" would read better as "ancaman yang bersifat menyebar".

acestridium-dichromum.name: Green Whiptail
notes: Item 3: type locality left in English ('Pozo Lucas, tributary of Río Orinoco, 7 kilometers south of ... Venezuela'). Translate the descriptive parts, e.g. 'anak sungai Río Orinoco, 7 kilometer di selatan San Fernando de Atabapo, ... Negara Bagian Amazonas, Venezuela'. Keep the proper names and coordinates.
Item 1: 'lele loricariid' is slightly awkward. 'lele loricariid' is acceptable, but 'Loricariidae' or 'lele penghisap' may be more familiar to hobbyists.
Item 1: 'teman satu akuarium' is a literal rendering of 'tankmates'. 'tankmate' or 'penghuni akuarium lain' is more natural.

acestrorhynchus-altus.name: Red Barracuda Tetra
notes: Item 8: "Jika memakai akuarium yang lebih tinggi" translates "deeper tank" as taller; it is fine, but "bisa diisi hanya 50–70%" is acceptable. Real issue: "terlalu banyak penutup atau dekorasi" adds "atau dekorasi" to "excess of cover" (minor addition).
Item 2: "karena ikan ini sangat damai terhadap sesamanya" is fine, but "Predator yang indah" for "splendid" is OK; the English "best in a group" is preserved. No change needed here.
Item 14: "Menezes (1969)" – fine. "kerabat terdekat (sister)" is awkward: write "kelompok saudara (sister group) bagi sisanya" so it is clear that A. falcatus is basal and sister to the rest.
Item 10: "ikan mas koki kecil" – "small goldfish" is just ikan mas/mas koki; acceptable. "Pemakan ikan obligat" is stiff; prefer "pemakan ikan sejati (piscivora obligat)".
Item 15: "Ikan-ikan ini" assumes an antecedent that is absent from the English ("They"); fine, but "terbukti satu spesies" is redundant with "ternyata"; use "ternyata satu spesies".
Item 3/7: "Red barracuda tetra" left in English with no Indonesian gloss; acceptable as a trade name, but consider adding "(tetra barakuda merah)".

acestrorhynchus-falcatus.name: Red Tail Barracuda
notes: Item 3: "Bintik humeral besarnya" is stilted. Prefer "bintik humeral yang besar" or a more natural term such as "bintik bahu".
Item 11: "ikan mas koki kecil" is redundant. Use "ikan mas koki" or "goldfish kecil".
Item 9: "pelompat yang kuat" and "kondisi apa pun" are slightly stiff. Consider "pelompat ulung".
Item 15: "kerabat terdekat (sister) bagi yang lainnya" is awkward. Rephrase as "kelompok saudara (sister group) bagi spesies lainnya".

Item 2: "seperti elang falkon" is odd. Use "seperti elang" or "seperti sabit"; falcatus actually means sickle-shaped, though the English source says falcon, so keep the source wording but make it natural.
Item 9: "belum cycling" mixes English into the Indonesian. Consider "belum matang (belum melalui siklus nitrogen)".

acestrorhynchus-isalineae.name: Striped Barracuda Tetra
notes: Item 3: the quoted type locality 'tributary of Rio dos Marmelos, Rio Madeira basin, 110 kilometers east of Humaitá along rodovia Transamazônica, Amazonas State, Brazil' is left in English, and it is also not converted to km as the imperial-to-metric rule would allow. Translate it into Indonesian, e.g. 'anak sungai Rio dos Marmelos, daerah aliran Rio Madeira, 110 kilometer di timur Humaitá di sepanjang jalan raya Transamazônica, Negara Bagian Amazonas, Brasil'.
Item 5: 'biologically immature set-ups' is rendered as 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable but wordy. Consider 'akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 7: 'ikan pakan hidup (feeder)' for 'feeder fish' is imprecise because feeders are not always live. Use 'ikan umpan (feeder fish)'. 'Ikan mas koki' is the right local name.
Item 8: 'gerombolan' for 'school' is a little odd. Use 'kawanan' or 'gerombol'.
Item 11: 'maksila bawah' is stiff for 'lower maxilla'. Consider 'rahang bawah' for readability.
Item 4: 'luar biasa cepat' slightly overstates 'extremely fast'. 'Sangat cepat' fits better.

acestrorhynchus-microlepis.name: Pike Characin
notes: Item 12: 'Menezes' (1969) diagnosed' is fine, but 'scale rows between lateral line and anal-fin origin' lacks a number in the source; the translation copies the gap without comment, so the reader gets an incomplete fact.

Item 6: 'Tempat persembunyian yang berlebihan' translates 'excess of cover'; this is okay, but 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is added detail for 'biologically immature set-ups'; use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 2/6: 'melompat dengan sangat kuat' is awkward; use 'pelompat yang kuat'.
Item 12: 'Foto A. britskii dalam keadaan hidup belum pernah terlihat' is awkward and drops the neutral 'we'; use 'Belum ada foto A. britskii hidup yang ditemukan'.
Item 12: 'kelompok dugaan' for 'putative group' is awkward; use 'kelompok yang diduga'.
Item 3: 'Essiquibo' is left as in the source, which is fine as a quote, but consider keeping the English quoted type locality consistently marked as a quotation.

Item 12: 'sisik gurat sisi', 'sirip dubur', 'tapis insang' are correct but 'pectoral/ventral' are given as 'dada/perut'; fine. 'Hitungan ciri tubuh' in item 2 is vague for 'counts'; use 'hitungan meristik'.

acestrorhynchus-minimus.name: Dwarf barracuda tetra
notes: Item 1: "penghobi khusus" is slightly awkward for "specialized aquarists"; use "aquascaper/penghobi ikan predator yang berpengalaman" or "penghobi spesialis".
Item 2: "pernah masuk" does not clearly say "We received"; use "Kami menerima" in neutral form, e.g. "Dari Peru diterima salah satu spesies kerdil ini".
Item 4: "ikan umpan (ikan pakan)" is redundant; use "ikan pakan" only.
Item 6: "Leksikon" is unusual; use "Etimologi" or "Asal nama". "Usulan nama umum: Dwarf barracuda tetra" could add a local rendering, e.g. "barracuda tetra kerdil".

acestrorhynchus-pantaneiro.name: Pantanal Barracuda Tetra
notes: Item 4: 'masing-masing di Paraguay, Uruguay, Argentina, dan Bolivia' misaligns with the English order. Río Paraná, Río Uruguay, Río de la Plata and rio Mamoré are listed against Paraguay, Uruguay, Argentina and Bolivia, so the mapping is awkward and implies Paraná is in Paraguay. The original is ambiguous too; make the sentence clearer.

Item 10: 'ikan pakan hidup (feeder)' is an added claim. The English 'feeder fish' means ikan umpan or ikan pakan, and the sentence then lists livebearers and goldfish. Say 'ikan pakan (feeder fish)' without the word 'hidup'.

Item 14: 'dugaan' in 'kelompok dugaan A. lacustris group' is awkward for 'putative'. Use 'kelompok yang diduga/diusulkan, "kelompok A. lacustris"'. It is also inconsistent with 'Kelompok A. microlepis' later in the same item.
Item 14: 'dengan A. falcatus sebagai anggota basal dan kelompok saudara bagi anggota lainnya' is clumsy. Say 'A. falcatus berada di posisi basal dan menjadi saudara bagi anggota lainnya'.
Item 1: 'Ketahanan: butuh akuarium yang sudah benar-benar matang' is acceptable but loose. Consider 'sudah mapan/matang secara biologis'.
Item 3: 'ikan keluarga Acestrorhynchidae bersifat kanibal' and 'cenderung merupakan pelompat yang kuat' are stiff. Use 'cenderung melompat dengan kuat'.

Item 8: 'tempat persembunyian yang berlebihan' for 'excess of cover' is fine, but 'sedikit gerakan di permukaan air' is fine too. 'Plants emergent' reads awkwardly; use 'tanaman yang tumbuh menembus permukaan'.

acheilognathus-macropterus.name: Giant Chinese Bitterling
notes: Item 11: "sedikit kemerahmudaan" is awkward and not standard Indonesian. Use "sedikit bersemu merah muda" or "agak kemerahmudaan".

Item 12: "ikan ini mungkin saja ternyata mudah beradaptasi" is vague. Make it explicit that the fish may be able to adapt to other host mussels, for example "mungkin dapat memanfaatkan kerang inang lain".
Item 13: "Kelompok acheilognathid (subfamili Acheilognathinae)" adds a parenthetical that is not in the English. Remove it or keep it plain.
Item 7: "batu-batu sungai yang halus" for "water-worn rocks" is slightly off. "batu sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air" fits better.

acheilognathus-tonkinensis.name: Rainbow bitterling
notes: #4 "tidak ada masalahnya" is slightly awkward; better "mudah dipelihara" or "tidak sulit dipelihara".
#4 "jadi ikan ini hemat energi" is slightly awkward, since it is the keeping that saves energy; better "sehingga pemeliharaannya hemat energi dan ramah lingkungan".
#6 "teman satu akuariumnya" is stiff; better "ikan penghuni akuarium lainnya" or "semua ikan lain di akuarium".
#8 "parasit pengeraman" is a literal rendering of "brood parasite"; better "parasit sarang (brood parasite)" or add a brief explanation.
#7 "ikan putih" for "whitefish" is unclear to Indonesian readers; consider adding the English term in brackets or a short explanation (e.g., ikan kecil berwarna keperakan).
#9 "cara berkembang biaknya sebagai parasit pengeraman" is clumsy; simplify it.

acnodon-normani.name: Sheep Pacu
notes: Item 7: "wadah" is vague for "tank"; use "akuarium", e.g. "membutuhkan akuarium yang cukup besar".
Item 18: "nama persembahan" is awkward for "dedication name"; use "nama ini untuk menghormati John Roxbrough Norman".

acrochordonichthys-gyrinus.name: Falcate Chameleon Catfish
notes: "teman setangki" (items 1, 8) is slightly unnatural. "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "tankmate" would be more usual for Indonesian hobbyists.
"tanpa lipatan daging" (item 9) is a bit literal for "fleshy flap". "tanpa lipatan berdaging" reads more naturally.

acrochordonichthys-rugosus.name: Asian Banjo Catfish
notes: Item 2/16: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is a slightly non-standard rendering of the IUCN category. "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah" with the English term is acceptable, but keep it consistent with the Indonesian IUCN usage.
Item 7: "kimia air yang naik-turun" is a bit stiff. Consider "parameter air yang berfluktuasi".
Item 8: "Kayu dan akar yang sudah lama terendam" for "Aged driftwood" slightly shifts the meaning. Consider "kayu apung yang sudah matang/tua (driftwood)".
Item 12: "Meskipun sebenarnya tidak suka bergerombol" is a bit stronger than "not really gregarious". Consider "kurang bersifat bergerombol".

acrochordonichthys-septentrionalis.name: Mae Klong Chameleon Catfish
notes: "stres dalam bentuk tertentu" is stiff and slightly unclear for "stressed in some way". Use "mengalami stres/tertekan oleh sebab tertentu".
"batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang bulat/halus terkikis air", or simply "batu dan kerikil sungai".
"pori aksila" is very technical. Consider adding the English term in brackets, "pori aksila (axillary pore)".
"pengaturan seperti ini membantu" is a loose rendering of "such an arrangement provides assistance". Use "pengelompokan seperti ini membantu".
"Seperti kerabatnya satu genus" is clumsy. Use "Seperti spesies lain dalam genusnya".

acrossocheilus-beijiangensis.name: Acrossocheilus beijiangensis
notes: Item 1: "131 mm SL (5 in SL)" -> the imperial figure was dropped, which is fine. But "SL" is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 1/4: "ikan cyprinid bergaris tegak" is acceptable, but "cyprinid" could be "ikan famili Cyprinidae" or "ikan sejenis brek/tambra" for clarity.
Item 1/3: "merumput biofilm" is slightly awkward; consider "memakan biofilm yang menempel pada batu..." or "mengerik biofilm".

Item 4: "jari-jari sirip punggung tidak bercabang yang terakhir mengeras menjadi tulang" is slightly heavy; "osseous" means bony. Consider "jari-jari keras terakhir pada sirip punggung berupa tulang".
Item 1: "Sifat sosial: perlu dipelihara dalam kelompok" is fine, but "Kecocokan: cocok dengan ikan lain" is repetitive; consider "Kompatibilitas: aman dengan ikan lain".

acrossocheilus-iridescens.name: Acrossocheilus iridescens
notes: Item 1: "masing-masing selebar enam sampai delapan sisik" is fine, but "ikan cyprinid" could be "ikan dari famili Cyprinidae" (minor).
Item 4: "horny sheath" rendered as "lapisan tanduk"; "selubung tanduk" is a more natural anatomical term (minor).
Item 4: "postlabial" and "rostral" are left as loanwords; "sungut rostral" is acceptable, but a gloss such as "sungut moncong" would help readers (minor).
Item 2: "Sungai Merah (Red River)" and "Sungai Mutiara" are fine; the quoted type locality is left in English, which is acceptable.

acrossocheilus-monticola.name: Acrossocheilus monticola
notes: Item 1: "150 mm SL" – the English gives "6 in SL" too, and dropping it is fine, but "SL" is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 1: "ikan cyprinid bergaris" – "barred" means bars (vertical stripes), so "bergaris-garis vertikal" or "berpalang" is clearer. "Cyprinid" could be "anggota suku Cyprinidae".
Item 4: "jari-jari tunggal terakhir ... mengeras seperti tulang" – "osseous" would be better as "keras (menulang)", and "jari-jari keras terakhir" is the usual term for a simple ray.
Item 4: "bibir atas yang mulus" – "smooth" is fine, but "tanpa rumbai" would match the etymology better.

Item 2: The quoted original, with its typo "fiowing", is left in English followed by a translation. This is acceptable for a quotation, but the typo could be marked [sic] or the text simply translated.

acrossocheilus-paradoxus.name: Taiwan banded barb
notes: Item 6: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is OK, but "setup" is used repeatedly; consider "aquascape/tata letak akuarium" (minor).
Item 6: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus".
Item 6: "mengerik" for graze is slightly unnatural; use "memakan dengan cara mengerik/menggerogoti" or "merumput".
Item 5: "akuarium paling kecil yang layak dipertimbangkan" is a little stiff; "ukuran terkecil yang disarankan" is more natural.
Item 1: "butuh" is colloquial for a handbook; use "membutuhkan" (also items 1 and 6).
Item 13: "garis vertikal" for "bar" is fine, but "sungut" for barbels and "anakan" for juveniles are acceptable; "sirip punggung mengeras seperti tulang" is awkward, use "mengeras (berbentuk duri)" .

acrossocheilus-parallens.name: Acrossocheilus parallens
notes: Item 1: "garis vertikal" for bars is fine, but "ikan cyprinid" could be "ikan famili Cyprinidae (cyprinid)" for hobbyists; minor.
Item 1/3: "mengerik biofilm" is slightly awkward; "memakan/mengikis biofilm" reads more natural.
Item 4: "jari-jari tak bercabang terakhir ... mengeras seperti tulang" is a bit loose for "osseous"; consider "berupa tulang keras".

aequidens-tetramerus.name: Saddle Cichlid
notes: Item 11: "A. diadema ... form a putatively monophyletic groupings" is rendered "diduga membentuk kelompok monofiletik"; fine, but "A. didema group" in the source was rendered "A. diadema" (silent correction). Keep it consistent with the source or flag it.
Item 11: "Cichlasoma ... sister clade" is rendered "kelompok saudara dari klad tersebut". Mixing "kelompok" and "klad" is awkward; use "klad" or "kelompok" consistently.
Item 5: "batu agak pipih yang halus karena terkikis air" is clumsy; use "batu pipih yang halus terkikis arus (water-worn)".
Item 1/2/11: "Dalam pengertian taksonomi saat ini" is a stiff rendering of "as currently recognised"; "menurut klasifikasi saat ini" is more natural.
Item 8: "teman satu akuarium" is slightly awkward; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "tankmate" for "tankmates".
Item 3: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" is fine, but "tidak pilih-pilih habitat" is colloquial for a handbook; "generalis habitat" or "toleran terhadap beragam habitat" is better.

agamyxis-pectinifrons.name: Raphael tutul
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 150 mm SL (6 in)' became '15 cm SL' – fine, but item 3 'Polygonium sp.' etc unchanged; no issue. Real issue in item 4: volume stated as 'sekitar 108 liter' with no tank height given; acceptable. Main issue: item 2 'Region Loreto' should be 'Wilayah/Departemen Loreto' (Region is untranslated English).
Item 2: 'Batas pasti sebaran alaminya masih agak belum jelas' is awkward; use 'masih kurang jelas'.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipe' should be 'lokalitas tipe' (standard taxonomic term); 'Equador' in the quote is fine.

Item 3: 'mengalir 'sedimen terlarut membuat air keruh' – source says 'reducing visibility'; fine, but 'polong-polongan' for 'leguminous species' is okay. 'padang apung' is a coined term; keep English in brackets only once consistently.

Item 7: 'omnivora generalis' is stiff; use 'omnivora dan tidak pemilih (generalis)'. 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is OK but 'pakan buatan' for 'prepared foods' should be 'pakan olahan/pabrikan'.
Item 11: 'sisik keras (scute)' – scutes are bony plates, not scales; use 'lempeng tulang (scute)'. 'klad' is unusual; use 'kelompok monofiletik (clade)'.
Item 11: 'memperkeras suara' mistranslates 'projection of the noise'; should be 'memancarkan/menyalurkan suara'.
Item 11: 'kerabat segenusnya' – 'congener' fine; but 'Region'/'lele driftwood' fine. 'konon' for 'ostensibly' adds hearsay nuance; use 'tampaknya/dengan alasan'.

ageneiosus-inermis.name: Manduba
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran akuarium: 400 × 120 cm' – the source's 'in excess of' is only in the prose; fine, but 'Ukuran maksimum' should be 'Ukuran maks.' – minor. Real issue: 'rios Negro, Madeira...' rendered as 'Sungai Negro' is OK, but 'ríos Tocantins... de la Plata' lost the 'Río' form; 'Sungai ... de la Plata' is awkward – use 'Sungai La Plata' (Río de la Plata).

Item 4: the volume '~5760 liter' is kept but the imperial figure was dropped correctly; however 'Ikan dewasa yang sudah tumbuh penuh' is redundant – use 'Ikan dewasa yang telah tumbuh penuh' or 'Ikan dewasa'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki kecil' – 'goldfish' is 'ikan mas koki' fine, but 'ikan teri (whitebait)' is inaccurate: whitebait is not teri; use 'whitebait' or 'ikan kecil beku' instead.
Item 7: 'menelan mangsa yang ukurannya mengejutkan besarnya' and 'memangsa mangsa' (items 1, 8) are clumsy repetition; rephrase e.g. 'mampu memakan mangsa yang sangat besar'.
Item 3: 'bagian hilir alur sungai' for 'lower sections of river channels' is ambiguous; use 'bagian bawah/dalam alur sungai utama' as appropriate.
Item 10: 'jari-jari sirip punggung' – source is singular 'dorsal fin ray'; use 'jari-jari keras sirip punggung' singular. Also 'mengendalikannya secara fisik' – use 'menahan/menggerakkan betina'.
Item 9: 'jari-jari ... bercabang pertama' ambiguous for 'first branched dorsal fin ray' (singular); also 'secara signifikan' – use 'sangat'/'jauh'.
Item 11: 'tepi orbit' and 'sungut dagu' acceptable, but 'jaringan lemak' for adipose tissue should be 'jaringan adiposa'; 'tonjolan tulang maksila' fine.

ageneiosus-magoi.name: Slopehead Catfish
notes: Item 3: "loricariid (keluarga sapu-sapu)" – loricariid is a family, not just sapu-sapu; fine but "keluarga" phrasing slightly awkward; consider "ikan famili Loricariidae (sapu-sapu)".
Item 4: "menjepit betina saat kawin" loses "spawning embrace"; consider "saat pelukan pemijahan/kawin".
Item 6: "dolphin catfish lainnya ... warnanya cenderung kurang mencolok" – 'remaining' rendered as 'lainnya' is OK, but "pastilah" overstates 'surely'; consider "tentu"/"tampaknya".

ageneiosus-marmoratus.name: Bottlenose Catfish
notes: Item 2: 'creek ... tributary of the Potaro River' — 'sebuah anak sungai' for creek then 'anak Sungai Potaro' is okay, but 'cabang dari sistem Sungai Essequibo' for 'affluent' should be 'anak sungai' (tributary), not 'cabang' (distributary).

Item 8: 'Aggressively territorial or very competitive species' was translated as 'agresif dan teritorial atau ... kompetitif'; 'dan' changes the meaning slightly; should be 'yang sangat agresif secara teritorial'.
Item 7: 'small goldfish' rendered 'ikan mas koki kecil' (koki = fancy goldfish); use 'ikan mas kecil' or 'goldfish kecil'.
Item 7: 'shellfish' rendered 'kerang-kerangan/udang-udangan' — adds 'udang-udangan' (crustaceans), which is not in the original; use 'kerang-kerangan' or 'seafood bercangkang'.
Item 7: 'obligate carnivores' as 'karnivora sejati' is slightly loose; use 'karnivora obligat'.

Item 5: 'Weekly water changes of 30-50% ... never be introduced to biologically immature set-ups' translated as 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' — acceptable but 'sama sekali tidak boleh' is a stronger rendering than 'must never'; 'arus dengan kekuatan tertentu' is vague for 'a degree of flow' — use 'arus sedang'.
Item 5: 'batu yang permukaannya halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn rocks'; use 'batu sungai yang halus'.
Item 9: 'sisi dalamnya' for 'medial surfaces' is vague; 'merayu' (item 10) for 'court' is colloquial; use 'memikat' or 'mendekati'.

Item 11: 'moncong lebar berbentuk parabola' is fine, but 'sirip ekor berlekuk dangkal (emarginate)' is OK; 'Genus ini dibedakan dari anggota Auchenipteridae lainnya' is fine. 'Terbentuk dari tonjolan tulang maxilla' is an acceptable rendering.

ageneiosus-ucayalensis.name: Duck Catfish
notes: Item 10: "Belum pernah tercatat berhasil dipijahkan di akuarium" changes the meaning of "Unrecorded in aquaria". The English says no spawning or courtship is recorded. The Indonesian says spawning was attempted but did not succeed. Use "Belum pernah tercatat di akuarium" or "Perkembangbiakan di akuarium belum pernah dilaporkan".
Item 11: "sirip ekor bercabang dalam" for "caudal fin deeply forked" is imprecise. Use "sirip ekor bercagak dalam" or "berbelah dalam".

Item 11: "jari-jari bercabang pertama" in the 'Selaput antarjari-jari' sentence and the anal-fin ray terms are acceptable. However, "tonjolan tulang maksila" for "outgrowths of the maxillae" is a slightly loose rendering.
Item 1 and item 8: "karasin ... perenang kolom air" for "pelagic characins" is wordy. "Karasin pelagis" would be clearer.

Item 4: "mudah kaget, dan gampang terluka" loses the sense that the fish injure themselves by swimming into the glass. "menabrak kaca" is acceptable, but the causal link is weaker than in the English.
Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" and "ikan teri beku (whitebait)" are questionable. Whitebait is not teri in the strict sense, so "ikan umpan kecil (whitebait)" would be safer.

aguarunichthys-tocantinsensis.name: Tocantins Pimelodus
notes: Item 7: the English says the depth is 70 cm (28 in) and the length is 2 metres (6 ft); the Indonesian is fine. The source says 'no smaller than', which 'minimal' covers.
Item 13: 'jari-jari lunak sirip dubur' and 'duri sirip dubur 5' match the source, so there is no change. The original 'anal spines 5' is odd, but it was translated faithfully.

Item 8: 'Mau menerima pakan kering berupa pelet' is stiff. Use 'Mau memakan pelet kering, cacing tanah, atau fillet ikan'. The source also says 'fish fillet', not 'potongan fillet', so 'potongan' is an added detail.
Item 10: 'wilayah teritori' is redundant. Use 'wilayah teritorinya yang luas' or just 'teritori yang luas'.
Item 10: 'cukup kecil untuk ditelan' adds 'untuk ditelan' ('to be swallowed'). The source says only 'small enough' to eat. This is a minor addition.

Item 12: 'Unreported in the aquarium' is translated as 'Belum ada laporan pemijahan di akuarium'. 'Pemijahan' (breeding) is added, since the source gives no subject, though it is probably implied by context. This is minor.
Item 4: 'infrequent and not very abundant' is fine. However, 'Dikoleksi' in items 5 and 6 is a loose rendering of 'Collected'. Use 'Ditemukan/Tertangkap di area berarus deras...' or 'Dikumpulkan'.
Item 9: 'whole and unbroken smelts' is rendered as 'ikan smelt utuh'. This is acceptable, but 'unbroken' is dropped. This is minor.
Item 3: the translation uses 'di hulu Marabá' for 'above Marabá'. This is acceptable, but it may add the sense 'upstream'. It is minor.

aguarunichthys-torosus.name: Bolt Catfish
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 346 mm SL (14 in SL)' – the imperial figure was dropped, which is allowed. 346 mm is not a conversion, so it is fine.
Item 1/2/5: 'hulu lembah Amazon' – 'lembah' is an unusual rendering of 'basin'. Use 'daerah hulu DAS Amazon' or 'cekungan Amazon'.
Item 3: 'predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' is slightly loose. 'predator obligat' or 'pemakan ikan murni' is more precise.
Item 4: 'Mau makan' is a bit colloquial. 'Menerima pelet kering...' is more natural. 'fillet ikan' could be 'fillet ikan' in a hobby context, which is fine.
Item 6: 'Teman setangki' is acceptable, but 'penghuni akuarium lain' is more standard. 'tidak dianggap mangsa' is fine.
Item 9: 'suku Indian Peru' – 'suku Indian' is awkward. 'suku asli Peru' or 'suku Aguaruna' is better.
Item 8: 'catfish' is left in English after the trade names, which is acceptable as a trade name.

ailia-coila.name: Ailia
notes: Item 5: "menurun cukup signifikan" adds a hedge ("cukup") that is not in the English "significant population decline"; use "menurun secara signifikan".
Item 5: "bentuk latin dari Kajoli" would be more natural as "bentuk Latin (dilatinkan) dari Kajoli", with Latin capitalised.

ailiichthys-punctata.name: Jamuna ailia
notes: Item 4: "Namun, kemungkinan besar eksploitasi berlebihan merupakan ancaman utama bagi spesies ini, meski karena kurangnya data" - the "meski" link slightly distorts the logic of the original (threat likely, but decline cannot be estimated due to lack of data); use "tetapi" or "namun".

Item 4: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)" - the Indonesian IUCN term is usually "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah"; "Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)" is more commonly "Informasi Kurang" or "Data Kurang". Keep one consistent form.

Item 4: "harvest level" translated as "tingkat penangkapan"; "tingkat pemanenan/penangkapan" is acceptable, but "data populasi dan tingkat penangkapan" could be clearer as "data populasi dan tingkat pemanenan".
Item 2/3: "Lokasi tipe" is better as "Lokalitas tipe"; "Jumna" as a river name was rendered "Sungai Jumna" in item 2 but left as "Jumna" in the quote in item 3 (fine as a quote, but keep consistent).

akysis-brachybarbatus.name: Tuberculate Catfish
notes: Item 1: "The tip of the snout is not in front of the lower jaw" is fine, but "Sirip ekornya sedikit berlekuk (emarginate) atau rata (truncate)" is OK; however "Tuberculate catfish" left untranslated is acceptable. No major issue here.
Item 3: "kolam-kolam sungai yang jernih" adds "sungai" (river), which isn't in the original "clear pools". Use "kolam/cekungan air yang jernih" or "genangan jernih".
Item 8: "kysis = kantong" – the English says "bladder"; "kandung" or "kandung kemih" is the better rendering for the etymology. "Kantong" changes the meaning slightly.
Item 8: "pendangkalan oleh endapan lumpur" is redundant; use "sedimentasi" or "pendangkalan akibat sedimentasi".
Item 8: "area yang benar-benar dihuni (AOO)" adds nuance; use "luas area hunian (AOO)".
Item 4: "kedalaman 30 cm" is OK, but "Bisa dipelihara" is fine; no change needed. Item 6: "kutu air" for daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the more usual hobby term.

akysis-ephippifer.name: Akysis ephippifer
notes: "mudah dipelihara oleh penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman": "any decent fishkeeper" means almost any reasonably competent keeper; consider "penghobi yang kompeten/pada umumnya" so it doesn't imply experience is required.
"dalam 30 cm": for tank depth, use "panjang/lebar depan-belakang" or "kedalaman" more naturally, e.g. "30 cm (lebar) x 20 cm (tinggi) x 30 cm (dalam)" could be clearer.
"gua": hobbyists usually say "gua-gua kecil" or "shelter/tempat sembunyi"; the plural "caves" is not reflected.
"sirip ekor yang sedikit berlekuk (emarginate)": "emarginate" means a shallow notch; "sedikit" is acceptable, but "berlekuk dangkal" is more precise.
"Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)": the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Data Kurang"; use "Data Kurang (Data Deficient)".
"kutu air" for daphnia: hobbyists often use "kutu air" for Daphnia, though "Daphnia" is also common; this is fine but could add "(daphnia)".

akysis-hendricksoni.name: Hendrickson's Stream Catfish
notes: Item 19: "Wakil Rektor" for "Vice-Chancellor" is a questionable equivalent (a vice-chancellor is closer to a rector or head). Use "Rektor" or "Wakil Kanselir", or keep the English title.
Item 14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which is not in the source. Use "lohok/loach balitorid" or "famili Balitoridae" only.
Item 5: "sungai kecil yang cukup besar (lebar sekitar 10 m)" is contradictory and awkward. Use "anak sungai yang cukup lebar (sekitar 10 m)" or just "sungai".
Item 9: "penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman" reads more demanding than "any decent fishkeeper". Use "penghobi yang kompeten" or "penghobi pada umumnya".
Item 8: "moss" is left in English. Use "lumut (moss)" or "berbagai jenis lumut air".
Item 19: "kysis = kantong" for "bladder" is imprecise. "Kandung" or "kantung" would be better, since the reference is to the swim bladder.
Item 12: "jentik kaca (glassworm)" is a loose rendering of the glassworm (Chaoborus larva). Hobbyists usually say "cacing kaca" or "jentik lonceng/kaca", so check the term.

akysis-heterurus.name: Lele Akysis
notes: Item 4: "depan-belakang 30 cm" is awkward for tank depth; use "dalam 30 cm" or "lebar 30 cm x tinggi 20 cm x dalam 30 cm".
Item 4: "gua-gua kecil sebagai tempat bersembunyi" adds "kecil" and "sebagai tempat bersembunyi", which the source does not say; use "gua" only.
Item 3: the gloss after "unculiferous" ("yaitu tonjolan kecil yang permukaannya dipenuhi tonjolan halus seperti kait") is not in the source; remove it or shorten it to "berunculi".

akysis-longifilis.name: Sittaung Stream Catfish
notes: Item 10: "glassworm (jentik Chaoborus)" adds a genus name the English doesn't give. Use "glassworm" alone, or "jentik glassworm".
Item 12: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which isn't in the source. Use "loach balitorid" or "loach dari famili Balitoridae".
Item 7: "pehobi yang cukup berpengalaman" is stronger than "any decent fishkeeper". Something like "pehobi yang kompeten" or "pehobi pada umumnya" is closer.
Item 15: "gravid female" is rendered "betina yang sedang bertelur", which suggests she is laying. "betina yang penuh telur" or "betina matang telur" is more accurate.

akysis-maculipinnis.name: Spotfin Stream Catfish
notes: Item 14: "alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves" is wrong, because melingkar means circular. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubangnya" or similar.
Item 8: "moss", "beech" and "oak" are left in English. Use "lumut" or "moss" with a gloss, and "daun beech/ek" with a gloss.
Item 15: "air yang sudah diendapkan" for "aged water" is slightly off. "air yang sudah didiamkan/diendapkan (aged)" is more natural, and "diffuser" could get a local gloss.
Item 13: "wajib cari tahu dulu dengan benar" is colloquial for a handbook. Use "wajib dipelajari dulu dengan cermat".

akysis-portellus.name: Akysis portellus
notes: Item 17: 'kysis = kandung (kandung kemih)' is awkward/garbled; write 'kysis = kandung kemih'.
Item 3/4: 'anak sungai Shwe Kyin, sebuah anak sungai kecil' repeats 'anak sungai'; the English 'stream' should be 'sungai kecil Shwe Kyin' or 'aliran'.

Item 15: 'dibiarkan melingkarkan tubuhnya ke tubuh betina' is awkward; 'cairan sperma' should be 'sperma/air mani'. Also the temperature drop omitted the (45 °F) which is fine, but 'jantan yang berhasil' reads oddly.
Item 14: 'lipatan daging' and 'lubang kelamin' are unnatural; use 'lipatan berdaging' and 'lubang genital'. 'Sirip dubur' is fine but 'sirip perut' for pelvic is acceptable.

Item 14: 'Pada A. alfredi, ... pada jantan lebih pendek daripada betina' adds 'pada jantan', which the English implies but it is fine; 'Belum dilaporkan' for 'Unreported' is ambiguous: say 'Belum ada laporan (dimorfisme seksual pada spesies ini)'.

Item 16: 'Asian stream catfishes' (lele arus Asia) leaves English in quotes; 'rahang atas' for maxillary barbels is okay but 'nasal barbels' should be 'sungut hidung' (ok). 'sirip ekor rata atau sedikit berlekuk' for truncate/emarginate is acceptable.
Item 11: 'moss' (item 7) and 'glassworm' left in English without a local term; use 'lumut' / 'cacing kaca'.
Item 13: 'hillstream loach' is added English not in the source; use 'ikan loach arus deras' or keep to 'Balitoridae'. 'teman satu akuarium' is fine.
Item 19: Reference list untranslated, which is acceptable.
Item 1: 'lele arus bermulut kecil' plus English name repeated is OK; 'Hardness 2–12 dGH' fine.

akysis-prashadi.name: Indawgyi stream catfish
notes: Item 12: "glassworm (jentik Chaoborus)" adds a genus name not in the source; keep just "glassworm" or a common local term.
Item 15: "Perbedaan kelamin" is better rendered as "dimorfisme seksual" (sexual dimorphism).
Item 7: "moss" is left in English; consider "lumut" (e.g. "lumut air").

akysis-pulvinatus.name: Kra stream catfish
notes: "betina yang sedang bertelur" for "gravid female": gravid means carrying eggs, not yet spawning. Use "betina yang sedang bunting telur" or "penuh telur".
"alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves at the pore": radial means grooves radiating outward. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubang".
"batu-batu sungai yang halus" for "water-worn rocks": better as "batu sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air".
Item 8: "hillstream loach (balitorid)" is fine, but "tumbuh terlalu besar" would read more naturally as "terlalu besar saat dewasa".

akysis-variegatus.name: Akysis variegatus
notes: Item 1: "unculiferous plaques or tubercles" is rendered "lempeng atau tuberkel berunkulus (tonjolan kecil seperti duri)". "Unculiferous" means bearing unculi (horny, spine-like cell structures). "berunkulus" is a non-standard coinage, and the added explanation is a gloss the source doesn't contain. Use a clearer rendering such as "berunkuli", or a simple explanation.

Item 1: "Nasal barbel shorter than head length" should be "sungut hidung" with a clear comparison to head length. "Large dark blotches on lower part of body" is fine. Check that "Bagian bawah tubuh berbercak gelap besar" is not misread, and consider "bercak gelap besar".

Item 2: The English locality statement is contradictory: "Northern Borneo and Mekong basin" versus "known only from Citarum, Java". The translation keeps this faithfully. No fix needed except that "1960's" is correctly given as "1960-an".

Item 3: "kedalaman 30 cm" for tank depth is better as "lebar 30 cm x tinggi 20 cm x dalam 30 cm", or use "panjang x lebar x tinggi". "gua" would be more natural as "gua-gua kecil" or "gua buatan" (ornamen gua).
Item 6: "makan dengan sangat lahap dan heboh" is colloquial for "voraciously and crazily". Consider "sangat rakus" for a handbook register.
Item 5: "kutu air" for daphnia is acceptable, but hobbyists commonly use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)". Consider adding it.

akysis-varius.name: Akysis varius
notes: Item 16: "Pola warna dewasa sudah terbentuk sempurna baru 23 hari kemudian" reverses the nuance. The English "after just 23 days" means it was fast, but "baru" reads as late. Use "hanya dalam 23 hari" or "sudah terbentuk sempurna hanya setelah 23 hari".
Items 1, 17, 18: "sirip ekor tegak (truncate)" is a questionable rendering. "Tegak" does not describe a caudal fin shape. Use "sirip ekor terpotong rata (truncate)".
Item 1: "Variable stream catfish" is left in English in the running text. Add a local gloss such as "lele sungai variabel" or keep it clearly marked as a trade name.
Item 17: "alat bisa (venom)" is awkward. "Kelenjar bisa" or "struktur penyuntik bisa" is more natural.

akysis-vespa.name: Wasp Catfish
notes: #8: "(misalnya lumut Java)" is not in the source. Delete it or keep only "berbagai jenis lumut".
#14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which the source doesn't have. Use "lonjong/loach balitorid" or "loach Balitoridae" without the addition.
#14: "Lele akysid lain ... direkomendasikan untuk lapisan bawah akuarium" is slightly awkward. "Ikan lele akysid" would be more natural.

akysis-vespertinus.name: Akysis vespertinus
notes: Item 8: 'Not especially competitive' is rendered 'Tidak terlalu agresif dalam berebut makanan'. This adds 'food' and changes the meaning. Use 'Tidak terlalu kompetitif'.

Item 8: 'it's also proven to co-exist peacefully with freshwater shrimp' is rendered 'Ikan ini juga terbukti...'. The sentence now reads as a separate statement rather than part of the preceding list. Check that the flow is clear.
Item 5: 'Walaupun tanaman air kecil kemungkinannya ada di habitat aslinya' is awkward and ambiguous. Use 'Walaupun tanaman air kemungkinan besar bukan bagian dari habitat aslinya'.
Item 5: 'batu-batu kali yang halus terkikis air' is wordy for 'water-worn rocks'. Use 'batu kali yang halus'.
Item 5: 'moss' is left in English. Use 'lumut' or 'java moss' as the hobby term.
Item 1: 'Western stream catfish' is left untranslated as the common name. Consider adding a local gloss.
Item 1: 'kemungkinan besar tersebar lebih luas' and 'tampaknya' are redundant hedging in the same sentence. Remove one of them. Items 2 and 11 do the same.
Item 9: 'Belum dilaporkan, tetapi dimorfisme seksual sudah dilaporkan' is correct. 'pelkvic' and 'poterior' in the source are typos that were silently fixed. This is fine.
Item 11: '135–16,0% SL' repeats the source's apparent typo (likely 13.5). Flag it for the editor, or correct it.

Item 11: 'tinggi badan di bagian anus' and 'jarak antarmata' are acceptable. 'sirip ekor rata atau sedikit berlekuk' is fine. 'Pseudobagarius' and similar names are correct. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)' is more common.

alestopetersius-brichardi.name: Cherry Red Congo Tetra
notes: Item 9: "tribus dugaan" for "putative tribes" is awkward; use "tribus yang diusulkan" or "tribus sementara".
Item 9: "predator mikro" is a little stiff; "pemangsa mikro" would be more natural.
Item 7: "hasilnya akan berupa pemandangan yang lebih alami" is awkward; rephrase as "Anda akan mendapat tampilan yang lebih alami".
Item 4: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is acceptable but loosely renders "biologically-immature"; "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" is closer.
Item 3: "±108 liter" uses "±" for "~"; "sekitar 108 liter" reads better.
Item 7: "ikan lele/catfish" is a clumsy slash; "lele dan catfish lain" or "catfish" alone is cleaner.

alestopetersius-caudalis.name: Yellow Tail Congo Tetra
notes: Item 11: 'Kedua penulis tersebut juga mengeluarkan Chalceus dan Arnoldichthys' — the English says 'The latter authors' (Arroyave and Stiassny), not 'both authors'. Meaning changed; use 'Penulis yang disebut terakhir'.

Item 11: 'kedua penulis tersebut juga menganggap genus neotropis Chalceus...' — the English 'who' refers to Zanata and Vari; the text is OK, but the sentence was split with a semicolon. Check that 'kedua penulis' clearly refers to Zanata dan Vari.
Item 11: 'tribus dugaan' for 'putative tribes' is awkward; use 'tiga tribus yang diduga' or 'tribus putatif'.
Item 11: 'monofili kedua kelompok ini ditolak' — 'monophyly' is better rendered 'status monofiletik'.
Item 11: 'Guinea Bawah' for 'lower Guinea' is fine, but 'goliath tigerfish raksasa pemangsa ikan' is clumsy; use 'ikan harimau goliath (goliath tigerfish) yang raksasa dan pemakan ikan'.
Item 8: 'dirancang dengan baik' is expected for 'well-researched'; 'direncanakan dengan baik' loses the sense of 'well-researched'. Use 'yang dirancang dengan cermat'.
Item 8: 'sisik yang lepas sangat umum terjadi' is stiff; use 'kehilangan sisik sangat sering terjadi'.
Item 3: 'ikan alestid lain yang ditemukan' is fine; but 'Belum banyak tulisan' is slightly informal. Use 'Belum banyak literatur'.
Item 2: 'Provinsi Équateur, barat laut Republik Demokratik Kongo' — fine. 'Type locality' as 'Lokasi tipe' is non-standard; use 'Lokalitas tipe'.

alestopetersius-hilgendorfi.name: Hilgendorf's tetra
notes: "Ikan ini sebaiknya hanya dipelihara oleh penghobi...": the English says "They" for the fish; the Indonesian is fine, but "miskin bakteri" is a literal calque. Prefer "rendah bakteri" or "minim bakteri".

"saat ditangkap warnanya jauh lebih merah pekat": the English says "when caught" (the fish were caught and handled). Prefer "saat ditangkap dengan jaring" or "saat diambil" for clarity. "merah pekat" is slightly awkward; "merah lebih tua" is more natural.
"tinta yang meluber": the English says "spread ink". "tinta yang menyebar" is more faithful.
"tergantung suasana hatinya": "suasana hati" is a bit anthropomorphic. Prefer "tergantung kondisi/suasana (stres atau tenang)" or "tergantung keadaannya".

alestopetersius-leopoldianus.name: Alestopetersius leopoldianus
notes: Minor: 'Mai-Ndombe' vs 'Lac Mai Ndombe' spelling is inconsistent in the same bracket; use one form.
Minor: 'bersemu oranye' is slightly literary; 'berwarna oranye kemerahan/semburat oranye' may be more natural.

alestopetersius-nigropterus.name: African Rainbow Tetra
notes: Item 9: 'Mbimbi Mayi Muneni' (EN text) is the source's spelling; ID matches it, but reference list says 'Munene' — no fix needed in translation, but consider noting the inconsistency.
Item 7: 'ikan catfish (berbagai jenis lele-lelean)' is redundant; use 'ikan catfish' or 'lele-lelean' only.
Item 7: 'well-researched' was rendered as 'dirancang dengan baik' (well-designed); the meaning shifts. Use 'direncanakan dengan matang'.
Item 9: 'Hemigrammopetersius Pellegrin 1926' became '(Pellegrin, 1926)'; keep the original citation format.
Item 8: 'Jantan yang sedang berahi atau siap memijah' adds 'berahi'; 'nuptial' alone means breeding-condition, so use 'Jantan yang siap memijah'.
Item 6: 'mencari makan dengan memakan' is awkward; use 'pemakan serangga kecil...'.
Item 9: 'putative tribes' was rendered 'tribus yang diusulkan'; 'tribus' is fine but 'dugaan' is closer.
Item 9: 'Arroyave dan Stiassny' replaces 'The latter authors' — acceptable, but 'Kedua penulis tersebut' in the Zanata/Vari sentence is fine.

alestopetersius-smykalai.name: Blue Diamond Tetra
notes: "Ganti air mingguan sebanyak 20–30% wajib": the English says 20-30% of the aquarium volume; add "volume akuarium" or "dari volume air" for clarity.
"siklus nitrogennya belum matang": the English says "biologically-immature"; this is acceptable but a bit of an interpretive rewording. Consider "yang belum matang secara biologis".
"tribus dugaan" for "putative tribes" is awkward; use "tribus yang diusulkan" or "tribus putatif".
"hasilnya adalah pemandangan yang lebih alami" is slightly stiff; consider "Anda akan mendapat tampilan yang lebih alami".
"Famili Alestidae adalah famili characiform Afrika..." repeats "famili" and leaves characiform in English; use "ordo Characiformes Afrika" or "famili characiformes Afrika".
"akuarium komunitas ... yang komposisinya sudah direncanakan dengan matang" for "well-researched" shifts the meaning slightly; "well-researched" refers to a community set up with proper research.

alfaro-cultratus.name: Knife Livebearer
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 75 mm SL (3.0 in)' – imperial dropped is fine, but 'SL' left unexplained; consider 'panjang standar (SL)'.
Item 1/10: 'Knife livebearer' left in English as the name; consider adding an Indonesian rendering or keep as trade name consistently (e.g., 'ikan livebearer pisau').
Item 2: 'Río Iroquois, Costa Rica' left with English 'Costa Rica' while the rest of the text uses 'Kosta Rika'; this is a quoted locality, so acceptable, but be consistent.
Item 3: 'backwaters' translated as 'perairan tenang' (calm waters) loses the 'backwater' sense; consider 'rawa/genangan tepi sungai' or 'anak sungai yang tenang'.
Item 4: 'akar kayu yang berliku' is slightly awkward; 'akar kayu bengkok/berkelok' (driftwood) reads more naturally.
Item 9: 'mudah dipijahkan' fits egg-layers poorly for livebearers; use 'mudah dibiakkan'. 'Burayak' for fry is OK but 'anakan' is used earlier, so be consistent.

allenbatrachus-grunniens.name: Ikan kodok
notes: Item 2: "menggerutu/mendengkur" for Latin 'grunting' is imprecise. Use "mendengus" or "menggeram" (grunting sound), and give one term rather than two.
Item 1: the opening "Freshwater toadfish" is left in English. Give an Indonesian name or gloss first, e.g. "Ikan kodok air tawar (freshwater toadfish)".
Item 5: "Spesies ini cukup umum di dunia akuarium" is slightly vague. "Dalam dunia akuarium hobi" or "di kalangan hobiis" would sound more natural.

altolamprologus-calvus.name: Calvus
notes: #5: "filling much of the aquarium" is rendered as "mengisi sebagian besar akuarium" and is fine, but "setup biotop" is mixed English; prefer "tata letak biotop" or "aquascape biotop".
#11: "cukup terlindungi" for "quite well-armoured" is vague; use "memiliki perlindungan lapis baja yang cukup baik" or "bersisik tebal sebagai pelindung".
#11: "sloped more laterally" is rendered as "lebih miring ke samping", which is unclear; rephrase to describe the mouth angle more clearly.
#10: "cangkang keong" is acceptable, but "Pot tanah liat" for flowerpots could be "pot bunga/pot terakota"; "Dalam kedua cara tersebut" is stiff.
#7: "Sebagian besar pakan hidup dan beku berbahan hewani diterima dengan mudah" is stiff; "mau memakan" is more natural.
#1: "kimia air" is unnatural; use "kondisi/parameter kimia air" or "perubahan kualitas air" (also in #11).

amaralia-hypsiura.name: Banjo catfish
notes: #1 "sirip punggungnya yang sangat mengecil": more natural "sirip punggungnya yang sangat mengecil/tereduksi"; acceptable but could be smoother.
#1 "Lele banjo": hobbyists often also use "banjo catfish"; consider adding (banjo catfish) in brackets at first mention.
#4 "ditemukan bahwa semua Amaralia hampir hanya memakan": awkward; prefer "hampir secara eksklusif memakan".
#4 "burayak": usually means fry/larvae; fine but "anakan ikan" is more common among hobbyists.
#5 "menekuk ekornya ke sisi tubuh": source says "press the tail on the side of the body"; "menempelkan ekornya pada sisi tubuh" is more faithful than "menekuk".

amatitlania-myrnae.name: Myrnae
notes: Item 10: "Jika berhasil mendapatkan ikan ini, spesies ini cukup mudah dibiakkan" is awkward because the subject changes mid-sentence. Rephrase, e.g. "Jika berhasil mendapatkannya, ikan ini cukup mudah dibiakkan."
Item 7: "sayuran hijau yang diblansir" is a non-standard term. "direbus sebentar" or "diseduh air panas" is more natural for hobbyists.
Item 10: "Untuk ikan sekecil ini, mereka sangat agresif" drops the nuance of "surprisingly". Use "mengejutkannya agresif" or "ternyata sangat agresif".

amatitlania-nanolutea.name: Yellow Convict
notes: Item 1/10: 'Saat musim kawin' for 'during courtship' is inaccurate; courtship is not a breeding season. Use 'saat masa pacaran/penjodohan'.

Item 3: 'Arcos nudus' is left as in the source, fine, but 'anak sungai' for 'streams and rivers' in item 1 was rendered 'sungai-sungai kecil' while item 3 uses 'anak sungai'. Make the term consistent.

Item 5: 'tidak boleh dimasukkan ke akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)' is fine, but 'pristine' became 'sangat bersih', which loses the sense of 'alami/murni'. Consider 'perairan yang masih alami dan murni'.

Item 10: 'Betina dapat meletakkan hingga 200 butir telur' - the original is passive ('as many as 200 eggs may be deposited'), so this adds the female as the actor. Make it 'hingga 200 butir telur dapat diletakkan'.
Item 10: 'burayak' for fry-grade foods is a non-standard hobby term. Use 'pakan kering untuk anakan ikan (fry)'.
Item 8: 'Alfaro, Brachyrhaphis dan Poecilia' is fine, but 'teritori' vs 'teritorial' is mixed with 'wilayah'. Use one term consistently.
Item 3: 'sympatrically' as 'hidup berdampingan (simpatrik)' is acceptable. 'Dasar perairan' for 'substrates' is inconsistent with 'substrat' elsewhere. Use 'substrat'.

amatitlania-nigrofasciata.name: Convict Cichlid
notes: Item 6: "Idealnya sedikit di atas netral (basa)" – "Somewhere on the alkaline side of neutral" means on the alkaline side; "sedikit" (slightly) adds a nuance, and the bracket is clumsy. Use "Idealnya di sisi basa dari netral".
Item 11: "burayaknya tidak mudah disalurkan" – "dispose of" means getting rid of or selling the fry; "disalurkan" is vague. Use "dijual atau dilepaskan" / "sulit dihabiskan".
Item 10: "Burayak" is used for the eggs' hatchlings and for free-swimming fry, and "Anakan" appears for the same young later. Keep the terms consistent.
Item 10: "Untuk ikan sekecil itu, mereka sangat agresif" – "sekecil itu" has no clear referent; use "Untuk ikan sekecil ini" / "seukuran ini".
Item 7: "kondisi ikan bisa berkembang optimal" – "kondisi berkembang" is awkward; use "agar kondisi ikan prima".
Item 10: "Kondisikan ikan" – the hobby term for conditioning broodstock is "dikondisikan/diberi pakan pematangan gonad"; "merangsang pemijahan" is fine.
Item 5: "kayu bogwood" is redundant; use "kayu bogwood (kayu apung/akar kayu)" or just "bogwood".
Item 1/11: "menjadi sangat ganas saat berbiak" – "berbiak" for fish is better as "memijah" for consistency with the rest of the text.

amatitlania-sajica.name: T-Bar Cichlid
notes: Item 3: "genus kolektif (kumpulan) Cichlasoma" is awkward; use "genus kolektif Cichlasoma" or "genus gabungan" without the extra bracket.

Item 3: "apalagi karena ikan-ikan ini relatif tidak merusak tanaman" is slightly stronger than the source ("treat plants rather gently", especially as); consider "terlebih lagi karena ikan ini cukup lembut terhadap tanaman".

Item 3: "berukuran cukup kecil" for "comparatively small" is fine, but "menunjukkan perilaku menarik yang sama" loses the nuance that they show the exciting behaviour of bigger cousins; consider "menampilkan perilaku menarik seperti kerabatnya".
Item 1: "panjang hingga 12 cm" is a minor addition; the source says only "up to 12 cm" (size), though the meaning is intact.

ambastaia-nigrolineata.name: Black-lined Loach
notes: Item 9: 'karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu' lacks the copula; write 'merupakan ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu'.
Item 7: 'riam' for 'riffles' suggests rapids or waterfalls; 'bagian berarus deras dan dangkal' or 'riak' is closer.
Item 12: 'ikan lele' for 'catfishes' usually means Clarias; 'berbagai jenis catfish' or 'ikan berkumis' is better for ornamental catfish.

ambastaia-sidthimunki.name: Botia sidthimunki
notes: Item 10: 'A 20-gallon (about 75 litre) tank' converted OK, but fine; however Item 3 omits the duplicate sentence 'A tightly-fitting cover is also essential' (harmless).

Item 22: 'Ambastaia nigrolineata and A. sidthimunki ternyata lebih dekat... padahal saat itu keduanya dianggap anggota Yasuhikotakia' - 'ternyata' fine, but 'Yang jelas, ikan ini tampaknya...' for 'It certainly seems' is OK; the statement 'Perubahan pertama... kedua' is OK. Main issue: 'pita vertikal' vs 'bars' fine.

Item 22: 'mungkin untuk mengurangi hambatan air... atau memiliki fungsi komunikasi lain' restructures 'perhaps reducing drag by swimming in formation' - acceptable, but 'Alasannya belum diketahui; mungkin berkaitan dengan cara kelompok tetap saling berdekatan' fine.

Item 18: 'angelfish' translated as 'manfish' is an acceptable Indonesian term, but 'cherry' should be 'udang cherry' (ok). 'Kelompok yang besar membuat mereka lebih tenang, membantu membentuk hierarki sosial, dan menampilkan perilaku' - subject is wrong: the group helps the fish to establish hierarchy and display behaviours; rephrase as 'membantu mereka membentuk hierarki sosial dan menampilkan perilaku...'.
Item 8: 'Karena musim hujan tahunan' is slightly unnatural; 'Karena habitat aslinya mengalami musim hujan tahunan' is better.
Item 22: 'Takson Ambastaia dibentuk' / 'Dwarf loach' fine; 'Hymenophysa... salah ejaan' fine. 'Saat ini anggota genus ini dibedakan...' fine.
Item 21: 'burayak' is OK; 'peternakan ikan' for fish farms could be 'tempat pembudidayaan ikan'.
Item 14: 'untuk tempat ikan ini melesat masuk' is clumsy; use 'tempat ikan ini bisa melesat masuk saat kaget'.

amblyceps-arunachalense.name: Arunachal torrent catfish
notes: "Mulut terminal" is acceptable, but "Sungut hidung" for nasal barbel and "Sungut maksila"/"Sungut mandibula luar/dalam" are slightly awkward; consider "sungut nasal", "sungut maksila", "sungut mandibula luar/dalam" consistently.
"Dikrong dan Subansiri" should read "Sungai Dikrong dan Sungai Subansiri" for clarity.
"survei-survei berikutnya ... tidak menemukan keberadaannya di tempat lain" is wordy; simplify to "survei lanjutan di daerah lain tidak menemukannya".
"Bibir berlipat ganda" is awkward; use "bibir dengan lipatan ganda".
"Ukuran: 13,0 cm panjang total" – use "panjang total 13 cm" for natural phrasing.
"Tren populasinya" is fine but "isthmus" is left untranslated; use "isthmus (celah antara insang)" or "tenggorokan".

amblyceps-caecutiens.name: Amblyceps caecutiens
notes: "Lokasi tipe": more standard is "Lokalitas tipe" (minor).
"anak sungai" for "streams": acceptable, but "sungai kecil/aliran sungai" may be more natural (minor).
"jari-jari lunak sirip dubur": "sirip anal" is the term more commonly used by hobbyists (minor).
"lipatan sudut mulut" for "rictal fold": non-standard rendering; consider "lipatan rictal" with the English term in brackets (minor).

amblyceps-cerinum.name: Amblyceps cerinum
notes: Item 4: "truncate caudal fin (vs. forked or strongly emarginate)" is translated with a gloss "tegak lurus di ujungnya/truncate"; "tegak lurus" is slightly awkward, so use "berujung rata/terpotong (truncate)".
Item 4: "vs." is left untranslated throughout; consider "dibandingkan" or "berbanding" for natural Indonesian.
Item 4: "jumlah vertebra pasca-Weber" is nonstandard; "vertebra pasca-Weberian" or "vertebra setelah aparatus Weber" would be clearer.
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is fine, but the bracket is redundant.

amblyceps-foratum.name: Amblyceps foratum
notes: "mata ... terletak di sisi atas kepala": 'dorsolaterally situated' is better rendered as "terletak di sisi punggung-lateral (dorsolateral) kepala"; "sisi atas" loses the lateral component.
"menimbulkan bengkak yang cukup parah": 'much swelling' is rendered a bit weaker; "pembengkakan hebat" would be closer.
"Least Concern/Risiko Rendah": the standard Indonesian term is "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)"; keep the format consistent with the bracket convention.
"foto mini pertama" for 'first thumbnail': "gambar mini/thumbnail pertama" is more natural.
"Dideskripsikan oleh": "Dideskripsikan oleh" is acceptable but "Deskripsi oleh" or "Dijelaskan oleh" is more natural in a spec list.
"ruas tulang belakang" for vertebrae: "vertebra" or "ruas tulang belakang (vertebra)" is the usual term.

amblyceps-laticeps.name: Torrent Catfish
notes: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)": the IUCN category 'Least Concern' is normally rendered "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Rendah"; 'Risiko Rendah' matches the old Lower Risk category, so use the current term.
"Jumlah ruas tulang belakang (vertebra)": the label is a little wordy; "Vertebra" alone would be more natural.
"Lokasi tipe": the usual term is "Lokalitas tipe" (type locality).
"Pegunungan Kasyah": the original spelling is kept, which is fine, but "Perbukitan Khasi" is used in the line before, so the two forms are inconsistent.

amblyceps-mangois.name: Indian Torrent Catfish
notes: Item 7: "Least Concern" rendered as "Risiko Rendah"; the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Terendah".
Item 4: "makan dengan heboh" is too colloquial for "feeding frantically"; use "makan dengan sangat agresif/bersemangat".
Item 7: "ikan lele" for catfish is fine, but "Indian Torrent Catfish" has no local name, so it stays in English. Consider adding a descriptive Indonesian gloss.
Item 3: "sungai dataran tinggi" for "upland streams" is better as "sungai pegunungan/hulu".

amblyceps-serratum.name: Amblyceps serratum
notes: Item 3: "anak sungai yang bercabang dari sungai utama" for "side arm of the main river" is slightly loose; "cabang sungai utama" is more precise.
Item 3: "Dikoleksi" is awkward; use "Dikumpulkan" or "Ditemukan".
Item 3: "di antara dasar kerikil" is awkward; use "pada dasar berkerikil" or "di antara hamparan kerikil".
Item 2: "kanal dangkal" for "shallow channel" could be "alur/saluran dangkal"; "kanal" suggests an artificial canal.
Item 1: the term "Kekurangan Data" for "Data Deficient" is fine, but "jari-jari lunak" and "sirip dubur" are acceptable; "4,5 cm" lacks specifying SL (minor).

amblyceps-tenuispinis.name: Amblyceps tenuispinis
notes: Item 3: "sungai dan aliran sungai" is redundant/awkward; use "sungai besar dan anak sungai/arus sungai" for "streams and rivers".
Item 4: "makan dengan heboh" is informal for "feeding frantically"; use "makan dengan agresif/liar".
Item 6: "Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)" — the standard Indonesian term is "Kurang Data"; use that.

amblypharyngodon-chulabhornae.name: Princess Carplet
notes: Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "Paling cocok dipelihara" is a slight shift from "Best maintained"; acceptable. Main issue: "ikan ikutan (bycatch)" is unnatural; use "ikan tangkapan sampingan" or "ikan campuran yang ikut terbawa".
Item 1/3: "Princess carplet" left untranslated with no local name; consider adding a descriptive Indonesian rendering or keeping it in italics/quotes as a trade name.
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is fine, but the type locality text is left in English ("Province"); consider "Provinsi" or keep as a quoted citation consistently.
Item 4: "Panjang standar: 4 cm" drops the precision of 40 mm; write "40 mm (4 cm)" or "4,0 cm".
Item 5: "Filter tidak perlu terlalu kuat karena ikan ini kebanyakan berasal dari..." is slightly awkward; use "karena ikan ini umumnya berasal dari perairan yang tenang".
Item 8: "tidak mudah stres" replaces "less nervous" (more skittish); prefer "tidak mudah gugup/penakut".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but the common hobby term is "kutu air (Daphnia)"; consider keeping "Daphnia" explicitly.

amphilophus-labiatus.name: Red Devil
notes: Item 11: "belang" (barred) and "belang-belang tidak beraturan (piebald)" are too close to tell apart. Use "bergaris/berpita vertikal" for barred.
Item 5: "saat sedang heboh" is informal. Use something like "saat sedang sangat aktif/agresif".
Item 3: "limbah kotoran mentah" is awkward. Use "limbah tinja/kotoran mentah" or "limbah kotoran yang belum diolah".

anabas-testudineus.name: Ikan Betok
notes: Item 9: "mastacembelid (sidat/belut berduri)": sidat is Anguilla, a different fish. Use "tilan" or "belut duri".
Item 12: "peternakan komersial" for commercial farms: peternakan means livestock. Use "usaha budidaya ikan komersial" or "pembudidaya".
Item 12: "data deficient" is left in English quotes with a gloss. This is acceptable, but "data kurang (data deficient)" would read more naturally.

ancistrus-dolichopterus.name: Starlight bristlenose
notes: Item 4: "Volume is approximately 243 litres (64 US gal)" is rendered as "Volumenya kira-kira 243 liter." This is fine on units. The sentence is accurate.
Item 11: "diberi nomor L L183" is a clumsy duplication. Write "diberi nomor L183" or "nomor-L L183".
Item 12: "hibrida berlapis" for "multiple hybrid" is unnatural and may mislead. Use "hibrida hasil persilangan berulang/berbagai spesies".
Item 12: "Common Bushmouth" and "White Seam Ancistrus" are left as English names in quotation marks. Add a local explanation or keep them consistent with "bristlenose biasa" used elsewhere.
Item 10: "Bertelur di dalam gua" is acceptable, but "anakan" for brood is slightly imprecise. "menjaga telur dan anakan" adds the idea of fry, which the English "brood care" only implies.

Item 12: "Hanya sesekali saja ada individu ... yang memiliki kurang dari 9 jari-jari lunak" is slightly clumsy. Reword it as "Hanya sesekali individu A. dolichopterus memiliki kurang dari 9 jari-jari lunak".
Item 7: "kutu air beku" for frozen Daphnia is non-standard. Use "Daphnia beku" or "kutu air (Daphnia) beku". "pakan kering yang tenggelam" should be "pakan kering tenggelam".
Item 1: "sungai kecil berair hitam" is fine. "lele bristlenose" is acceptable, but hobbyists usually say "pleco" or "ancistrus".

anentome-helena.name: Keong Assassin
notes: "loach atau buntal": acceptable, but could use common Indonesian names, e.g. "ikan botia atau buntal" for loaches.
"belalainya": "trunk" is better rendered as "proboscis"/"belalai" is fine; consider "probosis" only if needed (very minor).

aphyocharax-anisitsi.name: Bloodfin tetra
notes: Item 3: "Ikan ini mungkin menggigiti sirip teman setangki yang bersirip panjang atau gerakannya lambat" is ambiguous. Say "teman setangki yang bersirip panjang atau berenang lambat".
Item 8: "paling tampak betah" is awkward. Use "paling cocok/tampak paling betah".
Items 3, 11, 14: "teman setangki" is slightly stiff. "Penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain" is more natural.
Item 14: "bertenaga aerator" for "air-powered" is imprecise. Use "digerakkan udara dari aerator".
Item 14: "burayak" is correct but "hasilnya sampai beberapa ratus ekor burayak" is wordy. Simplify to "beberapa ratus ekor burayak".
Item 13: "Para akuaris" and "kesempatan langka" for "unique opportunity" are acceptable. "Fungsi variasi warna" for "purpose" is fine. "Dikromatisme" could use a gloss.
Item 4: "si Bloodfin tetra" adds a colloquial tone not in the source. Use "yaitu Bloodfin tetra".
Item 12: "sirip anusnya" is stiff. "Sirip dubur" is the usual term.
Item 13: "sirip anus" has the same problem. Use "sirip dubur".

apteronotus-albifrons.name: Black Ghost
notes: Item 14: "akhirnya kurus lalu mati" adds "lalu mati" (and dies). The English only says "wastes away", so use "menjadi kurus" or "semakin kurus".
Item 3: "bisa lecet karena bergesekan atau bertengkar" adds "bergesekan" (rubbing). The English "get into scrapes" only means getting into fights or trouble. Use "berkelahi" or "terluka".

Item 19: "pengalaman yang ada tidak menunjukkan hal itu" is vague and stilted. Use something like "hal itu tidak sesuai dengan pengalaman penulis/pemelihara", or the neutral "menurut pengalaman, hal itu tidak benar".
Item 2: "Dari pengalaman, ikan ini bisa tumbuh..." has no subject for the experience. Say "Menurut pengalaman pemelihara" so the sentence reads naturally.

apteronotus-leptorhynchus.name: Brown Ghost Knifefish
notes: "rutin diimpor" for "regularly stocked": slightly shifts meaning (stocked = available in shops). Consider "rutin tersedia" or "rutin dijual".
"Apteronotus leptorhynchus berwarna keemasan" with no article or noun: reads awkwardly. Consider "seekor Apteronotus leptorhynchus ..." or add "ikan".

astronotus-ocellatus.name: Ikan Oscar
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: 35 cm SL' / 'mencapai 35 cm SL' – 350 mm = 35 cm is correct, no issue; but see other items.
Item 12: 'cacing sutra' for tubifex is acceptable, but 'karnivora sejati' for 'serious carnivores' is fine; main issue: 'Oscar sangat menuntut kualitas kimia air' is okay.
Item 14: 'pastikan tetap memilih jenis-jenis dari Amerika Selatan juga' is slightly awkward; better 'pilih hanya jenis dari Amerika Selatan'.
Item 17: 'enam ekor anakan atau lebih' – 'half-a-dozen or more' fine; 'burayak' for fry is acceptable but 'benih' is more common among hobbyists.

Item 18: 'dibuahi oleh jantan dengan berenang di atasnya' – original says male swims over to fertilize; acceptable. 'Oscar bisa pilih-pilih dalam memilih pasangan' is repetitive; use 'sangat selektif dalam memilih pasangan'.
Item 19: 'bersifat kamuflase' for 'cryptic' colour pattern is fine but inconsistent with 'kriptik' used elsewhere; 'tribus dugaan' is awkward, use 'tribus yang diduga (putative)'.
Item 2: 'Area berenang: Atas dan tengah' ok; the source 'Minimum tank size 65 gallons (about 250 litres)' conversion: 65 US gal ≈ 246 L, OK.
Item 18: '100 gallon (about 380 litres)' fine.
Item 12: 'cacing darah' for bloodworms fine; but 'Meskipun sebagian orang menyarankan... pakan hidup' fine. Item 3: 'Populasi liar hasil introduksi' fine.
Item 6: Omitted the US gallon conversion — fine per instructions.

astyanax-mexicanus.name: Blind Cave Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the source says only "in the evening" ("pada malam hari").
Item 10: "Biasanya mereka sudah memijah" adds "Biasanya" (usually), which softens the source's "They should have spawned". Use "Mereka seharusnya sudah memijah".
Items 5 and 10: "setup" is left as English. "Penataan akuarium" or "set-up" would be more natural.

atractosteus-spatula.name: Ikan aligator
notes: #2: "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" is redundant. Use "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" -> "hingga ke negara bagian Veracruz di selatan".

#8: "ikan yang tidak agresif dengan ukuran serupa yang tidak muat di mulutnya" is ambiguous because of the stacked "yang". Rephrase, e.g. "ikan non-agresif berukuran serupa yang terlalu besar untuk muat di mulutnya".

atyopsis-moluccensis.name: Udang bambu
notes: Item 2: "finely grated dry food" translated as "pakan kering yang dihaluskan" - acceptable, but "cyclops beku" could be clarified as "cyclops beku" (fine); "partikel melayang" for "floating material" is fine.
Item 3: "kipas tangannya" ("hand fans") is awkward; use "kipas di capitnya" or "kipas capit". Also "capit" for "claws" and "kaki jalan" are okay, but "ujung ... kaki jalan" for "end limbs" is vague.
Item 3: "diam di tempat yang berarus" is slightly awkward; better "menempatkan diri di aliran arus".
Item 5: "cukup merepotkan" is weaker than "connected with some expenditure" (butuh biaya/upaya cukup besar); consider "memerlukan upaya dan biaya tertentu".
Item 1/3: "Moluccan mountain rock shrimp" and "Gabon giant fan shrimp" left in English; consider adding Indonesian names (e.g., "udang kipas raksasa Gabon") with English in brackets.

auriglobus-modestus.name: Buntal Emas
notes: "Pernah ada kiriman" / "Belakangan baru diketahui": fine in meaning, but "A shipment ... was received" implies the shop received it; consider "Kiriman ... diterima" for fidelity."
"ikan lele-lelean (catfish)": catfish is simply "lele" or "ikan lele/catfish"; "lele-lelean" is misleading since many catfish are not true lele."
"ikan sili (spiny eel)": "sili" is not a standard hobby term; use "spiny eel" or "tilan" (Mastacembelus)."
"ikan pisau (knifefish)": hobbyists usually say "knifefish" or "ikan pisau/belida"; acceptable but check consistency."
"Yang berlaku terhadap spesies ikan lain juga berlaku terhadap sesama jenisnya": awkward; better "Hal yang sama berlaku terhadap sesama buntal emas."
"kurang ajar" for "insolent" is too harsh/colloquial; use "lancang" or "agresif"."
"bukan pemilih pakan": "food specialists" means specialised feeders; better "bukan pemakan spesialis".

babylonia-spirata.name: Keong macan
notes: Item 1: 'Nama: keong macan (Babylonian snail)' adds a local name not in the source; 'Tiger snail' appears only in a reference title. Verify it is an established name for Babylonia spirata, or use 'keong babilonia'.
Item 9: 'frozen brine and mysis shrimp' is rendered 'artemia beku'. 'Brine shrimp' is Artemia, so this is acceptable, but 'udang mysis beku' reads as a separate item. Write 'artemia dan mysis beku'.
Item 9: 'freeze-dried larvae' is rendered 'larva kering beku (freeze-dried)'. This is awkward. Use 'larva serangga/jentik beku-kering (freeze-dried)', or say which larvae.
Item 9: 'Keong pemakan bangkai ... sangat peka' is fine, but 'Kalsium dibutuhkan untuk beberapa proses hidup yang vital' is stiff. Use 'sejumlah proses kehidupan penting'.

Item 10: 'Pada umumnya mereka adalah keong whelk predator yang memakan hewan yang berada di pasir' is clumsy and mixes 'mereka' with 'keong ini'. Use 'keong whelk pemangsa yang memakan hewan di dalam pasir'.
Item 10: 'cocok dengan sebagian besar penghuni lain' for 'compatible with most tankmates' is acceptable. 'Teman satu akuarium' is stiff, so consider 'penghuni lain' or 'tankmate'.
Item 12: 'Kawin' as a heading and 'Perkawinan tidak bergantung pada waktu' are fine. 'Setelah menetap di dasar' adds 'di dasar' (on the bottom), which is not in 'After settlement'. Remove it.
Item 12: 'Akuarium pembesaran harus memiliki parameter air yang sama' is ambiguous. Say 'sama dengan akuarium induk'.
