notes: Item 11: "goby 'bumblebee'" – word order is slightly unnatural; "goby bumblebee" without quotes, or keep "bumblebee goby", would read more naturally.
Item 10: "dengan cara tertentu" for "somehow" is vague; "dengan cara apa pun" or "perlu diberi pemberat" would be cleaner.

brachygobius-mekongensis.name: Mekong Bumblebee Goby
notes: Item 2: 'between bridge at between bridge at Muang Kengkok' duplication in source was silently fixed; fine, but 'Provinsi Nongkhai ... Thailand timur laut' ok. No issue.
Item 5: 'jangan pernah dimasukkan ke akuarium baru yang belum matang (belum siklus nitrogen)' adds explanatory content; 'belum siklus nitrogen' is awkward, use 'belum tersiklus'.
Item 10: 'meskipun gambar ditetapkan pada profil' is awkward/unclear for 'we've assigned images to profiles'; rephrase e.g. 'foto dicocokkan dengan profil'.
Item 10: 'spesies lain pernah dijumpai dijual dengan label nama ini' is slightly awkward; the neutral phrasing should be 'spesies lain pernah ditemukan dijual dengan label nama ini'.
Item 3: 'temporal swamps' rendered as 'rawa musiman' is fine, but 'lahan basah yang masih alami' for 'undisturbed marshland' loses 'marsh'; use 'rawa yang belum terganggu'.
Item 10: 'tidak bersisik' for 'naked' opercle/nape fine, but 'kadang tanpa sisik' for opercle in B. nunus is fine; 'gurat sisi di kepala' should be 'sistem garis rusuk (gurat sisi) kepala' - minor.
Item 9: 'betina yang sedang mengandung telur' acceptable; 'burayak' OK. No issue.
Item 8: 'agresi tersebar ke beberapa individu' is stiff; use 'agresi terbagi ke banyak ikan'.

brachygobius-sabanus.name: Bumblebee Goby
notes: "Kalimantan bagian timur laut" (items 1 and 2) for Sabah is geographically wrong. Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part of Borneo, and Sabah is in Malaysia. Use "Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo) bagian timur laut" or "Borneo bagian timur laut".
Item 10: "supaya tidak mengapung" adds a reason that the source doesn't give ("weighed down somehow"). Say only "perlu diberi pemberat".

brachygobius-xanthomelas.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "Dengan jumlah segitu" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu".
"foto online" could be the more standard "foto di internet" or "foto daring".

brachygobius-xanthozonus.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "selalu ternyata B. doriae atau B. sabanus" (items 1 and 4) is awkward word order. Use "ternyata selalu B. doriae atau B. sabanus" or "selalu berupa B. doriae atau B. sabanus".
"bumblebee goby" is left in English in items 1 and 4. This is acceptable as a trade name, but you could add an Indonesian gloss such as "ikan gobi lebah" on first mention.
"Max size ... (1.5 in SL)" was dropped in item 1. This is fine, since 38 mm is the metric value.

breitensteinia-cessator.name: Breitensteinia cessator
notes: "punggung adiposa yang rendah dan panjang" for "long low adipose ridge": "punggung" reads as the back, not a ridge. Use "lunas/rigi adiposa" or "lipatan lemak yang rendah dan panjang".
"Belum ada laporan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan." is repetitive. It is faithful to the source, but could be smoothed to "Belum ada laporan pemijahan."

breitensteinia-insignis.name: Breitensteinia insignis
notes: Item 3: "jari-jari keras sirip dubur: 0" is fine, but "Dibedakan dari spesies lain dalam genusnya" is slightly wordy; "kongenerik" could be used. Minor only.
Item 3: "kurang lebih berbercak ungu tua" is slightly awkward; consider "agak berbintik-bintik ungu tua".

brevibora-cheeya.name: Brevibora cheeya
notes: Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but the English gives the volume as only a rough figure alongside the dimensions. 80 × 30 cm with no height stated cannot give 72 L. This is a source issue, so mention it only if the translator was meant to flag it.

Item 8: "does not compete well with much larger or more boisterous species" is translated as "lebih agresif" (more aggressive). "Boisterous" means rowdy or lively, not aggressive, so use "lebih lincah/heboh".
Item 11: "Several years prior to its description" is rendered as if the species were the one described. Fine. But "lokasi yang samar" for "vague locality" is awkward; use "lokasi yang tidak jelas".
Item 5: "common beech or oak" is left as "beech atau oak" with no explanation. Add the local context, e.g. "kayu beech (Fagus) atau oak (ek)", or advise on locally available hardwoods.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan" has a broken sentence structure. Change it to "tanaman seperti Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, dan Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan".
Item 11: "larger head and prepectoral length" is rendered "kepala dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar". Use "kepala lebih panjang dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan spesies" is fine. However, "temannya setangki lainnya dibiarkan" is awkward; use "tidak mengganggu penghuni lain".

brevibora-dorsiocellata.name: Rasbora Eyespot
notes: Item 10: the English gives 72–78°F (about 22–26°C). The conversion is fine, but 'Suhu: sekitar 22–26 °C' is OK. No fix is needed here.
Item 16: 'ikan jantan akan menampilkan warna terbaiknya karena saling bersaing' is fine. 'kurang gugup' is awkward, so use 'kurang mudah stres/takut'.
Item 9: 'kayu beech atau oak' leaves the English names. Use 'kayu bukit/beech (Fagus) atau ek'. 'setup' could be 'penataan'.
Item 18: 'Pakan awal sebaiknya Paramecium' is OK. 'menyebar telur, bertelur secara terus-menerus' is clumsy, so use 'penyebar telur yang memijah berkelanjutan'.
Item 4: the translation is omitted. The stocklist code 451802 and the wholesale-only note are shop talk and may be dropped, so this is acceptable.
Item 15: 'Teman satu akuarium' is fine, but 'rakus saat makan' for 'aggressive eaters' could be 'agresif saat makan'.
Item 7: 'rawa gambut hutan purba' is acceptable. 'khasnya memiliki' is awkward, so use 'umumnya/biasanya memiliki'.
Item 5: 'akuarium habitatnya' is awkward. Use 'habitat (akuarium) sudah siap'.
Item 3: 'ikan siprinid' is a little stiff, but it is understandable. 'ikan hasil tangkapan alam' is fine.

camposcia-retusa.name: Kepiting Dekorator
notes: Item 2: the English says the crabs "may simply miss the food you give them". The Indonesian "pakan yang Anda berikan terlewat oleh mereka" is acceptable, but "Karena mereka tidak banyak bergerak" for "not very mobile" is fine too. The wording "kurang cocok" is okay.

Item 12: "larvae normally hatch overnight, occasionally in the early morning" became "menjelang pagi", which is acceptable. However, "Waktu mencapai dewasa" for "Maturity" is fine. "Uneaten food was removed" is fine.
Item 13: the English "Superfamily: Majidae" is given as "Superfamili: Majidae". Majidae is a family, but this mirrors the source, so keep it. "Subfilum: Crustacea" mirrors the source too.
Item 13: "Rostrum: the head is broad, slightly deflexed anteriorly, with an emarginated anterior edge". "bertakik" for "emarginated" is loose but acceptable.
Item 8: "seagrass leaves" became "helaian daun lamun", which is fine. "Decor should replicate" is fine.
Item 10: "Social: no" became "Hidup berkelompok: tidak". This is acceptable.
Item 12: the Indonesian keeps the awkward "Kelangsungan hidup zoea ... pada salinitas 35 dan 38" (as in the source). It also keeps "NH4+/NH3 dan NO2", which is fine.
Item 3: "Cape Grenville dan Port Denison" are left untranslated. Consider "Tanjung Grenville", but this is a minor point.

carassius-auratus.name: Ikan mas koki
notes: Item 1: "Varian ikan mas koki" drops "We received ... from China" nuance; also "koki" and "mas koki" are used inconsistently for goldfish. Minor.
Item 4: translation is left out entirely (the stocklist code 808202 and the wholesale-only note). This is shop talk, so dropping it is allowed.
Item 7: "koki komet asli berasal dari ikan Crucian carp" – the Crucian carp should have an Indonesian name or at least be explained (ikan mas karper/Crucian carp). "tidak ada di alam" is acceptable.
Item 11: "Salinitas: tetap tumbuh baik hingga 6‰" – "good growth up to 6‰" is rendered loosely. "Tahan suhu tinggi" is fine.
Item 14: "pemakan dasar" is fine, but "kutu air (moina)" is acceptable. "Feeding every day should be roughly 2%" is ok. No serious errors.

Item 17: "Zebrafish" is rendered "Ikan zebra", yet the text says "zebra danio"; use "zebra danio" consistently. "Mas koki bertubuh panjang ... mereka bisa lebih cepat" is slightly vague (outpace in swimming).
Item 20: "Betina sebagian besar matang kelamin pada tahun ke-2" is awkward; use "umumnya matang pada tahun kedua".
Item 3: "Bertelur" for "Egg layer" is fine; "Top and mid-dweller" is OK.

Item 13: "Gunakan kerikil halus dan membulat" – English says "smooth, rounded", but "halus" may be read as fine-grained, which conflicts with "large enough not to be swallowed". Use "licin" or "mulus".
Item 15: "gigi geraham" for goldfish pharyngeal molars is imprecise; "gigi faring" is more accurate. Also "mas koki" and "koki" used inconsistently.

caridina-multidentata.name: Udang Amano
notes: Item 8: "feromon pemijahan" for "breeding hormone" – the source says hormone; "feromon" is a technically different term, so use "hormon pemijahan" or keep the source wording.
Item 9: "Saat gelisah atau tegang" for "When excited" – adds a nuance; the source has a slightly different meaning (excited/stressed). Consider "saat terstimulasi/stres".
Item 9: "membongkar kiriman udang" – "unpack the animals" is better as "membuka kemasan udang"; "membongkar kiriman" is awkward.

Item 6: "Garis di punggung itu bisa memiliki garis putih polos" is repetitive/awkward; also "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" for "tankmates" is clumsy, use "penghuni akuarium lainnya" or "teman satu akuarium".
Item 6: "tembus pandang, berwarna cokelat atau cokelat muda" – "tan" is better as "cokelat keabu-abuan/krem"; and "Udang kecil yang renyah tidak boleh menjadi santapan" is a bit stiff.
Item 1: "Umur" for "Life expectancy" should be "Harapan hidup" or "Usia hidup"; the bracketed imperial conversions were dropped, which is acceptable.
Item 4: "Hanya karena udang amano suka membersihkan akuarium" loses "for a living" and the rendering is stiff; "kualitas kimia air" is an odd rendering of "water chemistry" (use "parameter air").

Item 3: "Aslinya hidup di rawa air tawar, krustasea ini baru belakangan masuk" – ungrammatical subject structure; fix to "Aslinya hidup di rawa air tawar, krustasea ini baru-baru ini diperkenalkan ke hobi akuarium".

caridina-pareparensis-parvidentata.name: Udang Pareparensis
notes: "berkembang biaknya sangat produktif" is slightly awkward; better "berkembang biak dengan sangat produktif" or "sangat mudah berkembang biak".
"Dalam semua kondisi ini udang ini tetap hidup" repeats "udang ini"; use "Pada semua kondisi tersebut, udang ini tetap hidup...".

"terkenal karena warnanya yang cerah, tapi juga terkenal susah dirawat" is a bit colloquial and drops the sense of "notorious" and "high demands on care"; consider "dikenal berwarna-warni namun terkenal menuntut perawatan tinggi".
"hobiis" is non-standard; use "penghobi" or "hobiis akuarium" in a more natural form.
"Pembiakannya sangat produktif" is stiff; use "Udang ini berkembang biak dengan sangat produktif".

carinotetraodon-travancoricus.name: Pea puffer
notes: #24: both daphnia and moina are rendered "kutu air", so the two cannot be told apart. Use "kutu air (daphnia)" and "moina", or "kutu air" and "kutu air moina".
#32: "yang membatasi bintik-bintik kuning keemasan" is imprecise for "which mark the shining golden yellow spots". Better: "yang menandai" or "di sekitar bintik...".
#29: "Pea puffer bisa cukup jorok" is colloquial for "messy". "banyak menghasilkan kotoran" is more natural.

cephalocassis-melanochir.name: Ikan duri
notes: Item 1: "Famili" is acceptable, though "Famili" vs "Suku" is a minor choice; consider "Suku (Family)".
Item 4: "Pemijahan" is fine; "Breeding: Unreported" could also be "Belum dilaporkan" (minor).

ceratoglanis-scleronema.name: Ceratoglanis scleronema
notes: Item 1: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" – the IUCN Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah"/"Risiko Rendah"; acceptable but check consistency. Leave as is if the glossary uses it.
Item 1: "sungut maksila yang kaku dan bengkok seperti kait" – "hooked" is rendered with redundant phrasing; simplify to "kaku dan membengkok/berkait".
Item 2: "rentan terhadap syok" is slightly awkward; "sangat sensitif terhadap guncangan/stres (syok)" would read more naturally.
Item 7: "kerabat segenusnya" is awkward; use "satu-satunya spesies lain dalam genus yang sama".

chaca-bankanensis.name: Chocolate frogmouth catfish
notes: Item 1: "Chocolate frogmouth catfish" and "oddball" left in English; consider a local term or add a gloss, e.g. "ikan unik/aneh (oddball)".
Item 11: "lele ini" for the catfish is a loose rendering; "ikan ini" or "lele Chaca" would be clearer. Chaca is not a true lele.
Item 11: "suara seperti dengkuran" (snoring) for a grunting sound; "suara menggerutu/mendengus" is closer.
Item 5: "ranting beech" is a literal rendering; add a gloss such as "ranting pohon beech (Fagus)" or use a more common term.
Item 8: "sangat predator" is awkward; use "predator yang sangat ganas" or "bersifat predator kuat".
Item 10: "berkembang biak" is fine, but "pemijahan" in the same sentence is mixed; use one consistent term.

chaca-chaca.name: Frogmouth catfish
notes: Item 8: "It can however be kept with others of its own kind with no problems" is rendered as a plain statement, but the Indonesian drops the contrast with "however". Add "namun" or "meski begitu" to restore it.
Item 11: "unsuitable subjects for the general aquarist" is rendered "bukan ikan untuk penghobi akuarium pada umumnya". This is acceptable but weakens the meaning. Use "tidak cocok untuk".
Item 11: "oddball" is left in English with no gloss. Write "ikan unik/aneh (oddball)".
Item 1 and item 11: "angler catfish" is left untranslated. This is acceptable as a trade name but could be glossed, e.g. "lele pemancing (angler catfish)".
Item 1: "Ukuran mangsanya bisa hampir sebesar tubuhnya sendiri" is fine. However, "lure prey, which can be almost as big as itself" is split into separate sentences, which is acceptable.

Item 5: "beech" and "oak" are left in English. Use "pohon beech/ek", or explain them as leaves of a temperate tree such as ketapang or similar. Also use "tahan banting" for "tolerant" only if plants are hardy. Better is "tanaman yang toleran".
Item 11: "acid-containing secretion" is rendered "lendir yang mengandung asam". "Lendir" (mucus) adds a specific meaning. Use "sekresi/cairan yang mengandung asam".
Item 3: "both large and small bodies of water" is fine. No change is needed here beyond the minor point that "amongst" is rendered naturally.
Item 10: "3" diameter tubing" is converted to "sekitar 7,5 cm". This is correct. "Presumably" is rendered "Kemungkinan", which is acceptable, but "Diduga" is closer.

channa-andrao.name: Channa Andrao
notes: "terkenal jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "terkenal pandai meloloskan diri".
"ikan pakan hidup seperti ikan beranak": "feeder fish" would read more clearly as "ikan umpan/ikan pakan"; "hidup" is not in the source.
"tidak dapat dicerna dengan baik" for "cannot be properly metabolised": "dimetabolisme" is closer.

channa-asiatica.name: Channa asiatica
notes: Item 8: "Atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, merupakan kompleks spesies..." is a sentence fragment. Join it to the previous sentence, e.g. "...banyak varian, atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, kompleks spesies...".
Item 8: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off for fish. "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 4: "Parameter air tidak berpengaruh" is a bit loose for "irrelevant". "tidak penting" or "tidak menjadi masalah" would be more natural.

channa-aurantimaculata.name: Channa Auranti
notes: Item 4: "tidak segeneralis banyak spesies Channa lain secara ekologis" is stiff. Something like "kurang bersifat generalis secara ekologis dibanding banyak spesies Channa lain" would read more naturally.
Item 8: "Predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is understandable but not the usual term. "Karnivora obligat" or "pemangsa murni" would be clearer.

channa-bankanensis.name: Channa bankanensis
notes: "jenis channa" for "snakehead species" is fine, but consider "ikan channa (snakehead)" for consistency; minor.
"Pada tahap ini kamuflase dibutuhkan" is slightly stiff; consider "Pada tahap ini kamuflase menjadi penting".
"Anakan Channa" mixes capitalised genus with a lowercase "channa" elsewhere; use consistent casing ("anakan channa").

channa-bleheri.name: Channa Bleheri
notes: Item 8: "jantung sapi atau ayam" could be read as chicken heart; say "daging ayam" or "daging sapi (jantung) atau daging ayam".
Item 10: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; "saat sedang bunting telur" or "saat membawa telur" is better.

Item 12: Several terms are left in English, such as "isthmus", "hypurapophysis", "urostyle", "epibranchial" and "branchial". Add Indonesian forms (e.g. "tulang epibrankial", "pelat gigi brankial") or put them in italics.

channa-gachua.name: Channa gachua
notes: Item 12: 'northeastern India' was translated as 'India timur laut', which is acceptable. The real problem is 'Greater Sunda Islands' → 'Kepulauan Sunda Besar', which is fine, so it is not listed.

Item 12: 'sides of body without numerous black spots' → 'sisi tubuh tanpa banyak bintik hitam' is acceptable. But 'The second-last point' → 'Poin kedua dari terakhir' refers to the wrong item because the list was reordered. Check that it still points to 'no bars on upper portion of body'.

Item 12: 'Ruang inilah yang memungkinkan ikan menghirup udara... di air miskin oksigen' is fine. However, 'pelat kepala' for 'cephalic plates' and 'sisik epidermis' are unclear. Use 'sisik kulit (pelat kepala)'.

Item 8: 'Predator sejati (obligat)' is awkward. Use 'predator obligat'. 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'cepat beradaptasi' adds 'cepat' (quickly), which is not in the source ('adapting well'). Use 'dapat beradaptasi dengan baik'.
Item 8: 'ikan umpan hidup (feeder)' is slightly off for 'feeder fish'. Use 'ikan pakan (feeder)'.
Item 5: '243 litres (64 US gal)' → the translation dropped the gallon figure, which is allowed. However, 'Volume yang disebutkan' is vague. Use 'Volume yang dianjurkan'.
Item 2: 'pandai kabur dari akuarium' is a bit colloquial for 'notorious for their ability to escape'. Use 'terkenal sering lolos'.
Item 9: 'galak terhadap sesama spesies lainnya' is awkward. Use 'agresif terhadap ikan sejenis lainnya'.
Item 10: 'sirip dubur' is non-standard. Hobbyists use 'sirip anal'. 'sedang mengandung telur' is acceptable, but 'bunting' is not used for fish.

channa-marulioides.name: Channa Marulioides
notes: Item 11: 'feeder fish ... livebearers or small goldfish' translated as 'ikan umpan hidup'; 'ikan mas koki kecil' is redundant/wrong (goldfish = 'ikan mas koki' or 'koki'); also 'tend not have high nutritional value' is OK, but fix the goldfish term.
Item 11: 'dried foods ... should never form the staple diet' rendered 'jangan sampai dijadikan pakan utama' loses 'never' strength; use 'tidak boleh sama sekali dijadikan pakan utama'.
Item 14: 'chevron' described as 'huruf V' then kept as 'chevron'; fine, but 'gurat sisi ke-17-20' ambiguous; use 'sisik gurat sisi ke-17 sampai 20'.
Item 14: 'DAS Mekong' for 'Mekong basin' OK; but 'danau-sungai' for 'riverine lake system' is awkward; use 'sistem danau paparan banjir/sungai'.
Item 6/14: 'Danau Sentarum ... in Kalimantan, Borneo' drops 'Borneo' - minor omission.
Item 14: 'Kalimantan' for 'Indonesian Borneo' drops 'Indonesian' nuance; use 'Kalimantan, Indonesia'.
Item 7: 'tenggelam' in quotes for 'lost' is a bit odd; use 'terlihat hilang/kecil sekali' ('mudah stres karena kurang terlindungi' not stated; avoid adding).
Item 1: 'Kemungkinan besar ikan ini bisa tumbuh sebesar C. marulius' changes 'likely to have the potential' slightly; and 'relationship of' = 'kelompok' rather than 'kerabat'.
Item 2: 'hidup di kolom air terbuka (pelagis)' is an interpretive expansion; just 'pelagis'.

channa-pleurophthalma.name: Channa Pleuro
notes: Item 6: "sehingga tidak perlu ganti air secara rutin" adds a causal link and narrows "regular maintenance" to water changes only. Use "dan tidak memerlukan perawatan rutin" to match the source more closely.
Item 3: "Kalimantan, Indonesia" drops "Indonesian Borneo". Consider "Kalimantan, Borneo Indonesia".
Item 8: "ikan mas koki kecil" for "small goldfish" is too specific, since the English means ordinary feeder goldfish. Use "ikan mas kecil" or "goldfish kecil".
Item 6: "jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "terkenal pandai melompat keluar/meloloskan diri".

channa-stewartii.name: Channa Stewartii
notes: "Selain ikan hidup maupun ikan mati": awkward; better "Selain ikan hidup maupun mati" or "ikan hidup dan ikan mati".", ""mau makan pelet stik": source says "sticks" (food sticks); "pelet stik" is fine but "pelet" is an added specificity, consider "stik pakan".", ""Channa ini" in sentence 1: "This snakehead" is better rendered as "Ikan bandotan/gabus" or "Snakehead ini"; "Channa ini" is slightly vague but acceptable.", ""Karena habitat aslinya tidak berada di wilayah tropis": fine meaning, but "tidak berada di wilayah tropis" could be more natural as "bukan di daerah tropis".", ""pengeram mulut": common hobby term is "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram telur di mulut"; consider "ikan pengerami mulut".

cherax-boesemani.name: Lobster Blue Moon
notes: Item 4: "Irian Jaya (Papua Barat)" – the English says West New Guinea; "Papua Barat" is a wrong gloss, so use "Irian Jaya (Nugini Barat)".

Item 2: "tidak dilarang di wilayah Anda" – the English says "state"; "negara bagian/wilayah" is acceptable, but "Florida ... ported" was rendered as "dibawa masuk"; check that this matches the intended "imported/transported" meaning.

Item 1: "Blue Papuan crayfish, Rainbow crayfish, Supernova crayfish, Blue Marble crayfish" – the other names were left in English with no Indonesian equivalent, so add "lobster" forms or italic marking for consistency.
Item 6: "Jangan buang kulit bekas molting" – it is fine, but add that the crayfish eat it to recover calcium. This is a minor omission only if the context requires it.
Item 8: "tempat yang sempit dan pas dengan tubuhnya" – 'tight-fitting' is rendered with extra wording; 'hanya filter gantung ... yang cocok' is fine.
Item 7: "Suhu: 24–31 °C" – fine, but "jadi makin kurang aktif" is slightly awkward; use "semakin tidak aktif".
Item 12: "Anakan suka bersembunyi dan hampir selalu tersembunyi" is repetitive; use "Anakan pemalu dan sebagian besar waktunya bersembunyi".

Item 5: "20-gallon long" was converted to "sekitar 80 liter" and "akuarium memanjang" – the conversion is fine (~76 L), but the term 'long' as a tank format is dropped from the number context; check that this is consistent.
Item 4: "Nama spesiesnya diambil dari Dr. Marinus Boeseman" – fine, but 'first collected it' should be "yang pertama kali mengoleksinya"; the subject is ambiguous.

Item 10: "Meski ukurannya besar" – 'Despite their size' should be tied to the crayfish with "Meski berukuran besar"; also "teman setangki yang buruk" is a calque, so use "Tidak cocok dipelihara bersama".

cherax-holthuisi.name: Lobster Apricot
notes: Item 5: "(bisa sambil diaerasi)" is not in the English; delete it or keep to the source's "Diamkan air selama beberapa hari".
Item 3: "tersembunyi di bawah tanah" and the added sentence "hidup di dalam liang" expand "lives underground". Use something like "hidup di bawah tanah, bukan di tempat terbuka".

cherax-pulcher.name: Lobster Pulcher
notes: Item 12: "khawatir jika Lukhaup membawanya pergi" names the author/researcher where the English says "he"; fine to keep as a pronoun like "ia". Use "jika ia membawanya".
Item 12: "kemerahmudaan" is non-standard/awkward for "pinkish". Use "merah muda keputihan" or "merah jambu pucat".
Item 1/12: "Pembiakan: sedang hingga sulit" conflicts with the text saying it is not difficult; this follows the source, but "Pembiakan" in the spec list is fine. No change needed beyond consistency.
Item 7: "tidak cocok dipelihara dengan tanaman" is a loose rendering of "not plant safe". Use "tidak aman bagi tanaman".
Item 9: "tidak hidup berkelompok" is slightly off for "not social". Use "tidak bersifat sosial".
Item 11: "sangat tertutup" is unnatural for "very secretive". Use "sangat pemalu/suka menyembunyikan diri".

Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya sudah matang" is fine, but "aklimatisasi" is okay; "pipa paralon (PVC)" is okay. Minor: "anggota tubuhnya" in item 11 is vague for appendages. Use "kaki renang (pleopoda)".

chilatherina-bleheri.name: Rainbow Bleheri
notes: "Endangered" (Terancam): Indonesian IUCN term is "Terancam Punah"; use "Terancam Punah (Endangered)".
"Daftar Merah Spesies Terancam Internasional": standard name is "Daftar Merah IUCN" / "Daftar Merah Spesies Terancam IUCN"; phrasing is awkward.
"Penangkapan ... tidak berperan, apalagi semua ikan...": "apalagi" is slightly off; "terlebih lagi karena" is more natural.
"sudah dikoleksi pertama kali": use "pertama kali dikoleksi pada tahun 1982"; "sudah" is a slight mistranslation of "as early as"; use "sedini tahun 1982".
"Pakan: omnivora": fine, but "ikan damai yang hidup bergerombol" is okay; "Irian Jaya" is now Papua, which is optional to add.

chitala-blanci.name: Royal Knifefish
notes: Item 4: 'Mekong hulu, Kamboja utara' is fine, but item 3 is not: the English lists 'Thailand, Laos, and Cambodia' and the ID matches, so no change needed there. The real problem is in item 5: 'perairan berarus kuat' is fine.

Item 12: 'Terhadap sesama jenis dan teman satu akuarium yang tidak bisa dimangsa, ikan belida sangat damai' is acceptable, but 'Chitala' is translated inconsistently as 'ikan belida' here and elsewhere. Use 'belida' consistently, and give the common name 'Asian featherback' where it is used.
Item 1: 'sirip punggung berkembang baik' is stiff; use 'sirip punggung yang berkembang baik'.
Item 8: 'kayu rendam' for driftwood is non-standard; use 'kayu apung' or 'driftwood'. 'aliran/sirkulasi' should be one term.
Item 11: 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'kebanyakan bisa beradaptasi dengan baik dengan pakan mati' reads awkwardly (double 'dengan'). Rephrase it.
Item 11: 'predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' is acceptable, but 'obligate' means it must feed on animal prey. Consider 'predator obligat'.
Item 18: the 'Text & photos' byline is dropped, which is correct. No fix needed.
Item 16: 'memijah di atas batu' is OK. 'Pada musim kawin' should be 'musim pemijahan' for fish.

chitala-ornata.name: Clown Knife
notes: Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" - 'small goldfish' as feeder; 'ikan mas koki' is redundant/awkward, use "ikan mas koki" or "koki kecil" consistently.
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" for 'feeder fish' is loose; prefer "ikan pakan (feeder)".
Items 1/11: "leucistic" left in English; use "leusistik" or add a local term.
Items 1/11: "dikembangkan lewat penangkaran selektif khusus untuk pasar ini" - 'line-bred for the purpose' is slightly over-interpreted; use "dikembangbiakkan secara line-breeding untuk tujuan itu".
Item 11: "populer tanpa alasan yang jelas" - 'inexplicably' fine, but "sirip anal ... menyatu dengan sirip ekor" OK; "Notopterid" could be glossed as "ikan famili Notopteridae".
Item 7: "Predator sejati" for 'obligate predator' is acceptable but "predator obligat" is more precise; sentence "mau menerima ... juga pelet kering" is slightly clumsy.
Item 6: Fahrenheit dropped, which is fine; no issue.
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" - hobbyists say "kayu driftwood" or "bogwood"; "kayu apung" means floating wood and may mislead.

chromobotia-macracanthus.name: Botia
notes: Item 1: "Ovipar/memijah" for "Spawners" is slightly awkward; "Pemijah telur" or "Ovipar" alone would read more naturally.
Item 3: "beberapa sentimeter" is vague for "a few inches"; a rounded figure such as "sekitar 5–8 cm" would be clearer.

clarias-batrachus.name: Lele kampung
notes: Items 2 and 12: "leucistic" is left in English. Give an Indonesian term or gloss, for example "leusistik (albino parsial)".
Items 2 and 6: "jago sekali kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use something like "pandai meloloskan diri".
Item 3: "Yang sudah pasti, ikan ini hanya diketahui dari..." is awkward. Use "Hanya diketahui dengan pasti dari daerah aliran sungai di Jawa".
Item 2: "sangat predator" is a little unnatural. Use "sangat bersifat predator" or "pemangsa yang ganas".

clarias-insolitus.name: Clarias insolitus
notes: Item 1: "Etimologi... chlaros ... lincah atau penuh semangat" is fine, but "Pengucapan: klar ee ass" is left as an English phonetic respelling. Consider giving an Indonesian-friendly pronunciation, or mark it as an English-style guide.
Item 1: "Data Deficient atau kekurangan data" is clumsy. The standard Indonesian term is "Kekurangan Data", with (Data Deficient) in brackets.

Item 3: "balashark" for silver shark is acceptable, but "tinfoil barb atau spanner barb" leaves the English trade names as is. Consider "ikan cyprinid" in a more common form such as "cyprinid besar" and check that the local names are consistent.

Item 6: Anatomical terms such as "epibranchial ke-2 dan ke-4", "superbranchial" and "fontanel anterior" are left untranslated. Consider adding Indonesian terms, or put the English in brackets after the Indonesian.

Item 6: Restructuring the text into bullet lists with the added lead-in "Ini ciri-ciri spesies Clarias:" and "Ciri lainnya:" changes the original's single-paragraph format. The content is intact, but this is a format change.
Item 6: "sirip dubur" is acceptable, but hobbyists often say "sirip anal". "Pori-pori saluran sensorik ... membesar" is slightly off for "Hypertrophied" (it means 'hypertrophied/enlarged').

clarias-leiacanthus.name: Lele hutan
notes: Item 3: "mengoleksi spesies ini" is slightly awkward; "mengumpulkan/menangkap spesies ini" is more natural.
Item 3: unit "mg/l" and "mg/L" are inconsistent, as in the source; make them uniform (mg/L).
Item 7: "Teman satu akuarium" is clumsy; "ikan penghuni bersama" or "tankmate" is more usual. "balashark" is a common name, which is fine.
Item 10: "lincah atau hidup" for Greek chlaros ("lively") adds "atau hidup"; use "lincah" only.
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is acceptable but redundant; the English is not needed in brackets.
Item 5: "mudah diterima ikan ini" is slightly stiff; "mudah diterima/dipakai ikan" would be better.

clarias-meladerma.name: Lele hitam
notes: Item 7: "silver sharks" translated as "bala shark" — the English says silver sharks; "tinfoil barb" and "spanner barb" fine, but keep to the source name or use "hiu perak/balashark" consistently. Minor, but "bala shark" differs from the source wording.

Item 1: "Least Concern" rendered as "Risiko Rendah" — IUCN's standard Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kurang Perhatian"; "Risiko Rendah" is the old LR category. Use "Resiko Rendah/Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" accordingly.
Item 1: "chlaros, artinya lincah atau hidup" — the source says only "lively"; remove the added "atau hidup" (added fact).
Item 10: "kadang berbelang bintik-bintik hitam pekat" — "variegated with ... spots" means mottled with spots, not striped; use "kadang bercorak/berbintik-bintik hitam pekat yang tidak beraturan".
Item 3: leftover English anatomical terms "epibranchial" and "superbranchial" are left untranslated; consider "epibrankial" and "ruang suprabrankial" in Indonesian spelling.

Item 6: "Menghuni habitat berair tenang (tidak mengalir)" is fine, but "peats" -> "lahan gambut" and "bogs" -> "rawa" lose the distinction between swamps and bogs ("rawa" is used for both bogs and swamps); use "rawa gambut/payau" distinction e.g. "bog" = "rawa asam".

corydoras-aeneus.name: Corydoras bronze
notes: "Corydoras bronze" / "cory": the common Indonesian hobby name is "corydoras perunggu" or "Bronze Corydoras"; consider keeping it consistent.
"Ikan ini dapat bernapas langsung dari udara (fakultatif)": "fakultatif" in brackets reads awkwardly; better "mampu bernapas dari udara secara fakultatif".
"keping tulang (armoured catfish)" and later "lele berlapis baja"/"berzirah": keep the wording consistent for armoured catfish.
"burayak" is correct but "benih" or "anakan" is more common among hobbyists.
"peternak" for breeders: "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more natural for fish.
"perkawinan sekerabat terseleksi" for line-bred is clumsy; "pembiakan garis keturunan (line breeding)" would be clearer.
"Ikan ini sangat langka" and "hanya tersedia dalam jumlah terbatas" are fine, but "Gold Shoulder" is left in English without explanation; this is acceptable.

corydoras-paleatus.name: Corydoras Paleatus
notes: Item 2: "Imports of this species did not appear for more than 10 years" is rendered "tidak pernah diimpor" (never imported). Use "tidak muncul/tidak ada impor" so the sense of a period without imports stays.
Item 6: "morsels of food" is rendered "sisa makanan" (leftovers). Use "serpihan/remah makanan", because the fish look for food, not scraps.
Item 11: "peternak" (livestock farmer) for breeders is non-standard. Use "pembudidaya" or "penghobi".
Item 1, 4: "kolam-kolam alami" adds "alami" (natural), which is not in the source "pools". Use "kolam" or "genangan".
Item 13: "menyerap oksigen melalui ususnya" and "menyambar udara" are a little loose. Use "menelan/menghirup udara" for "gulp of air".
Item 9: "Lele" for catfish is acceptable, but "cichlid kerdil" is awkward. Use "cichlid dwarf/cichlid kerdil (dwarf cichlid)" or "cichlid kecil".
Item 11: "Kelompok indukan" and "burayak" are fine, but "Corydoras tidak secenderung beberapa ikan lain" is clumsy. Use "Corydoras tidak sesering sebagian ikan lain memakan telurnya".
Item 12: "varian hasil budidaya" for "breeding forms" is fine, but "Ikan veteran" is a literal rendering. Use "ikan lawas/klasik" for naturalness.

corydoras-panda.name: Corydoras panda
notes: Item 10: "half-grown animals" translated as "Ikan yang masih setengah dewasa ini" is okay, but "swarm behaviour" -> "perilaku bergerombol" fine; no fix needed except the kind of fish refers to juveniles: use "ikan remaja" (minor).

Item 13: "burayak tidak akan tersedot" fine, but "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" OK; "Udang cherry ... cukup efektif" for "work well" fine. However "Menyaring air melalui gambut ... akan membantu" fine. Wording "meski bisa sampai 4 butir yang dikeluarkan" is awkward; use "meski kadang sampai 4 butir sekaligus".

Item 13: "Musim ini terjadi bersamaan dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps UK reference, acceptable but for Indonesian readers clarify (e.g., 'musim dingin di belahan bumi utara'); also 'Dapat ... akuarium berdasar kosong' fine.

Item 14: "Ini adalah sistem penomoran yang sangat sederhana" fine; "Namun, asalkan ruangnya cukup, hal ini jarang sampai menimbulkan luka fisik" OK. "penghirup udara fakultatif" is stiff; prefer "mampu bernapas dengan udara bebas bila perlu".
Item 14: "pemakan sisa" for scavengers; "agresi ... nyaris tidak pernah terdengar" is stiff; prefer "hampir tidak pernah terjadi".
Item 9: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable colloquial but "Daphnia" (kutu air) is clearer; "mikroworm" in item 13 should be "cacing mikro" or "microworm" in italics.
Item 2/5: "sungai kecil" for streams fine; "blackwater" left untranslated, consider "air hitam (blackwater)".

corydoras-pygmaeus.name: Corydoras pygmy
notes: Item 7: "Gurami coklat/licorice gourami" is wrong/invented; Parosphromenus is not a 'brown gourami'. Use "licorice gourami (Parosphromenus)" only.
Item 7: "kalah bersaing dengannya saat makan" adds "saat makan" (while feeding), which the source does not say; the original says only outcompete. Remove.
Item 5: "bahan botani (daun kering, ranting, dan sejenisnya)" adds a gloss not in the source; botanicals is a common hobby term, so keep "botanical" without the added list.
Item 3: "Persebarannya luas, tetapi di sebagian wilayah sebarannya rentan" is repetitive; say "Tersebar luas, tetapi rentan terhadap kerusakan habitat di sebagian wilayah sebarannya".
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is acceptable but the English in brackets is unnecessary.
Item 9: "hasil penangkaran" is fine, but "These ... are captive-bred" (the specific stock being sold) is turned into a general statement; this loses the sense that the fish on offer are captive-bred.
Item 6: "mendukung ... keaktifan ikan" is ok, but "Termasuk pemakan hewan renik" for "Micro-carnivores" is loose; "mikrokarnivora" alone is closer.

corydoras-sterbai.name: Corydoras sterbai
notes: Item 13: "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" is fine, but "selalu lebih baik jumlah jantan lebih banyak" is awkward. Rephrase as "rasio jantan terhadap betina sebaiknya lebih tinggi".
Item 13: "burayak" is used for both eggs hatched and young ("anakan" and "burayak" are mixed). Use one consistent term, preferably "burayak" or "anakan".

Item 13: "Musim ini bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris" is a locale-specific fact kept as is. For Indonesian readers, add a note such as "musim dingin belahan bumi utara (Inggris)", or say that the wet season falls in the northern winter.
Item 14: "Walaupun mereka akan memakan apa pun yang muat di mulut" is an overstatement of "bite-sized items such as eggs or fry". Say "hal-hal berukuran seukuran gigitan seperti telur atau burayak".

Item 14: "pakan yang lolos dari ikan-ikan di atasnya" and "hanya diharapkan bertahan dari sisa pakan" are stiff. Rephrase as "jika hanya mengandalkan sisa pakan yang lolos dari ikan lain di lapisan atas".
Item 14: "Kedua sistem ini diterapkan oleh" should read "diperkenalkan oleh". The word "Loricariidae" is fine.
Item 1: "toko ikan hias" is fine, but "diternakkan" and "hasil penangkaran" are inconsistent for a farmed or bred fish. Use one term consistently.
Item 8: "cabang kayu apung (driftwood) (kalau ..." has a double parenthesis, which is awkward and hard to read. Restructure it.
Item 6: "kali" for creeks is informal. Use "anak sungai kecil, sungai kecil/parit".
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is a loose term. Use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

crossocheilus-burmanicus.name: Crossocheilus burmanicus
notes: Item 4: Volume '304 liter' is wrong conversion of 80 US gal (≈ 303 L); use 'sekitar 300 liter' — more importantly check rounding; minor.

Items 1, 3: 'krikil halus' is an invented/odd term for 'gravel' since 'kerikil' already used for pebbles; use 'kerikil' for pebbles and 'kerikil halus/koral' consistently, or 'kerikil' and 'kerikil kecil'.
Item 1: 'sambil merumput biofilm' and 'dirumput' — 'merumput' is awkward for fish; use 'memakan/mengerik biofilm'.
Item 6: 'aufwuchs' left untranslated without explanation; add 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme pada permukaan)'.
Item 6: 'blanched courgette' → 'zukini yang direbus sebentar' fine, but 'Kacang polong yang sudah dikupas' for 'shelled peas' is OK; 'betah' is colloquial for 'settled in' — use 'sudah beradaptasi'.
Item 7: 'Sampai saat ini diagnosis ... belum bisa didapatkan' drops the 'We've been unable' subject nuance; rephrase as 'Belum diperoleh diagnosis...'.
Item 7: 'jari-jari bercabang' ok; 'lobus rostral' could be 'lobus rostral (rostral lobes)' for clarity.
Item 8: Reference list left untranslated, acceptable; no change needed.

crossocheilus-cobitis.name: Siamese Algae Eater
notes: Item 6: 'merumput alga' is awkward for 'grazers'; prefer 'pemakan/penggerus alga' or 'menggerogoti'.
Item 6: 'betah di akuarium' is colloquial; prefer 'sudah beradaptasi'.
Item 7: 'kerabat segenusnya' is slightly awkward; prefer 'anggota genus lain'.
Item 1: 'ikan cyprinid' could be 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' for consistency.
Item 6: 'pakan berprotein tinggi sebaiknya tidak diberikan di akuarium' is a bit stiff; prefer 'jangan diberikan'.

crossocheilus-nigriloba.name: Penguin Flying Fox
notes: Item 1: 'endemic to Borneo' became 'endemik Kalimantan' – changes the facts (Borneo is the whole island, Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part). Use 'endemik Pulau Kalimantan/Borneo'.

Item 4: '(about 304 litres)' is kept as 'sekitar 304 liter' – this is acceptable only if the volume is right; 150×45 cm needs a stated height, so the volume cannot be checked from the text. Check the figure.
Item 11: 'in the latter study' became 'dalam studi terakhir itu' – ambiguous and refers to a study that is not in the text; keep the sense of 'the latter'.
Item 11: 'uniquely breaks up' became 'yang khas hanya pada spesies ini' – awkward; use 'secara unik' or 'khas'.
Item 8: 'sympatric species' became 'spesies yang hidup sehabitat dengannya' – use 'spesies simpatrik' or 'hidup bersama di habitat yang sama'.
Item 8: 'shoaling, rather than schooling' – the explanation 'berkelompok longgar' and 'berenang serempak' is clumsy; keep the terms 'shoaling' and 'schooling' with a simpler gloss.

Item 7: 'Division Rhodophyta ... red algae' – the translation drops 'higher plants' nuance: 'tanaman tingkat tinggi' is fine, but 'blanched courgette' became 'zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar', which is acceptable. 'cuping moncong' for rostral lobes is non-standard; use 'lobus rostral' or 'cuping rostral'.

Item 10: 'Not thought to have occured in the hobby' became 'belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan' – OK, but 'related species are induced to spawn' lost the contrast: the 'Meski begitu' is added and not in the source.

ctenolucius-hujeta.name: Hujeta
notes: Item 2/9: "Ternyata" for "Surprisingly" reads as a discovery, not as a surprise; "Anehnya" or "Mengejutkannya" would be closer.
Item 2/9: "mencari makan di dasar" is fine, but "teman setangkinya" is slightly stiff; "penghuni akuarium lain" is more natural.

cyclocheilichthys-heteronema.name: Cyclocheilichthys heteronema
notes: Item 8: "Mick Wright" is named, and "UK aquarist" is kept ("Akuaris asal Inggris, Mick Wright"). Rewrite it neutrally, e.g. "seorang akuaris pernah memelihara sekelompok ikan ini". Naming the person is the only objection here.
Item 5: "kayu beech (Fagus sylvatica)" adds a Latin name that is not in the English, which only says "common beech". Remove the added Latin name.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp." changes "Cryptocorynes spp.". This is minor and acceptable, but "jenis seperti ... beberapa Cryptocoryne spp." is slightly awkward.

Item 4: the volume "sekitar 243 liter" is the figure for 48×18 in. At 120×45 cm the base area gives about 243 L only for an unstated height of about 45 cm. Check that the figure is consistent with the metric size.
Item 8: "berhasil menggabungkannya" is vague. Say "berhasil memeliharanya bersama".
Item 8: "proyek yang menarik dengan beberapa pilihan alternatif yang menarik" repeats "menarik". Vary the wording.
Item 1: "teman setangki yang agresif dan aktif" renders "boisterous" as "agresif", which overstates it. Use "heboh/aktif".
Item 8: "agresif" for "boisterous" has the same problem and implies aggression. Use "lebih lincah/hiperaktif".
Item 10: "dipijahkan" is acceptable, but "Sejauh ini diperkirakan belum pernah" is awkward. Use "Sejauh ini belum diketahui pernah berhasil dibiakkan".
Item 11: "Cyclocheilos yang divalidasi kembali" is clumsy. Use "yang kembali diakui sebagai genus valid".

cyclocheilichthys-janthochir.name: Temperas
notes: Item 1: "Di toko ikan" for "fishhouse" is acceptable, but "shark" should be "hiu"/"sepat" style; better: sebut "(shark)" with local term e.g. "hiu". Minor.
Item 1: "tidak ribet dalam hal lain" is colloquial; use "tidak rewel dalam hal lain".
Item 8: "biologically immature aquarium" is rendered "siklus nitrogennya belum matang"; it is acceptable but add "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" for fidelity. Minor.
Item 8: "agar tumbuh sehat" for "to thrive" OK; but "jangan pernah dimasukkan" switches from descriptive to imperative; use "tidak boleh dimasukkan".
Item 15: "Spesimen yang tersedia saat ini" drops "at the fishhouse" (shop talk, allowed); "Setiap pertambahan panjang 1 cm" is ok.
Item 12: "tidak mudah stres" for "less nervous" is slightly off; use "tidak mudah gugup/takut".
Item 11: "Enrichment" rendered as "nilai tambah" loses meaning slightly; use "pengayaan/pemanis" or "tambahan yang menarik". Minor.
Item 4: type locality 'Kapuas River in Pontianak' left in English inside translated phrase; use "Sungai Kapuas di Pontianak" or keep entire quote consistent.
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable; "Penghobi ... mendapati" fine. Item 13: "kurang berwarna" is awkward; use "warnanya sedikit lebih pudar".

cyphotilapia-frontosa.name: Frontosa
notes: "berjenong" / "jenong": the usual hobby term is "nonjol" (Frontosa berjidat nonjol/kepala benjol). "jenong" is a Louhan term and is awkward here. Consider "benjolan di dahi".
"tampak unik" for "look bizarre": "bizarre" means odd or strange. Use "tampak aneh/mencolok" instead.
"Hasil penangkaran enam garis dari Taiwan": this is missing a noun. Write "Ikan hasil penangkaran bergaris enam dari Taiwan".
"banteng" in quotes for "bulls among the cichlids": the idiom is unclear. Consider "tergolong cichlid bertubuh besar dan kekar".
"pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengerem mulut". This is fine but not ideal. "Pemijahannya" is also fine.

cyrtocara-moorii.name: Blue Dolphin
notes: Item 10: "spitting out the brood early" was translated as "memuntahkan telur atau burayaknya lebih awal". This adds "telur atau" (eggs or), which the source doesn't say. Use "memuntahkan erami lebih awal" or just "burayak".

Item 10: "Sebagian peternak mengeluarkan burayak ... pada umur 2 minggu" says the fry are stripped at 2 weeks. The source says "at the 2 week stage" of brooding. Say "pada minggu ke-2 pengeraman" so it isn't read as the fry's age.
Item 10: "Selama masa ini betina tidak makan" is fine, but "warna mengeram berupa pola gelap" is awkward. Use "warna khas induk mengerami dengan pola gelap".
Item 10: "Ikan ini adalah mouthbrooder induk betina (betina mengerami telur di mulut) yang poligami" is clumsy. Use "mouthbrooder maternal poligami (betina mengerami telur di dalam mulut)".

Item 8: "Damai dan sebaiknya tidak dipelihara bersama spesies yang agresif ... tetapi ... akan mengintimidasi" is a muddled sentence. "Boisterous" is better as "hiperaktif/kasar" than "agresif" (items 1 and 8). "spesies Synodontis dari danau Rift" should be "Danau-danau Rift" and capitalised.
Item 8: "Teman satu akuarium" is OK, but "tankmates" is more naturally "penghuni bersama" or "tankmate" as hobbyists say it.
Item 4: The US gallon figure was dropped and the bracket removed. This is acceptable, but the volume is reported as "sekitar 257 liter" with false precision. Round to about 260 L.
Item 9: "jenong (nuchal hump)" is fine, but "Sulit dibedakan jenis kelaminnya" could use "sulit disexing" as hobbyists say it. This is minor.

danio-albolineatus.name: Pearl Danio
notes: Item 21: "Pemijahan bisa dipicu dengan menambahkan sedikit air yang lebih dingin" is fine, but "Induk ... diangkat setelah beberapa hari" is OK; however the original says "one or more smaller ... containers" and ID "satu atau beberapa wadah yang lebih kecil" is fine. The real error: "Incubation ... 24–36 jam" is correct, but item 20 and 21 conflict in the source, not the translation.
Item 12: the English gives pH 6.5–7.0 and "neutral (pH 7.0)"; fine. The omitted fact: "Pearl danios tolerate colder temperatures well" is OK. No error here.

Item 22: "Tinca tinca (tench)" is fine, but "Kottelat (2013) ... Danio ... separated" is OK. The problem: "Spesies yang dulu bernama D. erythromicron..." changes meaning; it should be "Spesies yang dulu dikenal sebagai ..." (minor).
Item 3/2: "Wild examples are rare" translated as "Ikan tangkapan alam jarang ada di pasaran" is OK, but "celestial pearl danio ... dark-colored danio" fine.

Item 20: "Place half as many females as males ... several days before introducing the males" is translated as "betina sebanyak setengah jumlah jantan", which matches the English, but the English itself is likely wrong. Keep as is.
Item 5: "Region Tanintharyi" and "negara bagian" for Myanmar states is awkward; use "Wilayah Tanintharyi" and "negara bagian/wilayah".
Item 17: "ikan catfish" is redundant; use "lele-lelean/catfish" or just "catfish". "gugup" for nervous is slightly odd; use "stres/mudah takut".
Item 11: "Akuarium yang banyak tanamannya atau aquascape" - "set-up" rendered as aquascape is a shift; use "tata letak".

danio-choprae.name: Glowlight Danio
notes: Item 11: 'best removed after a couple of days' is translated 'setelah beberapa hari' – 'a couple of days' is ~2 days; use 'setelah sekitar dua hari'.
Item 11: 'the young free-swimming a couple of days later' is translated 'beberapa hari kemudian'; use 'dua hari kemudian'.
Item 11: 'half-filled with water' is fine, but 'The pair should spawn the following morning' is stated as 'biasanya memijah' – the hedge 'biasanya' was added; use 'seharusnya memijah'.

Item 11: 'The widely available plastic grass-type matting ... works very well' – 'hasilnya sangat baik' is acceptable, but 'power filter' as 'filter kecil bertenaga listrik' is unclear; use 'filter bertenaga (power filter)' or 'filter eksternal/hang-on kecil'.
Item 12: 'Spesies yang dulunya D. erythromicron...' is ungrammatical; use 'Spesies yang dahulu bernama D. erythromicron, ... dikelompokkan...'.
Item 12: 'ejaan alaminya adalah Choprae' – 'natural spelling' is better rendered 'ejaan yang wajar/semestinya'.
Item 12: 'Tinca tinca (ikan tench)' – use the Indonesian/trade name 'ikan tench (Tinca tinca)', or keep 'tench' without 'ikan'.
Item 2/6: 'Butuh tutup akuarium yang rapat' is informal; use 'Memerlukan penutup akuarium yang rapat'.
Item 6: 'batu besar yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus'.
Item 12: 'goresan hitam' for 'black streak' – use 'garis hitam'.

danio-kyathit.name: Danio kyathit
notes: Item 12: "sirip anus" is used for the anal fin. "sirip dubur" is the more usual term in Indonesian ichthyology and hobby writing.
Item 11: "pada sore hari" for "in the evening". "malam hari" or "menjelang malam" would be closer for a water-change trigger.

danio-margaritatus.name: Rasbora Galaxy
notes: Item 8: 'deep forest' became 'hutan lebat' (dense forest); 'hutan yang dalam/hutan belantara' is closer to the original.
Item 26: 'revalidated the species' became 'mengkaji ulang status spesies ini'; 'memvalidasi kembali spesies ini' keeps the taxonomic meaning.
Item 9: '~41 litres' became '±41 liter'; 'sekitar/~41 liter' is more natural for an approximate value.

danio-rerio.name: Ikan Zebra
notes: Item 34: the Indonesian ends mid-sentence ('Artinya, tidak semua anggotan'). The rest of the English is missing: the Devario/Danio split, Mayden/Fang/Kottelat 2013, Celestichthys, the 89 mm (3.5 in) SL note, Brachydanio, and the Kullander 2015 / Catalog of Fishes / FishBase conclusion. Translate it in full.
Item 34: 'anggotan' is a typo for 'anggotanya', and the sentence needs completing with 'berasal dari satu nenek moyang yang sama'.
Items 1, 5, 8, 10: 'kubangan' for 'pools' means a muddy wallow. Use 'genangan' or 'kolam alami' for natural pools.

Item 27: the 'cross-reared' sentence ('dibesarkan bersama strain atau corak yang berbeda dari dirinya akan lebih menyukai corak tersebut') is muddled. It should say that fish reared with another strain prefer the pattern they were raised with.

datnioides-microlepis.name: Indo Datnoid
notes: Item 11: "mungkin sudah punah di Thailand" – "extirpated" means locally extinct; use "punah secara lokal di Thailand" or "hilang dari alam di Thailand".
Item 8: "tertekan" for "intimidated" could be "terintimidasi" or "terdesak" to be closer to the source.

datnioides-pulcher.name: Siamese Tiger Fish
notes: Item 5: "meskipun pola ini juga muncul pada malam hari" is slightly ambiguous. Make clear that this stress-like pattern is also the normal nighttime pattern, e.g. "pola yang sama juga ditampilkan pada malam hari".
Item 11: "famili tripletail laut Lobotidae" leaves "tripletail" in English. Add a local term such as "ikan tripletail (Lobotes)" or a short gloss.

dermogenys-pusilla.name: Dermogenys pusilla
notes: Item 10: "Assuming they are healthy, the fry are best removed" is mistranslated as "Kalau anakannya lahir sehat". It should be about the fry being healthy and the advice to remove them (e.g. "Asalkan anakan sehat, sebaiknya dipisahkan"). The nuance is shifted.

Item 8: "Males will often spar... best to keep either a single male specimen or several" is fine. But "sparring" rendered as "bertarung" overstates it. Use "saling menyerang/beradu" or similar milder wording.
Item 1: "Lompatannya juga sangat jago" is awkward and colloquial. Use "Ikan ini juga pelompat ulung". Item 5 "jago melompat" is likewise informal.
Item 1: "Wrestling halfbeak atau julung-julung" leaves English untranslated and repeats "halfbeak". Use a consistent, established term such as "ikan julung-julung" throughout.
Item 1: the source says "tight lid" and then "tightly-fitting cover". The translation is fine, but "Butuh tutup" is terse. Use "Perlu tutup akuarium yang rapat".
Item 10: "Masa bunting" is used for a livebearer's gestation. "Masa kehamilan/mengandung" is more natural for fish. "Bunting" is mainly for mammals.
Item 10: "memancing ikan untuk kawin" is a literal rendering of "inducing the fish to breed". Use "merangsang ikan untuk berkembang biak".
Item 9: "Jantan dewasa ... ukurannya jauh lebih kecil daripada betina" is fine. But "organ kelamin" for "genital-type organ" drops the "type" nuance. Use "organ mirip alat kelamin".

desmopuntius-hexazona.name: Pentazona
notes: Item 4: English says the former locality ('Tuluk') is now Teluk Meranti, and that peat swamp forest was cleared 'to make space for oil palm plantations'. The Indonesian is fine on that. Still, 'Lokasi tipenya ... Tuluk dan Gunung Sahilan' is slightly altered: the original says 'of which the former is now known as'. This is a minor point.

Item 13: 'Hindari teman setangki yang ribut atau sangat agresif saat makan' adds 'saat makan'. The English says 'boisterous or very vigorous', not 'aggressive'. 'agresif' changes the meaning, so use 'sangat aktif/lincah'. 'bisa kalah bersaing dalam berebut pakan' is also redundant.

Item 17: 'D. pentazona ... terbatas di Kalimantan bagian barat laut, dan mungkin negara bagian Sarawak' is OK. But 'kelompok "tempat sampah" polifiletik' for 'catch-all' is a loose rendering; use 'wadah serba ada' or 'kelompok campuran'.

Item 17: 'pita ke-3 di pangkal awal sirip punggung' and 'pita ke-4 di pangkal awal sirip anal' render 'origin' as 'pangkal awal'. This is awkward; use 'awal pangkal sirip'. 'Pita pertama' also does not match 'anterior bar', which means the front bar.
Item 17: the sentence 'D. gemellus, D. johorensis ... pola pita hanya ada pada ikan muda' is fine. 'genus Desmopuntius dibentuk dan didiagnosis' is acceptable. 'Kesalahan penamaan' is fine.
Item 11: 'predator mikro' for 'micropredator' is acceptable. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is the common term, but 'Daphnia' is also used and readers may confuse it with other organisms.

Item 15: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' and 'diisi air matang' are ambiguous. 'air matang' usually means boiled water in Indonesian; use 'air dari akuarium yang sudah matang/siklus' for 'mature water'.
Item 15: 'jangan' is missing nowhere, but 'tidak menunjukkan perawatan induk' is stiff; use 'tidak menjaga telur/anak'.
Item 1: 'sudah dewasa penuh' is stiff; use 'berukuran dewasa'. 'hasil tangkapan alam' is fine, but the hobby term 'tangkapan alam (wild)' is commoner.

desmopuntius-johorensis.name: Striped Barb
notes: Item 10: "air matang (dari akuarium yang sudah mapan)" – "air matang" means boiled water in Indonesian; use "air dari akuarium yang sudah mapan/matang (cycled)".
Item 11: ordinal inconsistency, "pita pertama" next to "pita ke-2", "ke-3"; use "pita ke-1" or consistent wording.
Item 11: "sungut rostral dan maksila ada" is awkward; use "terdapat sungut rostral dan maksila".
Item 2: "posisinya tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus" is awkward; use "tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus".

desmopuntius-rhomboocellatus.name: Snakeskin Barb
notes: Item 1: "Spesimen tangkapan alam dari Borneo yang sangat bagus." is a fragment with no verb. The source says specimens were received. Use a full sentence, e.g. "Kami menerima spesimen tangkapan alam yang bagus..." in neutral phrasing, such as "Diterima spesimen tangkapan alam yang sangat bagus dari Borneo."

Item 4: "Kahayan" differs from the English "Kahajan". It is the correct modern river name, so this is fine. The other place names keep the old spelling (Oelin, Bandjermasin), which matches the quoted type locality.
Item 13: "air akuarium yang sudah matang/siap (mature)" is clumsy. "mature water" means well-established, aged water. Use "air yang sudah matang" only.
Item 13: "keesokan paginya" is rendered with "biasanya", a hedge that is not in the source ("should take place"). Minor.
Item 14: "pangkal depan sirip punggung" for "dorsal-fin origin" is acceptable. "keranjang sampah" for "catch-all" is fine.
Item 10: "terlalu aktif/lincah" uses a slash. Choose one term, e.g. "terlalu aktif".
Item 3 was left out. The English is shop talk for customers, which the translator is told to drop, so this is not an error.

dichotomyctere-fluviatilis.name: Dichotomyctere fluviatilis
notes: Item 8: "Ketiga spesies ini adalah ikan air payau sejati" contradicts item 15 and item 2 where only fluviatilis is a true brackish species; this is a source inconsistency, but the translation keeps the claim as written. Fine, but check consistency.

Item 10: "kerang-kerangan yang cangkangnya tidak dikupas" is fine, but "unshelled shellfish (such as crab legs, mussels)" is contradictory in the source; the Indonesian is ambiguous, so clarify as "yang masih bercangkang".
Item 12: "Karena agak tidak toleran" is awkward; use "Ikan yang agak intoleran ini..." and "monos" should be "ikan kitang/monodaktilus (Monodactylus)" for clarity.
Item 12: "ikan ketang-ketang (scat)" is a non-standard name; "ikan ketang-ketang" is the usual Indonesian term for Scatophagus.

Item 15: "tetrodoxin" in the source was corrected to "tetrodotoksin"; fine, but "lebih mematikan daripada sianida" is okay. "Buntal adalah hidangan istimewa" adds "Buntal" as subject, which is acceptable.
Item 7: "jadi ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial; use "jadi pergantian air sebagian secara rutin wajib dilakukan".
Item 6: "Alas akuarium" is acceptable, but "Standard length" is better as "panjang standar (SL)".

dichotomyctere-nigroviridis.name: Buntal Hijau
notes: Item 8: "lele Arius" – Arius are sea/brackish catfish; consider "ikan manyung (Arius)" or "patin laut/sembilang Arius" for hobbyist clarity.
Item 8: "Terutama ikan jantan, akan terus-menerus berkelahi" is awkward; use "Terutama ikan jantan akan terus-menerus berkelahi" (no comma) or "Pejantan khususnya akan berkelahi terus-menerus".
Item 5: "jadi ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial; use "sehingga penggantian air sebagian secara rutin wajib dilakukan".
Item 8: "agresivitasnya agak terpecah" is slightly unnatural; use "agresi tersebar ke banyak ikan".

dichotomyctere-ocellatus.name: Buntal angka delapan
notes: Item 8: "ikan kakap perak (mono/Monodactylus)" is wrong/confusing: kakap perak is Lates calcarifer (barramundi); monos are Monodactylus argenteus, so use "mono (Monodactylus)" or "ikan bulan/kitiran" without "kakap perak".

Item 7: "hewan bercangkang (kerang dan udang-udangan)" mistranslates "shellfish"; the example in brackets is incomplete, and "unshelled shellfish" (crab legs, prawns) is rendered as "yang tidak dikupas", which is ambiguous. Use "moluska dan krustasea bercangkang", and clarify that the crustaceans are fed with the shell on.
Item 14: added "dan suka bertengkar" duplicates the meaning; the English only says "quarrelsome". Minor.
Item 13: "air sebaiknya sekeras mungkin (kesadahan setinggi mungkin)" is wordy; the bracket is an addition. Minor.

Item 11: "jika Anda tidak ingin memelihara ikan buntal Anda lagi" is wordy; "if you need to get rid of" would be better as "jika perlu melepas/menyingkirkan". Also "anyone ... lebih dari 1000 kali lebih mematikan" is fine, but "tidak perlu Anda khawatirkan" is a loose rendering of "This need not worry you"; ok.

Item 10: "Diperkirakan belum pernah dipijahkan" – "Not thought to have been bred" better as "Tampaknya belum pernah berhasil dikembangbiakkan di kalangan penghobi"; "dipijahkan" implies only spawning, not breeding success.
Item 15: "Sejak awal ikan ini sering tertukar" adds "sering" (often) not in the source ("Very early on it was confused").

discherodontus-ashmeadi.name: Discherodontus ashmeadi
notes: Item 8: 'Males will also display their best colours as they compete' is rendered in the wrong sense. 'Ikan jantan juga akan menampilkan warna terbaiknya saat bersaing satu sama lain' is acceptable, but 'Damai ... tempat ia akan menghabiskan ... dan akan tumbuh baik' is one long run-on sentence and hard to read. Split it.
Item 3: 'tanaman emersed' leaves English untranslated. Use 'tanaman emers' or 'tanaman yang tumbuh menyembul di atas air'.

Item 3: 'Collection is therefore much easier during the hours of darkness' is rendered as 'penangkapannya jauh lebih mudah saat gelap'. This is fine, but 'ia' used for the fish in several places is slightly stiff.
Item 5: 'arus sederas air bah' for 'torrent-like conditions' overstates the meaning, since a flood is not a torrent. Use 'arus sederas aliran deras/jeram'.
Item 5: 'Microsorum, Bolbitis, atau Anubias' are left without italics. Make them genus names in italics (<em>) as Latin names.
Item 1/11: 'mudah stres (shock)' is imprecise. 'Shock' is better rendered as 'syok'. 'Stres' alone does not convey it.

Item 4: The 'Volume ±243 liter' is correct, but the dropped bracketed imperial values are fine. No change is needed, though 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran minimum' is awkward. Use 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran terkecil yang dipertimbangkan'.
Item 7: 'merumput biofilm' for 'browsing' is awkward. Use 'memakan/menggerogoti biofilm'. 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' is acceptable but loses the Latin name hobbyists use, so keep 'Daphnia'.
Item 12: The Kottelat reference contains the typo 'bibiography' and is left untranslated as instructed. This is fine, so no change is needed.

doryichthys-martensii.name: Pipefish air tawar
notes: "Ikan jarum ini" in item 5 is inconsistent with "Pipefish" elsewhere; "needles" is the English colloquial term, so use consistent terminology (e.g., "ikan pipa/pipefish").
"kutu air kecil" for small water fleas: "kutu air" is ambiguous; prefer "Daphnia kecil" or "kutu air (Daphnia) kecil".
"nauplii artemia" should be "nauplii Artemia" (genus name capitalised/italic) for consistency with Cyclops.
"Pipefish air tawar termasuk ikan yang cocok untuk aquarist yang sudah berpengalaman": "care objects for advanced aquarists" is slightly softened; "aquarist" could be "aquaris/penghobi", minor.
"sebisa mungkin pH sebaiknya di atas 7" is redundant ("sebisa mungkin" + "sebaiknya"); use one.
"perut yang tebal" is literal; "perut membuncit/gemuk" is more natural.

epalzeorhynchos-bicolor.name: Red Tail Black Shark
notes: Item 3: "pembangunan manusia" is awkward and can read as human development. Use "pembangunan oleh manusia" or "aktivitas pembangunan".
Item 5: "cukup tidak tahan terhadap penumpukan limbah organik" is clumsy. Use "kurang tahan" or "sensitif terhadap".

Item 7: "pakan kering berkualitas baik berupa pakan serpihan, granul, serta bahan nabati segar" lumps fresh plant material in with dried food. Separate them: dried flakes and granules, plus fresh plant material.
Item 2: "dianggap kritis" is vague for "considered critically endangered". Use "dianggap sangat terancam punah (critically endangered)".

Item 1: "ikan cyprinid" and "Red tail black shark" are acceptable, but the common name is more natural as "red tail black shark" (also "hiu bala/balashark ekor merah"). Use the form hobbyists use consistently.

epalzeorhynchos-frenatus.name: Rainbow Shark
notes: Items 7 and 11: "menggerogoti" (gnaw) for "browse/graze" on algae and biofilm is slightly off. "memakan/mengerik" or "merumput" would fit better.
Item 1: "anerythristic" is left untranslated, though item 11 glosses it. Consider "anerythristic (tanpa pigmen merah)" here too.

epalzeorhynchos-kalopterus.name: Flying fox
notes: Item 1: "Flying fox bisa dengan mudah hidup 10–15 tahun" – the English "easily live up to 10-15 years" is rendered loosely; "hingga 10–15 tahun" is more faithful.
Item 2: "karena itu tangkapan alam relatif jarang diimpor" – the comma splice is awkward; use "sehingga" or "itulah sebabnya".
Item 5: "bisa suka bertengkar" is awkward; use "bisa agresif/suka berkelahi".
Item 5: "masalah ini jauh berkurang" is fine, but "perilaku ini bisa terbentuk" is vague; make clear it refers to the hierarchy and group behaviour.
Item 3: "Flying fox" is written in lowercase at the start of a sentence; capitalise it and use italics for the Latin name.

esomus-metallicus.name: Striped Flying Barb
notes: Item 12: "a dozen described Esomus species" is rendered "belasan spesies" (about 11–19). Use "selusin" or "sekitar 12 spesies" to stay close to the source.

Item 12: "tidak ada yang terlalu populer" is slightly weaker than "none are especially popular". "Tidak ada yang terlalu populer" is fine, but "sebagian besar umum dijumpai" would read more naturally as "sebagian besar tergolong umum".

eutropiichthys-burmannicus.name: Eutropiichthys burmannicus
notes: Item 1: size and temperature drop the original in brackets (14 in; 73-79°F). Dropping them is allowed because the metric conversion is given, so this is not an error.

Item 4: 'eutropheia = cukup makan' is fine, but 'jarang ditemukan di pasar ikan' is OK. 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' is acceptable; the usual Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Resiko Rendah'.
Item 2: 'hilir Sungai Salween' reads slightly ambiguous. Consider 'bagian hilir Sungai Salween'.

garra-borneensis.name: Garra Borneo
notes: "Ikan ini mutlak hidup di sungai kecil" (obligate dweller): "mutlak hidup" is awkward and unclear; use "hanya hidup di" or "penghuni khas/eksklusif sungai berarus deras".
"dasar batuan induk" / "batuan induk" for bedrock: "batuan induk" is a geological term for parent rock (source rock), which is a different meaning; use "batuan dasar" or "dasar batu padat".

"Spesies ikan lain di sana" is fine, but "Tidak ada anggota genus ini lainnya yang diketahui berasal dari pulau tersebut" is stiff; rephrase as "Tidak ada anggota genus lain yang diketahui dari pulau tersebut".

"Spesies ini sudah tercatat" in 2: the English has no explicit subject and says "it has been recorded"; fine, but "negara bagian Sabah dan Sarawak" is correct, so no change needed there. Minor: "Malaysian provinces" rendered correctly.
"zat tanduk" for keratinised/horny is unnatural; use "mengeras seperti tanduk (berkeratin)".
"kecil kemungkinannya terwujud" and "kumpulan yang ada sekarang" for "current assemblage" are slightly awkward; prefer "pengelompokan saat ini".
"klad" is a rare spelling; use "klade".

garra-flavatra.name: Garra panda
notes: Item 8: 'Memelihara Garra flavatra sangat mudah' — the English says 'very easy', but this contradicts the rest of the text, which says it needs stable water and a mature set-up. It is faithful to the source, so only flag it if the source is wrong. Not a translation error.
Item 10: 'Parameter air lainnya tidak berpengaruh baginya' is a little too absolute. Prefer 'tidak penting bagi mereka'. This is a minor point.
Item 13: 'Mereka sepenuhnya damai' — fine. No change needed.
Item 6: 'batu kerikil bulat' for 'pebbles' is awkward; use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali'. 'Anak sungai' for 'stream' is acceptable but slightly imprecise; 'sungai kecil' is better.
Item 6: 'Dasarnya didominasi batu besar dan batu kecil' — 'rocks and stones' is rendered with 'batu besar', which adds a size claim. Use 'batu dan batu kecil'.
Item 6: 'Pengambilan ikan' for 'collection' is vague; 'penangkapan/pengumpulan ikan' is clearer.
Item 12: 'Tubifex' is rendered as 'cacing sutra'. That is acceptable but not identical; keep Tubifex or add it in brackets.
Item 12: 'kerang/udang yang dihaluskan' for 'puréed shellfish' adds 'udang' and is imprecise. Use 'kerang-kerangan/hewan bercangkang yang dihaluskan'.
Item 16: 'Direktur pelaksananya' — 'Managing Director' is better as 'Direktur Utama'.
Item 3 is left out, which matches the instructions for shop talk. No issue.

garra-rufa.name: Ikan Dokter
notes: Item 3: "Lapisan biofilm" for "Growth" adds a term not in the source; the source says algae and the microorganisms in it. Use "Lapisan alga" or "Tumbuhan penempel (alga) beserta mikroorganisme di dalamnya" instead.
Item 4: "batu-batu berlumut alga" is slightly off for "algae-covered stones". "batu yang ditumbuhi alga", as used in item 3, is more consistent.
Item 4: "Terutama ikan-ikan muda sangat rajin" is awkward for "Young fish in particular are very fond of...". Use "Ikan muda khususnya sangat gemar membersihkan dan memakan alga".

Item 5: "Saat dicoba langsung" loses the "self-experiment" meaning, which is the author trying it on their own arm. Use "Dalam percobaan pada diri sendiri", or a neutral wording such as "Dalam uji coba pada lengan sendiri".
Item 5: "dengan sendirinya berenang menghampiri tangan" is fine, but "pemakan alga yang hebat" is a bit colloquial. "pemakan alga yang andal" is more natural.
Item 2: "Ikan dokter" is a common name, but it is not the same as "psoriasis fish". Consider "ikan dokter (ikan psoriasis) Kangal" for clarity.

gastromyzon-lepidogaster.name: Hillstream Loach Borneo
notes: "pilihan tankmate": English term left in; "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "teman satu akuarium" is more natural.
"aufwuchs": German term left as is; add a short Indonesian gloss such as "lapisan alga dan jasad renik (aufwuchs)".

gastromyzon-punctulatus.name: Borneo Sucker
notes: Item 6: "Karena bagaimanapun impor yang datang cukup sering berisi campuran..." changes the logic. The English says a mix of up to five species often arrives anyway, so the animals are simply still sold as G. punctulatus. Rephrase, e.g. "Karena toh cukup sering datang campuran hingga lima spesies...".

Item 6: "dulu dalam impor dimasukkan ke 3 spesies saja" is clumsy. The English says species that were assigned to 3 species in earlier imports. Rephrase, e.g. "yang pada impor terdahulu dimasukkan ke dalam 3 spesies".
Item 6: "tidak mau mengembangkan siripnya kalau dipanggil" is a literal, odd rendering of "when called". Rephrase, e.g. "tidak mengembangkan sirip sesuai perintah".
Item 6: "area tulang belakang" is stiff for "vertebral area". Use "daerah punggung sepanjang tulang belakang". "bentuk peralihannya banyak sekali" is awkward. Use "bentuk peralihan/perantara".

Item 6: "Di perdagangan ikan hias selalu ada" fits "There are always ... offered" only loosely. "Selalu" could be "senantiasa/biasanya". The "punctulated" point is also lost: "satu spesies berbintik".

Item 3: "perkelahiannya selalu tidak berbahaya" is awkward. Use "perkelahian di antara mereka selalu tidak berbahaya/tidak melukai". "tidak peduli" has a slightly negative tone for "not interested". Use "tidak mengganggu".

Item 1: "mungkin ada gunanya" is a bit colloquial. "Suhu di kisaran tengah lebih disarankan" is fine. In "sangat lunak dan sering juga asam", "lunak" is correct for soft water. "Acclimation" as "aklimatisasi" is fine.

Item 2: "Ikan ini sangat mudah diberi pakan, segala jenis pakan mau dimakan" is a comma splice. Merge into one sentence. "lumut" for algae is acceptable, but "alga" is more precise. The English says they are less concerned with algae than with micro life.

glossolepis-incisus.name: Rainbow merah
notes: Item 4: "western Papua New Guinea" translated as "bagian barat Papua Nugini". Lake Sentani is in Indonesian Papua, not Papua New Guinea, and item 2 says Indonesia. The translation copies the source's geographic error, which contradicts the other entries. Consider correcting it to "Papua" or flagging it.
Item 2: "far less colour" became "jauh lebih pucat" (much paler). This is a slight shift in meaning. Use "warnanya jauh lebih kurang mencolok" or "warnanya jauh kurang cerah".
Item 14: "Filter kecil bertenaga aerator" is awkward. Use "filter udara kecil" or "filter sponge dengan aerator".
Item 14: "air yang agak sadah dan basa" is acceptable, but "burayak" is a less common term for fry. "Anakan" or "larva" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 3: "seiring setiap sentimeter pertumbuhan ikan" is awkward. Use "seiring bertambahnya setiap sentimeter ukuran ikan".
Item 11: "lebih banyak lebih baik" is fine, but "ikan catfish" is redundant. Use "ikan lele-lelean (catfish)" or just "catfish".

Item 1: "Rainbow merah" is used for the red rainbowfish. The spelling "rainbow" is fine, but the sentence adds "dan keduanya relatif kurang mencolok", which restructures the source. The meaning is preserved, so this is minor.

gnathonemus-petersii.name: Elephant Nose
notes: "saling keroyok, bahkan sampai ada yang mati" – "mob each other, even to death" is slightly softened; better "saling menyerang beramai-ramai, bahkan sampai mati". "keroyok" is colloquial.
"elephant nose" – the usual Indonesian hobby name is "ikan hidung gajah" (or "elephantnose"); consider using it.
"Padahal di alam" – "however" is better rendered as "Namun, di alam"; "padahal" implies contradiction/reproach and is slightly off.
"unik" for "bizarre" – "aneh" or "tidak biasa" is closer to the source.
"kawanan" and "bergerombol" for schools/schooling – "kawanan" is usually for land animals; "gerombolan" is more natural for fish shoals.

gymnarchus-niloticus.name: Aba Aba
notes: #5: "ditanam atau diberi pemberat" adds "ditanam" (planted), which the source doesn't say. Use "diberi pemberat dengan kuat" or "dikunci/ditahan dengan kokoh".
#3: "lahan basah" is a broad term for wetlands in general. For "marshes" use "paya" or "rawa-rawa".

#11: "Karena sirip punggungnya yang memanjang... padahal" in #1 and "pencinta ikan predator monster" in #11 are loose. "Tankbusting" means fish that outgrow and wreck tanks, so "ikan predator raksasa perusak akuarium" is closer.

gymnochanda-filamentosa.name: Gymnochanda filamentosa
notes: Item 1 and 11: "sulit dipelihara" is added; the English only says "delicate" (evidently delicate and recommended only to experienced aquarists). Remove "dan sulit dipelihara".
Item 5: "akuarium yang baru disiapkan" for "a new aquarium" is okay but slightly changes the meaning. The point is an uncycled, immature tank, so use "akuarium baru (belum matang/belum siklus)".

Item 9: "duri sirip" is kept for spines, but the filaments are elsewhere called "jari-jari" (rays). Keep "duri/jari-jari" consistent with the source. "seperti benang" is added to "filamen" and is redundant.
Item 11: "Betina tidak berpigmen (bening)" for "colourless" is a slight over-interpretation. Use "tidak berwarna".
Item 7: "kutu air (Daphnia)" is acceptable, but "kutu air" also names other organisms. Consider "Daphnia/kutu air" or the hobby term "cacing sutra/kutu air" as appropriate.
Item 4: "Volumenya sekitar 54 liter" is fine but the volume figure was left out of context. The 60×30 cm base needs the height assumed, so keep this as in the source.

gymnochanda-ploegi.name: Gymnochanda ploegi
notes: Item 8: "ikan kuhli" is loosely phrased for "Kuhli loaches"; use "ikan kuhli (Kuhli loach)" or "lundu/loach kuhli".
Item 7: "kutu air" for daphnia is okay but "daphnia" is more precise; consider "daphnia (kutu air)".
Item 1: "ikan kaca (glass perch)" is fine, but "SL" is left unexplained in the sentence; write "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 7: "mungkin mau menerima" is slightly clumsy; use "dapat mau memakan".

gymnocorymbus-ternetzi.name: Black Widow
notes: #8: 'manfish' is wrong for 'angel fish'; use 'angelfish' (atau 'ikan manfish' hanya jika dikenal) — better 'angelfish/skalar'.
#4: '20g long' dropped; '(sekitar 70 liter)' fine, but 'standar' ok. Minor: ensure 70 L retained as stated (it is).
#1/#11: 'ikan karasin (Characidae)' – 'karasin' is non-standard for hobbyists; use 'characid' or 'famili Characidae'.
#11: 'cukup 'black tetra'' is awkward for 'simply black tetra'; use 'atau sekadar 'black tetra''.
#11: 'nama dagang' for 'common names' should be 'nama umum'.
#5: 'Cukup tidak rewel soal dekorasi' is awkward; use 'Tidak terlalu rewel soal dekorasi'.
#7: 'pelet butiran' adds 'pelet'; source says granules – use 'granul'. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok, but 'Daphnia' commonly used.
#10: 'java moss' and 'spawning mop (media pemijahan dari benang)' adds explanation; acceptable but 'lumut jawa' is the local term.
#10: 'Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu' fine; 'indukan harus segera dipindahkan' ok. 'burayak' is acceptable but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
#3: 'kali' redundant with 'anak sungai'; 'creeks' ok but streamline.

gyrinocheilus-aymonieri.name: Chinese Algae Eater
notes: Item 1: "Umurnya bisa lebih dari 15 tahun, dan sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk akuarium komunitas" – the subject is ambiguous; better "ikan ini sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk..." or "kurang cocok untuk...".
Item 3: "kerikil kecil, kerikil" for "pebbles, gravel" is a little repetitive; consider "kerikil besar/koral, kerikil".

hampala-dispar.name: Spotted Hampala Barb
notes: Item 1: 'Needs a tank at least 2 m long' vs 'Aquarium size: 240 × 60 cm' is fine, but the ID 'Butuh arus kuat, dengan filter yang memutar air akuarium 8–12 kali per jam' is OK; no issue. Main problem is in item 8: 'ikan teri (whitebait)' is wrong; teri are anchovies, whitebait are juvenile herring/sprats. Use 'ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)'.
Item 8: 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but 'pack-style behaviour' became 'kawanan pemburu', which adds 'hunting'. Use 'perilaku berkelompok seperti kawanan'.

Item 8: 'Hampala spp. ... dalam jumlah lebih sedikit' in item 12 changes meaning: 'to a lesser extent, H. dispar' means H. dispar is seen less often, so it is OK; but item 8 'ditambah sebagian ikan kecil' is fine.
Item 12: 'di Kalimantan' placed after 'Malaysia' is garbled. Say 'negara bagian Sarawak di Kalimantan, Malaysia'.
Item 12: 'bentuk H. bimaculata ... sebaiknya dianggap berbeda' loses the 'ought to be considered distinct [species]' nuance. Say 'dianggap sebagai spesies tersendiri'.
Item 12: 'pada dua spesies lainnya terletak di bawah pangkal awal sirip punggung' is slightly redundant. Use 'di bawah pangkal sirip punggung'.

Item 5: the '~864 litres' volume is correct, but 'Spesies aktif yang hidup di kolom air terbuka (pelagis)' is a loose rendering of 'pelagic'. Use 'ikan pelagis aktif yang berenang di kolom air tengah-atas'.
Item 9: 'shoaling (berkumpul longgar)' and 'schooling (berenang serempak)' are acceptable, but 'ikan yang kalah dominan' is awkward. Use 'ikan subdominan'.
Item 6: 'setup' and 'mudah kaget' are fine, but 'skittish' as 'cukup mudah kaget' is OK; 'substrat batu dan kerikil berbagai ukuran' is fine. Item 1: the 'SL 35 cm' conversion is right.

hampala-macrolepidota.name: Hampal
notes: Item 2: "Needs a tank at least 2 m long" is fine, but item 3 'Needs a tight-fitting lid...' ok; main issue: item 15 "tidak semestinya dianggap sebagai ikan akuarium kecuali dalam kondisi yang sangat ekstrem" is acceptable, but "Salah satu pengecualian yang langka" (item 1) shifts meaning: 'rare exceptions' = pengecualian yang jarang, fine; no change needed.

Item 15: "di bawah pangkal awal sirip punggung" for "below the dorsal fin origin" is fine, but "H. dispar ... kurang tegas" ok; real issue: 'Hampala spp.' left in English style, use 'spesies Hampala'.
