Item 12: "ikan catfish (ikan berkumis)" is redundant; use "ikan lele-lelean/catfish". Also "loach botiid" mixes terms; use "loach famili Botiidae".

Item 12: "shoaling ... schooling" rendered as "hidup berkelompok longgar ... berenang serempak" is acceptable, but "mudah gugup" for 'rather nervously' and "kalah dominan" for 'subdominant' are awkward; use "ikan yang berstatus lebih rendah".

Item 10: "ikan teri kecil (whitebait)" – whitebait is not teri exactly; use "ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)". Also 'feeder fish' translated as "pakan hidup" loses the 'feeder fish' meaning; use "ikan umpan/feeder".

Item 11: "sangat damai terhadap" – use "sangat damai terhadap" fine; 'schooling fish' as "hidup bergerombol" conflicts with item 12 where the species is explicitly shoaling, not schooling; use consistent term.
Item 3/7: 'cyprinid', 'characid' left as English; prefer "ikan Cyprinidae", "Characidae".
Item 15: "H. macrolepidota ... sisik gurat sisi" numeric ranges use hyphen while elsewhere en dash; minor consistency.

hampala-salweenensis.name: Hampala Salween
notes: Item 8: "ikan yang rewel makan" is fine, but "Hampala ... disarankan sebagai teman satu akuarium" changes the subject: the original says the fish is recommended as a tankmate for fussy/new fishes, which is kept, but "segerombolan" for "a shoal" is fine. The real error is "feeder" fish: "ikan mas koki kecil" is OK. Check "pakan hidup (feeder)": feeder fish are live fish, so say "ikan umpan (feeder fish)" rather than "pakan hidup", which wrongly suggests all live foods.
Item 6: the sentence "Ikan ini juga paling baik dipelihara ... " is fine. "mudah kaget" for skittish is okay, but "cabang kayu (driftwood)" should be "kayu apung/kayu rendam" or just driftwood.
Item 12: "dilewati gurat sisi" is awkward for "passing through lateral line"; use "tepat pada gurat sisi" or "menutupi gurat sisi".
Item 12: "ikan lele/catfish" and "Cyprinid, characid" are left as English-style terms; use "ikan lele" and consider "ikan karpet (cyprinid)" only if needed.
Item 12: "di Kalimantan (Borneo)" is awkward; Sarawak is in northern Borneo (Kalimantan is Indonesian), so write "di Pulau Borneo".
Item 12: "tanda di tubuh cenderung memudar pada ikan yang sangat besar pada semua Hampala spp." has double "pada"; rephrase.
Item 1: the "201 mm SL" figure is unchanged, which is correct, but SL is not explained anywhere; consider "panjang standar".
Item 3: the type locality is left in English with a translation in brackets, which is acceptable; "anak Sungai" is fine.

hasemania-nana.name: Silver Tip Tetra
notes: Item 1: "All the fish in the trade are captive bred and unfussy ... and it is sometimes sold" — fine, but 'copper tetra' left in English is acceptable; consider adding local explanation "tetra tembaga".

Item 3: "perairan air putih (white water) maupun air hitam (black water)" is redundant/awkward; use "perairan air putih (white water) maupun air hitam (black water)" → "perairan berair putih ... dan berair hitam" or "air putih" without 'perairan'.
Item 4: "Alas akuarium" is slightly stiff; "Ukuran alas akuarium" or "Dimensi dasar akuarium" is more natural.
Item 5: "dan akar-akar yang meliuk" for 'twisted roots' ok; "daun ek dan daun beech" — 'beech' left untranslated; use "daun beech (bukit)" or explain; minor.
Item 7: "pakan kering berupa pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran" repetitive; use "pakan kering berupa flake dan granul".
Item 8: "gurami hias" fine; "Loricariidae" capitalised as family not italic—fine; "suka menggigit sirip" ok. "angelfish" could be "ikan manfish/angelfish"; minor.

helostoma-temminckii.name: Tambakan
notes: Item 1: 'Tambakan atau kissing gourami' — adds a local name that is not in the source; also 'famili Helostomatidae' is added. 'Tambakan' is the established local name, but the added family name is not in this sentence.
Item 1: 'Bentuk putih kemerahan' for 'pinkish-white' is okay, but item 11 then says 'Bentuk pink' — use one term consistently.
Item 8: 'ikan lele/catfish' — the source says 'catfishes' (a broad group), and 'lele' is a specific catfish; use 'ikan berkumis/catfish' or just 'catfish'.

Item 5: 'Pencahayaan relatif tidak penting ... lumut/alga jangan dibasmi' — acceptable, but 'mengambil udara dari permukaan' is fine. 'saluran keluar' for 'outflows' is slightly clumsy. 'merumput biofilm' is odd; use 'memakan/menggerus biofilm'.
Item 7: 'Bibirnya yang tebal' — the source says 'fleshy lips'; 'berdaging' is closer. 'mengecap' for 'mouthing' is unnatural; use 'membuka-tutup mulut'.
Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' — fine, but 'Tapis insang' / 'lengkung insang' are not clearly rendered as 'gill rakers' and 'gill arches' to hobbyists.

hemibagrus-wyckii.name: Crystal Eye Catfish
notes: Item 1: "mata birunya tidak disebut ... dalam diagnosis mana pun yang pernah ditemukan" is awkward and slightly changes the source ("seen" = consulted). Better: "dalam diagnosis mana pun yang dirujuk".
Item 4: "710 mm SL" is not converted or rounded to cm (about 71 cm SL). The imperial figure was dropped, which is fine. Consider "71 cm SL" and the Indonesian "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 1/10: "Anakannya" is non-standard. Use "Anakan ikan ini" or "Ikan muda".
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is a poor term. Hobbyists say "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendam".

Item 7: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine. "daging mamalia seperti jantung sapi atau ayam" is wrong, because chicken is not a mammal. This follows the source, but clarify with "daging unggas" or "daging ayam".
Item 10: "Hemibagrus ... Etimologi" is fine. "kerabat segenus" is awkward. Use "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama" or "anggota genus lain".
Item 10: "posttemporal", "interneural" and "mesetmoid" are left untranslated or misspelled. "mesetmoid" should be "mesetmoid/mesethmoid", and "sirip dada" for pectoral fin is fine.
Item 3: "hutan yang tergenang banjir" is OK. "musim hujan" for wet season is fine.

hemigrammus-bleheri.name: Rummy Nose Tetra
notes: Item 12: "Tulang frontal kiri dan kanan saling bersentuhan" adds "kiri dan kanan", which is not in the source ("Contact between frontals").

Item 12: "17 atau lebih sedikit jari-jari sirip anal bercabang" is fine, but "tepi posterodorsal ... tidak bersentuhan (berjarak)" reads awkwardly and the source is unclear. Check this against the source.
Item 12: "warna merahnya melewati tutup insang" is OK. However, "lobus sirip ekor yang dipisahkan oleh pita berwarna putih" is ambiguous. Specify that the bars are separated by white bands.
Item 12: "tidak dapat dideklinasikan" is a stiff, unnatural literal rendering. Use "tidak mengalami perubahan bentuk (indeclinable)".
Item 4: "kelompok 10 ekor, lebih baik lagi kalau lebih banyak" is fine. "Karena sifatnya yang aktif berenang" is acceptable.
Item 8: "Anabantoid" and "Loricariidae kecil" are inconsistent. Use "anabantid/labirin" and "loricariid kecil".
Item 10: "sekitar enam ekor dari masing-masing jenis kelamin" is OK. "Dengan jumlah yang baik" is awkward.
Item 11: "Uniknya" adds emphasis not in the source. "Precisely in a tetra" is rendered loosely.

hemigrammus-erythrozonus.name: Glowlight Tetra
notes: "sejauh ini hanya diketahui" (items 1 and 2) adds a hedge the English doesn't have. Use "hanya diketahui dari".
"manfish" for angel fish is acceptable. "angelfish" is the more common hobby spelling and could be added in brackets.
"ternakan massal" and "hasil ternakan" read slightly stiff. "hasil penangkaran massal" is more natural.

hemirhamphodon-phaiosoma.name: Hemirhamphodon phaiosoma
notes: Item 1: "betinanya tetap lebih kecil" – "tetap" is slightly off for "stay smaller"; "betinanya tetap berukuran lebih kecil" or "betina lebih kecil" is more natural.
Item 2: "ikan julung-julung" is fine, but "blackwater (air hitam)" is slightly redundant; acceptable but could use "perairan air hitam (blackwater)".

hemirhamphodon-pogonognathus.name: Julung-julung
notes: Item 5: "teman setanknya tidak boleh terlalu kasar" – "setank" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain dalam akuarium yang sama". "robust" is better rendered "terlalu bongsor/agresif/aktif" than "kasar".
Item 5: "Sesama jantan bisa cukup sering berkelahi" adds "sering" (frequency); the source says quite quarrelsome, so use "cukup suka berkelahi".

Item 2: "tidak tahan pengiriman" is stiff; use "tidak tahan terhadap pengangkutan/transportasi". "kondisi ... hampir tidak mendukung kehidupan" is fine but "miskin" for food supply could be "minim nutrisi".
Item 2: "aklimatisasi" is good, but "Terutama, ikan ini..." is awkward; use "Ikan ini terutama tidak tahan...".
Item 4: "dimakan dengan lahap" slightly strengthens "with pleasure"; "dimakan dengan senang hati/mau memakan" would be closer.

hemisilurus-moolenburghi.name: Lais
notes: Item 1: "Maximum size: 500 mm (19.7 in) SL" – the conversion is fine, but "panjang standar" was added in brackets; this is acceptable, so check only that the abbreviation is used consistently.

Item 8: "Seperti ketiga spesies dalam genus ini" – the English says "all three species in this genus", which includes this species. Better: "Seperti ketiga spesies dalam genus ini" is slightly ambiguous; use "Seperti semua (ketiga) spesies dalam genus ini".
Item 8: "penggundulan hutan" is acceptable, but "deforestasi" or "pembukaan hutan" is more common in technical text.
Item 8: "para penulis deskripsinya" – the English says "the authors"; "para penulis (yang mendeskripsikan spesies)" is clearer, and "presumably" should be "diduga" rather than "kemungkinan".
Item 5: "tutup insang" for opercle is fine, but "bertubuh lebih tinggi" for "deeper bodied" could be "berbadan lebih tinggi/bongsor"; minor.
Item 9: the reference title is left untranslated, which is fine.

herichthys-carpintis.name: Green Texas
notes: Item 4: in "P 120 cm × T 45 cm × L 37,5 cm", "L" for lebar is easy to confuse with L for litre. Consider writing "Lebar" in full or using "P × L × T" with the words spelled out.
Item 10: "telur/larva" adds a word that is not in the source (it says only "they"). Use "telur" alone.

heros-severus.name: Severum
notes: "agak sadah" for "medium hard": use "sadah sedang" (or "kesadahan sedang"); "agak sadah" slightly shifts the meaning.
"Hal ini terutama karena perilaku berkembang biaknya": "berkembang biak" is awkward. Use "perilaku pemijahannya" or "cara berbiaknya".
"mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbreeding)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram mulut". Also, "bertelur di substrat" is vague; "memijah di substrat (substrate breeder)" is better.
"Amazon, Orinoco": add "Sungai" or "DAS" (e.g., "Sungai Amazon, Sungai Orinoco") so the reader knows these are river systems.
"warnanya mungkin jadi memudar": "jadi" is colloquial; use "menjadi" in the formal handbook register.
"Ikan juga bisa lebih rentan" and "tanda-tanda kondisi yang menurun": stiff and vague. Use "tanda-tanda penurunan kondisi" or "kesehatannya menurun".
"Pakan nabati perlu ditambahkan": the source says "vegetarian components". "Komponen nabati" or "pakan berbahan nabati" is closer. "pelet stik" for "sticks" is fine, but "stik" alone is enough.

homaloptera-parclitella.name: Lizard Loach
notes: Item 3: 'Jadi spesies yang layak dipelihara' for 'recommendable species' is awkward; also the 'we were able' import claim is rendered passively, which is acceptable, but 'Loach cantik ini mutlak' is fine. Main issue is only minor wording.
Item 12: 'pertarungan pamer' for 'comment fights' (Komment fights, ritualised display fights) is unnatural; use 'perkelahian ritual/adu pamer' with a clearer explanation.
Item 9: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' → 'batu dan kerikil bulat berbagai ukuran yang terkikis arus'.
Item 9: 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)' is a German term left in place in items 9 and 11; use 'aufwuchs' with a gloss consistently, or 'lapisan alga/biofilm'.
Item 9: 'Turnover ... 10–15 times' conflicts with item 2 (8–12) in the source itself; this is not a translation error, but 'jadi bila perlu' adds a slightly different logic to 'so ... as necessary'.
Item 16: the translation is missing entirely (left out). The stock code and wholesale note were dropped; if the shop talk is intentionally dropped this is fine, but confirm it.
Item 13: 'lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp.' calls the catfishes 'lele', which usually means Clarias; use 'ikan lele-lelean' or 'catfish'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'merumput biofilm' is awkward; use 'memakan biofilm dengan cara merumput'.

homalopteroides-stephensoni.name: Homalopteroides stephensoni
notes: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use something like "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis arus", or "batu kali yang membulat".
"gobi" is not the usual hobby spelling. Use "goby".

homalopteroides-tweediei.name: Gecko Loach
notes: Item 5: "sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but item 2 omits nothing; however item 6 "filter yang kapasitasnya berlebih" fine. Real problem: item 6 "jangan pernah dimasukkan ke akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is OK; but item 6 turnover "10–15 kali per jam" differs from item 2 "8–12 kali per jam" (source inconsistency, check consistency).
Item 12: "sangat bersahabat" for "very thankful" (dankbar = tolerant/undemanding) is a mistranslation; use "tahan banting" / "mudah beradaptasi dan tidak rewel".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air" (water-worn).

Item 6: "Anubias sangat berguna" - source says 'the latter' (Anubias/ the plants generally); acceptable but "Anubias spp." should be consistent. Also "Microsorum, Crinum, dan Anubias spp." mixes genus/spp.
Item 1: "Homaloptera tweediei" and "gecko loach" left untranslated; consider "loach gecko" and note the name differs from Homalopteroides in item 2.
Item 8: "predator mikro" for micropredators is OK, but "kutu air" for Daphnia is usually "kutu air (Daphnia)"; "cacing darah" fine. "pakan kering yang tenggelam" better "pakan kering tenggelam".
Item 9: "lele dari genus Glyptothorax..." fine; "teman setangki" better "penghuni akuarium lain / tankmate".

hyphessobrycon-amandae.name: Ember Tetra
notes: Item 13: 'very boisterous' is translated as 'sangat agresif'. This changes the meaning; use 'sangat lincah/heboh'.
Item 13: 'tidak akan mampu bersaing' turns 'will not compete well' into an absolute. Use 'kurang mampu bersaing'.
Item 5: 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai (backwater)' is wordy. 'Danau tapal kuda' is acceptable for oxbow, but 'danau oxbow' is also common.
Item 3: 'tidak terganggu' is weaker than 'not affected'. 'Most available' is also unclear. Use 'tidak terdampak'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki' is fine, but 'Mungkin tidak perlu sesering membersihkan akuarium ikan mas koki' is awkward. Rephrase it.
Item 12: 'Soal teman satu akuarium' is colloquial. 'Tankmate' is usually written 'tank mate' or 'penghuni akuarium lain'. Also 'bergerombol' vs 'berkelompok' is inconsistent.
Item 17: 'pemijah bebas yang menebar telur' is clumsy. 'Egg-scattering free spawner' is better as 'penebar telur'.
Item 1: the minimum tank size 'sekitar 38 liter' converts 10 gallons correctly, but the item 6 volume is a separate figure. Check that the two sizes are consistent.
Item 10: 'Anda' is used here but not elsewhere, and the register is inconsistent. 'Ikan muda dan indukan' is fine.

hyphessobrycon-eques.name: Serpae Tetra
notes: Item 11: "Disarankan kelompok 12–15 ekor ... tanpa spesies lain penghuni lapisan air atas" is fine, but "mungkin merupakan pilihan terbaik, tetapi pilihan lain yang mungkin termasuk" is clumsy and repeats "mungkin". Rephrase, e.g. "barangkali pilihan terbaik, sedangkan opsi lain meliputi...".
Item 11: "Kelompok minimal 12 ekor sebaiknya dianggap sebagai syarat minimum" is redundant. Use "Kelompok minimal 12 ekor dianggap sebagai syarat minimum".
Item 11: "ikan rainbow" should be "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)", the usual hobby term.
Item 11: "ikan beranak (livebearer)" is acceptable, but "lele callichthyid atau loricariid" should be clearer, e.g. "lele/ikan sapu-sapu" for loricariid.
Item 14: "Bagaimanapun, ikan ini memang indah" renders "after all" poorly. "Bagaimanapun" means "anyway/however". Use "Lagi pula, ikan ini memang indah".
Item 14: "warna merah bening seperti kristal" and "merah tembus pandang" are fine, but "Brillant" is kept with the German spelling. This is a trade name, so it is fine.
Item 10: "saling merusak sirip" loses the sense of ruffling/nipping. Use "saling menggigiti sirip".
Item 13: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" should be "filter spons berpenggerak udara". "pengasuhan induk" should be "tidak menjaga anakan".
Item 2: "Varian hias hasil penangkaran" says "captive-bred", but the source says "ornamental strains". Use "galur hias" to match item 15.
Item 7: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu krusial, meskipun warnanya cenderung..." leaves the subject unclear (the fish). Say "ikan ini cenderung menampilkan warna lebih bagus".

hyphessobrycon-herbertaxelrodi.name: Black Neon Tetra
notes: Item 7: 'Volume: sekitar 72 liter' is fine, but item 4: 'Sungai Sepotuba bermuara ... 500 kilometer di hulu Taquari' keeps the source typo-free; however 'Lokasi tipenya ada di daerah aliran sungai hulu rio Taquari' is OK. Real issue below.

Item 19: 'Lima et al. (2014)' — the English says 'Lima et al.'; fine, but 'tinggi badan kurang dari 3,6 kali dalam SL' is awkward; use 'tinggi badan kurang dari 1/3,6 SL' or 'SL lebih dari 3,6 kali tinggi badan'.
Item 19: 'maxilla' left untranslated; use 'tulang rahang atas (maxilla)'. 'Himpunan monofiletik' and 'monofilinya' are awkward; use 'kelompok monofiletik' and 'monofili'.

Item 19: 'asymmetrical, broad band' translated 'pita lebar yang tidak simetris' is fine, but 'lateral stripe ... padat dan tidak terputus' acceptable. 'Penulis lain... kebingungan besar masih ada' is stiff; rephrase 'masih banyak terjadi kebingungan'.
Item 15: 'manfish (angelfish)' — use 'angelfish' or 'manfish' consistent with hobby usage; 'Geophagus (eartheater)' is fine. 'teman satu akuarium' is awkward; use 'penghuni akuarium lain'.
Item 6: 'Echinoria' is rendered as in the source; 'tanaman air' for 'aquatic macrophytes' is acceptable. 'Salvinia' is a floating plant, fine.
Item 12: 'kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)' — Daphnia/Moina are commonly called 'kutu air' but be consistent; item 13 uses 'kutu air' for Daphnia only; ok.
Item 3: 'Neon tetra bisa sedikit lebih pemalu dan tinggal di setengah bagian bawah' — fine. Item 1: 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' acceptable.

hyphessobrycon-megalopterus.name: Black phantom tetra
notes: Item 3: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" is wrong in meaning for a hobby handbook; Daphnia is usually "kutu air" but Moina is "kutu air" too, so this is acceptable. Better to keep Daphnia and Moina as in the source without the generic gloss.
Item 1/11: "Sebagian besar catatannya" and "dibudidayakan" are fine. Better to use "tulang postorbital" and "bintik humeral" with the usual "bintik bahu" gloss for readability.

Item 2: "anak sungai utama rio Mamoré" for "main affluent" is fine. "yang mengalirkan air dari lahan basah" reverses the sense: the Guaporé drains the Pantanal wetland, so "yang menguras/mengalirkan air lahan basah tropis" would be clearer.

Item 8: "well-researched community aquarium" became "penghuninya sudah dipilih dengan cermat". This slightly changes the meaning. A closer rendering is "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan matang".
Item 10: "Karena itu, perilakunya lebih menarik dan warnanya lebih bagus" is fine. "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" is a bit vague, so write "matras plastik tipe 'rumput'".

hyphessobrycon-pulchripinnis.name: Lemon Tetra
notes: Item 8: 'each fish soon occupies a tiny territory' is rendered correctly, but 'Memelihara semua jenis lemon tetra' is fine. No change needed here; ignore.
Item 4: 'rio Tapajós basins' / 'municipalities' rendered as 'munisipalitas' – use 'kota/kabupaten (munisipalitas)' for natural Indonesian.
Item 17: 'crystal red' translated as 'merah jernih berkilau' – adds 'berkilau'; use 'merah jernih'.
Item 17: 'Pada Muzel tetra kuning, bercak humeral (di belakang tutup insang)' adds a fact not in the source ('di belakang tutup insang'); remove or keep only 'bercak humeral'.
Item 14: 'well-researched community aquarium' is translated as 'penghuninya dipilih berdasarkan riset yang matang'; simplify to 'akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan baik'.
Item 18: 'Zarske, 2008)[12]' kept; fine. But 'Weitzman & Palmer ... kemonofiletikannya' is awkward; use 'kemonofiletikan kelompok ini'.
Item 3: 'Jacare Acanga' versus 'Jacareacanga' in item 4 – spelling inconsistency between items (source also differs, but harmonise).

hyphessobrycon-rosaceus.name: Rosy Tetra
notes: "tampangnya sangat mirip": too colloquial for a handbook; use "penampilannya sangat mirip".
"tetra ini tetap berenang di akuarium": too literal; use "masih dipelihara di akuarium".
"dibiakkan oleh beberapa peternak": use "penangkar/pembiak" (hobbyist breeders), not "peternak" (livestock farmers).
"Ini bagus, karena dari Guyana... tidak ada impor atau hanya sangat sesekali": awkward and unclear; rephrase, e.g. "impor hanya terjadi sangat jarang atau tidak ada sama sekali".
"tetra phantom": better to follow the Indonesian hobby term order, e.g. "phantom tetra" like "rosy tetra"; the text is inconsistent.
"sailed under this name" → "Nama itu dipakai": the idiom is lost; this is acceptable but rather flat.

hyphessobrycon-sweglesi.name: Red Phantom Tetra
notes: Item 4: 'Kedua tipe biotop yang disebut terakhir' follows the English 'latter two', but the Indonesian sentence in the previous paragraph names river channel, lagoons and floodplain lakes, so the reference is ambiguous. Say 'laguna dan danau dataran banjir' explicitly.
Item 4: the English says morichals 'tend to contain transparent, clear water'. The translation 'umumnya berair jernih' drops 'transparent'. Minor.
Item 4: 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' is fine, but 'sering dikaitkan dengan habitat' reads stiffly. Use 'sering ditemukan di habitat'.
Item 12: 'Pigmen merah cerahnya tetap bertahan ... bukan hasil pengaruh pakan' is awkward. Use 'bukan akibat pakan'.
Item 12: 'salah satunya sangat berwarna' is unnatural for 'particularly colourful'. Use 'sangat mencolok warnanya'.
Item 12: 'kelompok dugaan ini' for 'putative assemblage' is hard to read. Use 'kelompok yang diduga ini'.
Item 12: 'garis keturunan polifiletik' and 'didirikan ... sebagai subgenus' are stiff but acceptable. Consider 'dibentuk'.

Item 12: 'jari-jari bercabang pada sirip dubur' and 'gigi premaksila' are fine. However, 'an irregular row of 9-10 premaxillary teeth' is rendered 'satu baris tidak teratur', adding 'satu' (one) where the English has 'an'. Acceptable but check.

Item 9: 'well-researched community aquarium' is rendered 'dirancang dengan cermat'. This changes the meaning slightly, from researched to carefully designed. Use 'direncanakan dengan matang' or 'dipelajari dengan baik'.
Item 11: 'Pemijah bebas yang menyebar telur dan tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan induk' is stiff. Use 'tidak merawat telur/anak'.

inpaichthys-kerri.name: Blue Emperor Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore atau"; the source says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "pada sore hari".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan teman setangki yang lebih agresif" drops the idea of "will not compete well" (as a caution). Consider "tidak mampu bersaing dengan ... yang lebih agresif".

iriatherina-werneri.name: Threadfin Rainbow
notes: Item 20: "harlequin rasboras (cá tam giác)" – the Vietnamese phrase was dropped; this is fine, but "angelfish" became "manfish" – use "angelfish/ikan manfish" consistently; "monos and scats" became "monos dan scat (ikan kiper)" – 'ikan kiper' is not scat; remove/fix.

Item 20: "Siamese algae eater", "paradise fish", "Panda garra", "clown killifish" left in English – give common Indonesian names/transliterations or put the English in brackets (e.g. "ikan paradise (Macropodus)").
Item 20: "Walaupun senang berkelompok ... Pelihara minimal 6 ekor (batas paling minimal)" is redundant; "agresif/heboh" for "boisterous" is loose – use "ribut/lincah".

Item 20: "Setelah persaingan selesai" ok; but "cupang menyukai suasana tenang ... threadfin rainbow senang bergerak" fine. "Jauhkan dari semua jenis lobster air tawar" – crayfish = udang karang/lobster air tawar OK.
Item 20: "Anakan udang berumur 1–2 minggu sudah terlalu besar untuk dimakan" fine; "udang kerdil" better "udang hias/dwarf shrimp".
Item 23: "Air yang sudah lama tidak diganti" for "Aged water" – ok; "filter spons bertenaga aerator" – better "filter busa (sponge filter) dengan aerator".
Item 10: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – better "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis/belum cycling"; "ikan ini pilihan yang sangat bagus" fine.
Item 15: "zooplankton lainnya" fine. Item 17: "sebagian diatom" mistranslates "some diatoms" ok; "artemia" for "brine shrimp" ok.
Item 5: "Sungai Merauke" – 'between the Merauke and the Fly Rivers' ok. Item 6: dropped "72–90 °F" fine.

Item 22: "sirip punggung dan sirip anal yang jauh lebih besar" fine; Item 26: "Jari-jari paling dalam sirip perut terhubung ... oleh selaput" awkward; "Pola warnanya terdiri dari ... (opak...)" 'opaque' pigment should be 'putih buram'.

kottelatia-brittani.name: Rasbora brittani
notes: Item 11: 'isi dengan air matang' is ambiguous or wrong. In Indonesian 'air matang' means boiled water, but 'mature water' means water from an established tank. Use 'air dari akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)'.
Item 11: 'Filter spons bertenaga udara (aerator)' wrongly equates the sponge filter with an aerator. Use 'filter spons yang digerakkan pompa udara' and drop '(aerator)'.
Item 11: 'wool mop' is left as English, and 'microworm' is also untranslated. Add an explanation or use a local term, e.g. 'mop wol/benang'.

kottelatlimia-hipporhynchos.name: Kottelatlimia hipporhynchos
notes: Item 5: "batu yang terkikis/halus oleh air (batu sungai)" is awkward, with a slash. Use "batu sungai yang halus terkikis air".
Item 3: "Namun, bila spesies tersebut menghuni..." is a weak contrast. Use "sedangkan spesies tersebut menghuni... K. hipporhynchos teramati...".
Item 3: "hutan kerangas dataran rendah campuran" is a slightly awkward rendering of "mixed lowland heath forest". "Hutan kerangas dataran rendah campuran" is acceptable but could be clearer.
Item 8: "riset yang matang" is unnatural. Use "riset yang cermat/teliti".

Item 11: "duri ini bisa tersangkut di jaring akuarium dan ... bisa menembus kulit manusia" is fine. "sedangkan 'dikoleksi'" is OK. "Lepidocephalichthys pristes kemudian dipindahkan" lacks the destination genus, but this is faithful to the source.
Item 1: "kerabat satu genusnya" is clumsy. Use "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama" or "spesies lain dalam genusnya".

kottelatlimia-pristes.name: Kottelatlimia pristes
notes: Item 2: the English says 'Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan) province'. The Indonesian keeps only 'Provinsi Kalimantan Selatan'. Minor omission, but fine to restore.
Item 2: the English says 'Barat, Kalimantan'. 'Barat' is left dangling in the type locality. Consider 'Kalimantan Barat'.
Item 3: 'rawa gambut air tawar biasa maupun blackwater' is awkward, and 'biasa' is added. Use 'rawa gambut air tawar maupun rawa gambut blackwater'.
Item 3: 'bila spesies tersebut menghuni hamparan pasir terbuka' loses the contrast in 'whereas'. Use 'sedangkan spesies itu menghuni...'.
Item 5: 'batu sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward. Use 'batu sungai yang halus karena terkikis air' or 'batu kali'.
Item 5: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' adds 'nitrogen cycle'. The English says only 'biologically immature set-ups'. Simplify.
Item 11: 'nama-nama dagang yang muluk' for 'fanciful names' is slightly odd. Consider 'nama-nama dagang yang mengada-ada' or 'nama karangan'.
Item 11: 'ke arah belakang' for 'posterior projections' is ambiguous. Clarify as 'tonjolan posterior'.
Item 11: 'Lepidocephalichthys pristes kemudian dipindahkan oleh...' is fine, but 'sungut hidung' is a non-standard term for 'nasal barbel'. Consider 'sungut nasal'.
Item 7: 'predator mikro' for 'micropredator' is acceptable. 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is fine.

kryptopterus-bicirrhis.name: Lais kaca
notes: Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – 'biologically immature' is rendered more specifically than the source; acceptable but 'belum matang secara biologis' is closer. Minor.
Item 8: "terlalu aktif dan agresif" – 'boisterous' means rowdy/lively; "agresif" adds a fact (aggression) not in the source. Use "terlalu lincah/heboh".
Item 5: "bisa jadi gampang kaget" is awkward; use "mudah kaget/gugup". "perubahan kualitas air yang naik-turun" narrows 'water chemistry'; use "fluktuasi parameter kimia air".
Item 3: "kompleks danau Danau Sentarum" is redundant; use "kompleks danau Sentarum".
Item 1: "lele dari famili Siluridae" – 'silurid catfish' fine, but 'Kepulauan Sunda Besar' vs. item 2 'pulau-pulau Sunda Besar' is inconsistent; unify.
Item 11: "kelompok spesies dugaan" is stiff for 'putative species groups'; use "kelompok spesies yang diduga" (or "putatif").

Item 4: the 243 litre volume is unchecked; 120×45 cm gives about 243 L only at a ~45 cm height. Fine, but 'paling kecil yang layak dipertimbangkan' is slightly loose for 'should be the smallest considered'.

kryptopterus-cryptopterus.name: Ikan lais
notes: Item 20: 'extending beyond tip of pectoral-fin' is rendered 'melewati ujung sirip dada' but the English comparison is 'short barbels (to pectoral base) vs. beyond tip'; this is fine. The real error is item 7: 'biologically immature aquarium' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang', which adds a specific claim; use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 1: 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' is acceptable, but 'Size: 200 mm (7.9 in) SL' dropped the inches, which is fine. No error here.
Item 2/20: 'silurid catfish' is rendered 'lais dari famili Siluridae'. This is fine, but in item 13 'lele/catfish Asia' is wrong: Mystus is not a lele (Clarias), so use 'catfish Asia' or 'baung'.
Item 6: the volume '~243 litres' is the English figure left unchanged, so it is fine. The base size needs no change.

Item 12: 'Tubifex' is rendered 'cacing sutra'. Tubifex is commonly called 'cacing sutra' in Indonesia, so this is fine. Item 12 also says 'dan mungkin sesekali cacing tanah kecil', which is acceptable.
Item 14: 'cyprinid' and 'loach' are left in English; use 'ikan cyprinid (suku karper)' and 'ikan loach (botia)' for readability.

Item 3: 'DAS Mekong dan Chao Phraya' is fine, but the English is 'basins' of the rivers, so no change is needed. Item 16: 'informasi lainnya' should be 'informasi tambahan', since the original says additional information.

kryptopterus-vitreolus.name: Lele kaca
notes: "karena arah cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas betul" – the source says "the interaction of light and movement of the fish must fit exactly"; consider "interaksi cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas" to stay closer to the original.

"seorang penghobi bergelar sarjana biologi" – the source says "a keeper with a degree in biology"; fine in meaning, but "pemelihara" or "aquascaper" is not needed. Keep "penghobi" and consider "lulusan biologi" as more natural.
"Dari kebiasaan ini" – the source says "In this context"; "Dalam kegiatan ini" would be more faithful, since it was not a habit that led to the discovery.

labeo-chrysophekadion.name: Black Shark
notes: Item 14: "Despite the zoological relationship" is mistranslated as "secara zoologi tidak berkerabat dengan hiu" (reversed/added meaning); fix to something like "Meskipun ada hubungan kekerabatan zoologis (dengan hiu)..." or follow source intent: not a shark, yet the name fits.
Item 2: "600 mm" should be converted to metric-friendly "60 cm" for consistency with the handbook (item 1 uses cm/kg).
Item 12: "lebih tinggi/gemuk" leaves a slash alternative; choose one, e.g. "bertubuh lebih tinggi (lebih gempal)".
Item 11: "bisa suka berkelahi" is awkward; use "bisa agresif/suka berkelahi".

Item 15: "anakan seluruhnya hitam" fine, but "subfamili cyprinid Cyprininae yang masih bersifat dugaan" misplaces "putative"; it modifies the subfamily classification, rephrase "subfamili Cyprininae (yang diduga) dalam cyprinid".
Item 10: "merumput aufwuchs" and "kutu air" for Daphnia are acceptable but "Daphnia" is better kept as the Latin name; "zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar" - blanched is fine.
Item 3: "anakannya" for juveniles is OK, but "pemilik akuarium yang benar-benar besar" reads as the owners being big; use "pemilik akuarium yang benar-benar besar ukurannya".

labidochromis-caeruleus.name: Labidochromis caeruleus
notes: Item 11: "cichlid Danau Rift" reads as if the lake is called Rift. Use "cichlid danau-danau Rift Valley" or "cichlid Great Rift Lakes".
Item 10: "memuntahkan telur/burayak" mixes two terms. Use "memuntahkan telur atau burayak".
Item 7: "mau menerima sebagian besar pakan" is slightly stiff. Use "mau memakan sebagian besar jenis pakan".

labiobarbus-fasciatus.name: Lambak
notes: Unit 3: "bagian mulut lunak yang khas" adds "khas" for "unique"; fine but "unculi" could be glossed as "unculi (tonjolan bertanduk kecil)".
Unit 1: "ikan cyprinid" could use the local term "ikan cyprinid (suku Cyprinidae)"; minor.
Unit 3: "sebaiknya tetap didahulukan" slightly softens "should continue to take precedence"; consider "tetap diutamakan".

labiobarbus-ocellatus.name: Arengan
notes: Item 8: 'SF members who have kept it report' became 'Penghobi yang pernah memeliharanya melaporkan' - acceptable, but 'teman setangki' is non-standard; use 'penghuni akuarium lain'.

Item 7: 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' - Daphnia is usually 'kutu air' but ok; 'blanched spinach' as 'direbus sebentar (blansir)' fine. 'courgette' as 'zukini' fine. 'pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran' redundant: 'granules' = 'granul', not 'pelet butiran'.

Item 5: 'tatanan' for 'set-up' and 'paling ideal dipelihara' awkward; 'merumput' for graze is odd; 'bongkahan batu besar yang halus terkikis air' is clumsy - use 'batu besar yang halus terkikis arus'.
Item 4: 'Volume: ~304 liter' - consistent with source; 'dibutuhkan akuarium dengan ukuran dasar lebih dari 150 × 45 cm' fine.
Item 2/3: 'Type locality ... Borneo' translated 'Lokasi tipe' - use 'lokalitas tipe'. Also 'Borneo' vs 'Kalimantan' inconsistent within the same text.
Item 9: 'lebih tinggi/tebal' - slash hedging; choose 'lebih tinggi badannya'.
Item 11: 'ocellus (seperti mata)' and 'Labeonin' left unexplained; 'tanpa garis atau tepi hitam pada kedua cuping ekornya' OK. 'unculi' term unchanged is fine.
Item 12: reference list untranslated is allowed.

laides-hexanema.name: Laides hexanema
notes: "Lokasi tipe: Palembang, Batavia" is acceptable, but "Type locality" is better as "Lokasi tipe (type locality)" or "Lokalitas tipe" for hobbyists; minor.
"mandibular" and "mental" are left untranslated. Use "sungut rahang bawah (mandibula)" and "sungut dagu (mental)".
"keturunan dari" for "descendant of" is a bit awkward. Use "turunan dari" or "keturunan".
"jarak antarmata" for interorbital distance is fine, but "47,0–55,6%" lacks the "HL" unit, as in the source. This is faithful, so optionally add HL.

lentipes-ikeae.name: Lentipes ikeae
notes: Item 5: "GH ≤ 4 °d" and "KH ≤ 2 °d" – Indonesian hobbyists usually write °dGH / °dKH (or dGH/dKH); consider using that form.
Item 7: "Karnivora, pemangsa mikro" is slightly awkward; consider "Karnivora, pemangsa mikro" → "Pemangsa mikro karnivora".
Item 7: "mungkin juga mau menerima" is wordy; use "mungkin mau menerima".
Item 8: "hillstream loach" and "danionin" are left in English; consider "loach sungai pegunungan" and "danio".
Item 8: "gurami" is an imprecise rendering of gouramis; consider "gurami" with the English term in brackets if needed.
Item 10: the two sentences are redundant and contradictory in strength ("sangat sulit" vs. "tidak dapat"). This mirrors the source, so keep it, but the phrasing could be smoother.

lepidocephalichthys-furcatus.name: Forktail Loach
notes: Item 5: volume "sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but "Dibutuhkan ukuran alas 45 × 30 cm atau lebih" is okay; no issue. The main issue is elsewhere.
Item 12: "duri tajam yang bisa digerakkan di bawah mata" is fine, but "loach 'sejati'" is acceptable; the phrase "Šlechtová et al." is kept in English, which is fine in context.
Item 6: "batu yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu sungai yang halus/membulat" or "batu yang terkikis air".

Item 4: "danau tapal kuda" for oxbow is rare in hobby use; use "oxbow" or "kolam bekas meander sungai". "air tergenang" for stagnant duplicates the earlier flooding sense, so use "air menggenang/tidak mengalir".
Item 9: "riset yang matang mutlak diperlukan" is stiff; use "sangat penting mencari informasi dulu". "agresif dengan cara lain" is awkward; use "atau agresif".
Item 4: "alga makrofit" is imprecise for macrophytic algae; use "alga makroskopis/tanaman air berlebih".
Item 9: "Mereka paling baik dipelihara bersama sesama jenisnya" is slightly unnatural; use "Ikan ini paling baik dipelihara berkelompok dengan sesama spesiesnya".

lepidocephalichthys-hasselti.name: Hasselt's loach
notes: Item 5: "approximately 54 litres" is kept, but 60 × 30 cm base alone doesn't give 54 L. This is the source's figure, so it's fine as is.
Item 2/6: "loach" is left in English and is acceptable, though "ikan loach" would read more naturally.
Item 4: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" is awkward. Use "kolam/danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" or "meander yang terpisah".
Item 4: "dikoleksi" is stiff. Use "ditangkap/dikumpulkan".
Item 6: "batu yang halus terkikis air" is clumsy. Use "batu kali yang halus terkikis air".
Item 9: "burayak" is correct but "anakan" is more common among hobbyists.
Item 9: "teman setangki" is a calque. Use "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama".

leptobarbus-hoevenii.name: Ikan jelawat
notes: Item 3/10: "cukup mudah kaget" for "skittish" is OK, but "ikan cyprinid" is untranslated jargon; use "ikan sejenis karper/cyprinidae" for clarity (minor).
Item 8 says "minimal 3 m" while item 2 says "minimal 2 m" – this inconsistency is in the source, but check that it is intended and not an error.
Item 3: "800–1000 mm" and "100–150 mm" kept in mm; better convert to cm (80–100 cm, 10–15 cm) for consistency with item 1.
Item 3/9/20: "sirip dubur" is OK, but "ikan pancingan" for "sport fish" should be "ikan buruan/ikan pancing olahraga (sport fishing)".
Item 1 translates "Cigar Shark" and "Mad Barb" with "jelawat" first; jelawat in Indonesia is Leptobarbus hoevenii, fine, but Item 20 says 'mad barb' without mentioning 'jelawat' - inconsistent.
Item 14: "kutu air (Daphnia)" is acceptable; "zukini yang direbus sebentar" fine. Item 15: "gerombolan yang megah" is awkward; use "kawanan yang indah".
Item 13: "urusan pakannya tidak bermasalah" is colloquial; use "tidak sulit dalam hal pakan".
Item 16: "kemungkinan besar akan dimakan" is ambiguous; the English says "are likely to be eaten" so use "berisiko dimakan".

luciocephalus-pulcher.name: Pikehead
notes: Item 7: 'Leave a gap of a few inches' became 'beberapa cm'. The unit is converted but the figure is not (a few inches is about 5–8 cm). Give a sensible metric figure such as 'sekitar 5–8 cm'.

Item 7: the sentence 'Ikan ini butuh lapisan udara lembap... dan ikan ini juga jago melompat' loses the causal link ('as not only... but also'). Link the gap to the humid air layer and the jumping, e.g. 'karena ikan ini butuh lapisan udara lembap di atas airnya dan juga jago melompat'.

Item 1: 'despite being always hungry' is rendered as 'meskipun selalu lapar'. 'Pasti bakal jadi favorit' is too colloquial. Use 'tentu akan menjadi ikan akuarium favorit' and keep the original 'sensitive fish of all' wording.

Item 1: 'feeds preferably on shrimps' became 'paling suka memangsa udang', which is acceptable. 'Ikan akuarium favorit meskipun selalu lapar' is awkward, so rephrase it as 'meskipun selalu lapar'. The colloquial 'bakal' and 'cuma' register is too informal for a handbook (also in items 3, 10 and 11).

Item 5: 'often stagnant' is attached to 'air' and reads as 'yang airnya sering tergenang'. 'Airnya di biotop purba ini' is awkward word order. Rephrase as 'Air di biotop purba ini biasanya berwarna cokelat gelap...'.
Item 6: 'sekitar 108 liter' is correct. The informal 'Ukuran akuarium minimal yang sebaiknya dipertimbangkan' is a little stilted but acceptable.

Item 14: 'Luciocephalinae along with Colisa, Trichogaster...' is rendered as 'subfamili Luciocephalinae (famili Osphronemidae)'. The English says 'Osphronemid subfamily', so this is fine. However, 'Tiga genus yang disebut terakhir punya struktur telur yang sama... dan struktur ini unik' is acceptable. 'Burayak' for fry is fine.
Item 9: 'perfectly-adapted niche predator' became 'predator dengan adaptasi khusus yang sempurna', which is slightly altered but acceptable. 'Kamuflase yang sangat baik sampai ada korban' is fine.

luciosoma-spilopleura.name: Apollo shark
notes: Item 2: the English gives "East Kalimantan (Kalimantan Tengah)", and the translation drops the parenthetical. Mention it or flag the source inconsistency. This is minor.
Item 3: "batu, bebatuan" for "rocks, stones" is repetitive. Consider "bongkahan batu, batu kecil, dan kerikil".

lysmata-debelius.name: Fire Shrimp
notes: Item 7: "giant moray eels" translated as "belut moray raksasa" – 'belut' is wrong for moray (they are not true eels in common Indonesian usage); use "ikan moray" / "remang"; "giant" fine.
Item 7: "large flame cardinalfish ... berukuran besar" - 'ikan besar seperti flame cardinalfish berukuran besar' is redundant/awkward; rephrase.

Item 7: "mematuki sisik dan kulit mati" is OK, but "Karang SPS" and "buntal" mixed with English names (triggerfish, hawkfish, wrasse, lionfish) inconsistent; use "ikan pakol/triggerfish", "buntal" etc. consistently.
Item 3: "Akuarium yang lebih besar dengan struktur karang yang besar lebih disarankan" is stiff; 'struktur karang' (reef structures) could be 'struktur batu karang'.
Item 6: "Mereka memakan sisik dan kulit yang mereka bersihkan" - repetitive; simplify.

Item 9: "Marine Cuisine" fine; but "berenang dengan telson di depan dan posisi terbalik" ok; "phototrophic" rendered "fototrofik" - should be 'fototaksis/tertarik cahaya' (positively phototactic) for clarity.

Item 10: "kulit lamanya (eksoskeleton) jangan dibuang" - 'eksoskeleton' should be 'eksoskeleton/kerangka luar' ok; but "statusnya terancam punah" should be 'endangered' = 'terancam' consistent with wording; minor.

macrognathus-aculeatus.name: Ikan Sili
notes: Item 1: "unik" for "bizarre fishes" loses the 'odd/strange' nuance; use "aneh" or "unik/tak lazim" – minor.
Item 2: "Sili-sili" and "Sili" for spiny eels; hobbyists often say "tilan" (Mastacembelidae) – note the term variant; Macrognathus are commonly called "tilan"/"sili", consider consistency.
Item 6: "ikan kecil dianggap sebagai tambahan makanan" is stiff; better "ikan kecil dianggap mangsa/makanan tambahan".
Item 6: "berdempetan" for "cuddle" is acceptable but "suka bergelung bersama" is more natural.
Item 5: "Pakan terbaik adalah pakan beku dan pakan hidup" is awkward; use "Sebaiknya beri pakan beku dan pakan hidup".

macrognathus-maculatus.name: Macrognathus maculatus
notes: Item 3: "Hanya ikan yang sangat kecil yang sebaiknya tidak dicampur dengannya" is clumsy. Use "Hanya ikan yang sangat kecil yang tidak boleh dipelihara bersama sili".
Item 4: "Jantan dan betina bisa dibedakan dengan jelas" leaves out "fully sexually differentiated". It is acceptable but loose. Say "dimorfisme seksual jelas" or "jenis kelamin mudah dibedakan".
Item 1: "punya sirip yang menyatu melingkar" is awkward for "circumferential fin". Use "sirip yang menyatu mengelilingi tubuh" or "sirip punggung, ekor, dan anal yang menyatu".
Item 5: "revisi taksonomi" adds "taxonomic", which the source does not say. It is minor. Use "revisi terbaru".

macropodus-opercularis.name: Ikan Paradise
notes: Item 12: "cacing sutra" for "blackworms" is inexact. Cacing sutra is usually Tubifex, and blackworms are Lumbriculus. Use "blackworm" or "cacing hitam".
Item 8: "kayu apung" for "Driftwood" can be read as wood that floats. Use "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendaman".
Item 14: "urutan hierarki" is redundant for "pecking order". Use "hierarki dominansi" or "urutan dominansi".
Item 2: "LC (Risiko Rendah)" would be better as "Berisiko Rendah", the usual Indonesian wording for Least Concern.

marosatherina-ladigesi.name: Beseng-beseng
notes: #10: "bertelur beberapa butir setiap hari" adds "a few"; the source says only "batches of eggs each day" (e.g. "bertelur dalam beberapa kelompok setiap hari" or just "bertelur setiap hari").
#10: "pakan yang melayang" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off; "pakan hidup yang aktif berenang" would be closer.
#1/#11: "peternakan (ikan)" for fish farms is unusual; hobbyists say "tempat budidaya" or "penangkaran".
#7: "ia mau menerima" is stiff; "mau memakan" is more natural.

mastacembelus-armatus.name: Tilan Tire Track
notes: Item 5: "spiny eel sering suka membenamkan diri" is redundant (sering + suka); use "sering membenamkan diri" or "cenderung suka".
Item 5: "air payau ringan" is awkward; use "air payau dengan salinitas rendah" (or "sedikit payau").

Item 1/11: "Tilan tire track" mixes local and English; the English name is left untranslated and the Indonesian term "tilan" is used inconsistently across items (e.g. "peacock eel" and "Tanganyikan spiny eel" stay in English). Consider "belut duri" or "tilan" consistently, with English in brackets.
Item 5: "Tutup akuarium yang rapat wajib dipakai" is stiff; rephrase to "Akuarium wajib ditutup rapat".
Item 7: "lancefish" and "krill" are left in English without a gloss; add "ikan lancefish (sand lance)" or a local equivalent.
Item 7: "menopang ikan yang sudah besar" is awkward; use "memenuhi kebutuhan gizi ikan yang sudah besar".
Item 4: "Panjang standar 91 cm" is correct, but the volume is stated without litre/gallon context. This is fine, so no change is needed here beyond smoothing the wording.
Item 3: "sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine, but "sungai kecil maupun besar" slightly changes "streams and rivers"; use "anak sungai dan sungai".

mastacembelus-erythrotaenia.name: Fire Eel
notes: Item 1/11: "ikan sili (spiny eel)" is a dubious local name. Family Mastacembelidae is usually called "ikan tilan" or "belut duri" (sili is a different fish). Use "tilan"/"belut duri".
Item 5: "ikan sili sering suka membenamkan diri" is redundant (sering suka). Also use the same term as elsewhere. Suggest "sering membenamkan diri".
Item 5: "ditanami tanaman air dengan rapat" is awkward. Suggest "ditanami cukup rimbun".
Item 7: "lancefish" is left untranslated. Add a local equivalent such as "ikan lance (sand lance)".
Item 8: "teman satu akuarium cukup besar" is fine, but "sesamanya" for conspecifics is vague. Use "sesama spesiesnya".
Item 10: "berhasil berkembang biak" is stronger than the source. Suggest "pernah berkembang biak" or "memijah". Also change "Sesekali pernah" to "Pernah sesekali".
Item 4: "±432 liter" uses ± where the source has ~. Use "sekitar 432 liter".

maylandia-estherae.name: Red Zebra
notes: Item 10: "Care must be taken, if you decide to move the fish... harassment by the males" is rendered as "memindahkan betina... betina tidak diganggu jantan", which narrows the meaning. The source says the fish in general, not only the female.

Item 10: "dissipate this aggression" became "menyebarkan agresi". That is fine, but the sentence "Jantan cukup agresif saat mengejar betina" slightly changes the nuance of "quite vigorous in his pursuits".
Item 10: "Maternal mouthbrooder" became "pengeram mulut induk betina". This is awkward; use "pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder) oleh induk betina".

Item 10: "Some breeders artificially strip the fry... at the 2 week stage" became "mengeluarkan burayak secara paksa". "Secara paksa" is too harsh for an artificial method; use "secara manual/buatan".
Item 11: "Mbuna yang memang pantas populer" is stiff. Use "Mbuna yang populer dan memang layak".

Item 11: "jantan oranye dan OB" (item 1) says "orange and OB males occur", but "yellow or OB females" is missing from item 1. That is acceptable as a summary, but the item 11 and item 1 colour descriptions are inconsistent.
Item 8: "The tank should be overcrowded" was rendered with the English term "(overcrowded)" in brackets. "Padat tebar" would be the more natural hobby term.
Item 8: "peace loving species" became "spesies yang damai". The wording is fine, but "Peacock atau Utaka" should be clarified as cichlid groups.
Item 3: "karang-karang batu" is awkward for "reefs" in a freshwater lake. Use "area bebatuan/terumbu batu".
Item 1: "bisa kawin silang (hibrida)" is a clumsy use of the noun "hibrida". Use "bisa berhibridisasi".

melanotaenia-boesemani.name: Rainbow Boesemani
notes: Item 8: "ikan lele seperti Corydoras" is imprecise. Hobbyists would write "corydoras" or "lele hias (catfish) seperti Corydoras".
Item 10: "pakan yang melayang di air" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off. Better "pakan hidup yang berenang bebas seperti naupli artemia".
Item 11: "sangat dirugikan oleh perdagangan ikan hias" is a little loose. A clearer rendering is "perdagangan ikan hias berdampak sangat buruk pada spesies ini".

melanotaenia-picta.name: Rainbow Picta
notes: Item 2: "Melanotaenia goldiei group of New Guinea" rendered as "dari Papua"; Papua is only the Indonesian half of New Guinea, so use "dari Nugini" / "Papua Nugini" to avoid changing the geography.
Item 1: "hibrida" is acceptable, but "hibrid/persilangan" is more common among hobbyists; "terjadi hibrida" is slightly awkward, so use "terbentuk hibrida (persilangan)".
Item 6: "sebanding dengan kebanyakan ikan rainbow lainnya" is awkward for care comparison; use "mirip dengan" or "kurang lebih sama dengan" instead.
Item 3: "hampir tidak ada tumbuhan air" is fine, but the original says vegetation in general, not specifically aquatic plants; "vegetasi" would be more faithful.

melanotaenia-praecox.name: Rainbow Praecox
notes: Item 15: "filter shrimp" is left in English; use "udang filter" or "udang bamboo (filter shrimp)".
Item 18: "Filter kecil bertenaga aerator" is clumsy; use "filter udara kecil (air-powered)" or "filter busa dengan aerator".
Item 18: "pakan yang melayang di air" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off; use "pakan yang bergerak bebas/berenang aktif" for live nauplii.
Item 8: "minimal akuarium sekitar 110 liter" reads awkwardly; use "atau paling kecil akuarium sekitar 110 liter".
Item 15: "manfish" for angelfish is a non-standard hobby term; use "angelfish" or "ikan manfish (angelfish)".

microdevario-kubotai.name: Rasbora Kubotai
notes: Item 6: the English sentence 'In the Suriya the water is well-oxygenated, slightly turbid' is rendered correctly, but 'Such habitats tend to comprise transparent water' became 'berair jernih'. That is fine. The real problem is item 8: 'biologically immature set-up' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This adds detail, but it is acceptable. A fuller fix is 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.

Item 1: 'maximum size of around 2.5 to 4 cm (1 to 1.5 inches)' was kept as 2,5–4 cm. That is correct. However, 'kadang bisa cukup merepotkan' for 'can make them difficult at times' is vague. Use 'kadang sulit dipelihara'.
Item 3: 'Mae Khlong and Mae Klong' are the same river spelled two ways. 'daerah aliran anak sungai Mae Khlong dan Mae Klong' reads oddly, but it matches the source, so leave it.

Item 4: the type locality is left entirely in English, including the coordinate '98°41'11'E'. It is untranslated English in running text. Translate the descriptive words ('Khlong Phrae Sai di Ban Kreo Noi, kilometer 8 pada jalan bercabang ke timur, 32 kilometer di utara Ranong ...') and keep the place names.
Item 4: 'daerah hulu Khwae Noi' for 'upper Khwae Noi watershed' drops 'watershed'. Use 'daerah aliran Sungai Khwae Noi bagian hulu'.
Item 11: 'aquascape hardscape' is awkward and does not mean a hardscape-only tank. Use 'akuarium dengan hardscape (batu dan kayu)'.
Item 15: 'paling baik dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)' is slightly ambiguous. 'sendiri' could be read as a single fish. Use 'dipelihara satu spesies saja'.
Item 16: 'bertubuh lebih tinggi' for 'deeper-bodied' is acceptable. 'lebih ramping' for the males is not in the source ('more compact'). Use 'lebih kompak'.
Item 7: 60 × 30 cm base at 54 litres is plausible only for a ~30 cm tall tank. Check that the figure matches the source.

mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.name: Ramirezi
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 60 cm" for "a couple of feet across" is acceptable, but "lebar" is odd; use "berdiameter sekitar 60 cm".
Item 9: "kemerahmudaan" is non-standard and awkward; use "bercak merah muda".
Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "biologically immature" is more commonly "belum matang secara biologis / belum cycling"; consider adding "(cycling)".
Item 5: "tidak satu pun berasal dari Amerika Selatan" is correct; "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari" reads clumsy, use "hindari pergantian air dalam volume sangat besar".
Item 10: "memakan telur atau anaknya" adds "or fry" (source says brood, so acceptable), but "mikroworm" should be "cacing mikro (microworm)".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the usual hobby term; "kerang-kerangan" for shellfish is vague (could include crustaceans), use "kerang dan udang-udangan/seafood".
Item 11: "klad" is unusual for hobbyists; use "klade". "Kullander (1998) memakai Mikrogeophagus ... sedangkan Microgeophagus sensu Frey ..." slightly alters the sentence flow but meaning kept.
Item 1: "Ram atau ramirezi" adds a name not in the source ("The ram"); acceptable but could be "Ram" only.

moenkhausia-sanctaefilomenae.name: Red Eye Tetra
notes: Item 11: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the English says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "menjelang malam".
Item 3: "Inggris" for "the UK" is slightly imprecise; "Britania Raya" or "Inggris (UK)" would be more exact.

monetaria-annulus.name: Gold Ring Cowrie
notes: Item 8: "These snails are primarily herbivorous" is rendered "terutama herbivora", but item 1 gives "Omnivora/detritivora". The English is inconsistent too, but the translator could harmonise it.
Item 7: "rock pools" became "cekungan batu karang". "Kolam pasang surut" (tide pools), used in item 3, would be more natural.
Item 7: "seagrass leaves" became "daun lamun". This is fine, but "clean-up crew" is left in English in item 8. Use "pasukan pembersih" or add the English term in brackets after the Indonesian one.
Item 6: "magnesium 1250–1350" has no unit. The English has none either, so add "ppm" (mg/L) for clarity.
Item 5: "bulldoze through corals" became "menabrak dan mendorong karang". This is slightly awkward. Use something like "menggeser/merobohkan karang".
Item 1: "Jenis air: SG ..." is imprecise. Use "Salinitas (SG)" or "Berat jenis air".
Item 9: "jinak" for "docile" is acceptable but a little odd for a snail. "Tenang" would read more naturally.

monodactylus-sebae.name: Mono Sebae
notes: Item 1: "bisa berpindah dengan bebas" is fine, but "hasil penangkaran" for "offspring" is acceptable; consider "keturunan hasil budidaya" for naturalness.
Item 2: "sudah memijah" for "are spawning" is okay; "troop" rendered as "kelompok" is fine, but consider "gerombolan" (schooling term) for hobby usage.

Item 5: "memijah bebas tanpa merawat anakan" — "free spawners" is better as "penebar telur (free spawner) tanpa perawatan induk"; "telurnya melayang bebas" slightly changes "spawn swims around" (spawn here may mean eggs/larvae, which swim), so use "telur/larva berenang di air".

monopterus-albus.name: Belut sawah
notes: Item 7: "lancefish" is left as English with no explanation; consider adding a local equivalent or a short gloss such as "ikan lancefish (sand lance)".
Item 11: "belut rawa" (for swamp eels) and "belut sawah" (for the same species elsewhere) are used inconsistently; pick one name.

mystacoleucus-obtusirostris.name: Genggehek
notes: Item 7: 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' — wrong/ambiguous; Indonesian hobbyists use 'daphnia' (or 'kutu air' loosely), but keep the Latin name Daphnia unchanged.
Item 7: 'pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran kering' — 'granules' rendered redundantly as 'pelet butiran'; use 'pelet'/'granul'.
Item 11: 'sinonim subjektif simultan' — 'simultaneous subjective synonym' is correct but 'simultan' is stiff; consider 'sinonim subjektif sezaman'.
Item 5: 'batu-batu sungai yang halus' — 'water-worn' means rounded/smoothed by water, not fine; use 'batu sungai yang membulat/terkikis air'.

Item 1: 'ikan cyprinid sungai' — use 'ikan sirip-cyprinid' or 'anggota suku Cyprinidae'; also 'Tiongkok barat daya' fine, but 'puluhan tahun' fine. Item 1 'duri di depan sirip punggung yang mengarah ke depan' omits 'procumbent' (rebah) nuance used in item 11.
Item 4: 'Volumenya sekitar 243 liter' — the original dimension 120 × 45 cm with 243 L implies 45 cm height; fine, but check 48×18 conversion omitted is allowed. No issue.
Item 8: 'loach' left in English — prefer 'ikan loach' or 'ikan botia/lepu' as used locally.
Item 11: 'Mystacoleucus spp. juga bisa dikenali' fine; 'bisa tersangkut di jaring akuarium' fine.

mystus-bimaculatus.name: Two Spot Mystus
notes: Item 1: "Peternak komersial baru berhasil membiakkannya" – "baru" adds the nuance 'only just'; the English says 'only by hormone injection'. Use "hanya berhasil membiakkannya dengan suntikan hormon".
Item 5: "Yang wajib adalah" is a bit stiff, and "nyaman" for 'quite happily' is slightly off; consider "Yang mutlak diperlukan adalah" and "tetap dapat hidup dengan baik tanpanya".
Item 10: "yang mungkin dapat memicu pemijahan" is awkward and the hedging is doubled (mungkin dapat); use "yang kemungkinan dapat memicu pemijahan" or restructure the sentence.
Item 1/8: "ikan lele" for catfish is acceptable, but "Two spot mystus" is left as English with no local naming; consider adding the italic/trade-name form.
Item 4: "Alas akuarium" is non-standard; use "Ukuran dasar akuarium" or "Luas alas akuarium".

mystus-bleekeri.name: Day's Mystus
notes: Item 1/11: "lele bagrid" is awkward; bagrid catfish are not true lele (Clariidae). Prefer "ikan bagrid" or "lele bagrid" with a note.
Item 5: "Parameter kimia air relatif tidak penting" is slightly stiff; prefer "Kimia air tidak terlalu penting".
Item 7: "tidak rewel soal makanan" is a bit colloquial; consider "tidak pilih-pilih makanan".
Item 1/8: "lebih berani tampil" for "more outgoing" is slightly loose; consider "lebih aktif/lebih berani keluar".
Item 11: "kurang dihargai" is okay but "kurang mendapat perhatian" is more natural for "underrated".

mystus-gulio.name: Lundu
notes: Item 10: "Least Concern" rendered as "Risiko Rendah"; the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah (LC)". Check the wording.
Item 10: "He included only eight species" became "Ia hanya memasukkan"; "Ia" is ambiguous after the list of other authors. Use "Roberts hanya memasukkan..." or "Ia" with clearer reference.
Item 11: "ikan hias... tradisional": "artisan fisheries" is better rendered as "perikanan skala kecil/artisanal" than "tradisional".
Item 6: "Mungkin memangsa ikan yang sangat kecil" is slightly vague; use "Dapat memangsa ikan yang sangat kecil".

mystus-singaringan.name: Senggaringan
notes: #4: "Volume: ~243 liter" – 120×45×45 cm is 243 L, fine; but "300 mm SL" should be converted/expressed in cm ("30 cm SL") for consistency with the hobby handbook's metric style.
#1: "Ukurannya bisa mencapai sekitar 300 mm" – hobbyists in Indonesia normally write "sekitar 30 cm"; consider converting.
#1/#8: "lele bagrid" – "lele" is a different catfish (Clariidae); better use "ikan patin/baung" or keep "bagrid catfish" (baung is the common local name for Mystus/Hemibagrus).
#5: "pot tanah liat" – English "flowerpots"; fine, but "wajib diberi" is stronger than "must be provided"; consider "harus diberi".

myxocyprinus-asiaticus.name: Chinese Hi-Fin Banded Shark
notes: "Semua ikan yang diperdagangkan berasal dari budi daya dan merupakan hasil penangkaran" is redundant; budi daya and penangkaran say the same thing. Use one, e.g. "berasal dari hasil penangkaran/budi daya".
"mighty dorsal fin" became "sirip punggung besar", which loses the sense of a strong or imposing fin. Consider "sirip punggung yang megah/kokoh".
"semua ikan ini yang beredar di perdagangan" is awkward word order. Use "semua ikan jenis ini yang beredar di perdagangan" or similar.
"Chinese Whimple Carp" and "Batman-Loach" are left in English with no local name or explanation. Consider adding a note that this is a trade name, or italicise it.
"tahan menghadapi musim dingin" is clumsy. Use "tahan musim dingin" or "dapat bertahan di musim dingin di Eropa Tengah".

"Myxocyprinus" is the genus name, but the ID text does not give the full species name. This is fine if the source also omits it. Check that the genus is not mixed up with the common name "Chinese Whimple Carp".

nanobagrus-armatus.name: Nanobagrus armatus
notes: Item 1: "Least Concern" rendered as "Risiko Rendah" is non-standard; the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Terendah". Use that.
Item 1: "prosesus supraoksipital yang mengecil" and "elemen depan pelat nuchal yang mengecil" are awkward. Use "tereduksi" and "elemen pelat nuchal bagian anterior".
Item 5: "Mau langsung menyantap" is awkward for "Readily feeds on". Use "Mudah menerima pakan hidup/beku dan pakan olahan lainnya".
Item 4: "kayu (driftwood)" is vague. Use "kayu apung/kayu rendam (driftwood)" or "kayu akar".
Item 2: "Pasifik" and "Kepulauan Sunda Besar" are fine, but "Greater Sunda Island Rivers" is a drainage-basin name. Consider keeping it as "Sungai-sungai Pulau Sunda Besar".

nemacheilus-saravacensis.name: Nemacheilus saravacensis
notes: Item 8: "sangat teritorial atau agresif" drops the English "excessively ... or otherwise" nuance and implies all are aggressive. Use "terlalu teritorial atau bersifat agresif".
Item 8: "satu atau dua gerombolan" is awkward. "Gerombolan" usually means a gang. Use "kawanan" or "sekelompok" (schooling fish).
Item 5: "Arus sederas air bah" adds a flood image. The English says "torrent-like", so use "arus deras seperti torrent" or "arus sangat deras".
Item 5: "halus terkikis air" is clumsy for "water-worn boulders". Use "batu besar yang membulat terkikis arus".
Item 1: "dengan jumlah pola pelana yang kurang lebih sama" is vague. Use "tanda berbentuk pelana dengan jumlah serupa di punggung".
Item 1: "loach" and "hobi akuarium" are fine, but "Butuh arus kuat" in a spec list would read more naturally as "Membutuhkan arus kuat".
Item 11: "mulut kecil dan sangat melengkung" is imprecise for "strongly arched". Use "mulut kecil, melengkung kuat".

nemacheilus-selangoricus.name: Selangor loach
notes: Item 1: 'filter yang memutar seluruh volume air akuarium 8–12 kali per jam' is fine, but 'loach' left in English is acceptable; no issue.
Item 4: '(sekitar 54 liter)' is kept from the English; check that it is right: 60×30 cm with ~30 cm height gives about 54 L, so it is fine. No change.

Item 8: 'Teman setangki terbaik' adds the idea of tankmates. The English 'Fishes which inhabit similar biotopes...' is fine, but 'kawanan ikan seperti itu' slightly changes 'one or two schools'. Minor.
Item 8: 'sangat teritorial atau agresif' drops 'excessively'. Use 'terlalu teritorial atau agresif'.
Item 5: 'Arus sederas air bah' is a poor rendering of 'torrent-like conditions'. Use 'arus deras seperti torrent/jeram'.
Item 5: 'batu berbagai ukuran' is placed first in the substrate list; the English 'rocks' is fine. 'bongkahan batu yang tergerus air' is OK.
Item 11: 'sirip ekor bercabang sampai bercabang dalam' is a mistranslation of 'forked to deeply forked'. Use 'bercagak sampai bercagak dalam'.

Item 11: 'kelompok ... yang pertama kali dikenali' is fine, but 'bintik hitam ... juga tidak ada' is OK. 'panjang kepala bagian dorsal' is awkward; use 'panjang kepala dorsal' or 'panjang kepala di sisi punggung'.
Item 12: The reference list is untranslated, which is allowed. No issue.

Item 2: 'Kalimantan bagian barat (negara bagian Sabah dan Sarawak...)' keeps the source's structure, but 'dulu dikenal sebagai Billiton' changes 'aka' (also known as) to a past name. Use 'juga dikenal sebagai Billiton'.

nemacheilus-spiniferus.name: Nemacheilus spiniferus
notes: Item 3: "serasah organik" for "organic detritus" is slightly off; "detritus organik" or "endapan bahan organik" is closer.
Item 5: "Arus sederas air bah" is awkward for "torrent-like conditions"; "arus sederas air terjun/jeram" is more natural.
Item 11: "panjang kepala bagian atas" is a stiff rendering of "dorsal head length"; "panjang kepala dorsal" is clearer.

nematabramis-everetti.name: Nematabramis everetti
notes: Item 1: 'tanda humeral (di belakang tutup insang)' adds a location not in the English source; drop the parenthetical or keep to 'bercak humeral'.
Items 1 and 7: 'tanda humeral' is a little technical; 'bercak/noda humeral' is more natural.
Item 3: 'anak sungai berarus deras' for 'swiftly-flowing affluent streams' is OK, but 'degraded swamps' becoming 'rawa yang sudah rusak' reads stiffly; 'rawa yang terdegradasi' is more natural.
Item 4: 'Pakan utamanya adalah invertebrata darat dan air' is ambiguous; use 'invertebrata darat dan akuatik'.
Item 5: '(lebih gemuk)' adds a meaning not in the source ('deeper-bodied' means tinggi badan); drop it.
Item 7: 'jari-jari bercabang pada sirip dubur' is fine, but 'tinggi tubuh 2,5–3,5 kali dalam SL' is awkward; use 'tinggi tubuh 2,5–3,5 kali panjang standar'.
Item 7: 'pangkal sirip punggung' is acceptable, but 'sirip dada' for 'pectoral-fin' is fine; no change needed except 'sungut lebih panjang dari kepala' should read 'lebih panjang daripada kepala'.

nematobrycon-lacortei.name: Rainbow Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore menjelang malam" – English says "in the evening"; fine, but "Konon cara berkembang biaknya" is slightly awkward; prefer "Dikatakan berbiak dengan cara serupa...".
Item 8: "cocok sekali menjadi penghuni akuarium komunitas yang komposisi penghuninya sudah direncanakan dengan baik" is wordy for "well-researched community aquarium"; simplify.
Item 8: "hasilnya berupa tontonan yang tampak lebih alami" is a bit awkward; "Anda akan dihadiahi pemandangan yang tampak lebih alami".
Item 5: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan" is awkward; use "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu penting".

Item 11: "jumlah jari-jari sirip dada yang paling umum" OK, but "gasteropelecid, lebiasinid, callichthyid, loricariid" left as English family terms; consider Indonesian-style wording (e.g. "lele Callichthyidae").

neohomaloptera-johorensis.name: Neohomaloptera
notes: Item 3/7/10: pH 'as low as 3.0 or 4.0' vs item 10 'pH 6.0–7.2' is a source inconsistency; the translation is faithful, so no fix needed. Real issues are below.

Item 15: 'Hindari spesies besar, agresif, atau yang lamban dan tidak tahan arus sedang' changes the meaning. The English means avoid large, aggressive, or slow-moving species that cannot tolerate current. The Indonesian is ambiguous but acceptable, so tidy the phrasing.
Item 14: 'aufwuchs (lapisan perifiton)' is fine, but 'Balitorid sering dijual dalam kondisi sangat kurus' adds 'sangat' (very), which is not in the source. Use 'kurus'.
Item 6: 'merumput biofilm' is awkward. Use 'memakan/merumput biofilm' or 'mengais biofilm'.
Item 18: 'setup tema sungai yang sudah matang dan sangat lama berjalan' is awkward and loose for 'mature, heavily seasoned river setups'. Use 'akuarium bertema sungai yang sudah matang'.
Item 13: 'Sayuran yang direbus sebentar' is acceptable. 'Algae wafer' is fine.
Item 21: 'banyak anggota balitorid sebelumnya' is slightly off. Use 'banyak ikan yang dahulu digolongkan sebagai balitorid'.
Item 12: 'Sediakan arus air yang kuat' conflicts with item 9 ('torrent-like conditions are unnecessary'). This comes from the source, not the translation, so leave it.
Item 5: 'bagian selatan Semenanjung Malaysia' and 'barat laut negara itu' are faithful. 'Hutan rawa gambut Selangor Utara' is fine.

neripteron-auriculatum.name: Keong Batman
notes: Item 3: "drop... from 114 individuals at 0–2 m/s" fine, but "Sebarannya yang terbatas" is fine; however "tekanan hidraulik (arus)" adds a gloss; keep as "tekanan hidrolik" or neutral.

Item 5: "sisa tanaman yang membusuk" ok, but "mungkin menggerogoti daun yang sedang mati" - fine; main issue: "masukkan hanya ke akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya sudah selesai" is awkward; use "akuarium yang sudah cycling".
Item 6: "Suhu: 22–26 °C" fine; "Mereka membutuhkan masa adaptasi yang panjang agar bisa dipelihara jangka panjang" is clumsy; rephrase "agar dapat dipelihara jangka panjang".
Item 9: "lobster air tawar" for crayfish is OK, but "Mereka bukan penggali" loses 'natural' ("bukan penggali alami"); "mungkin saja mengacak substrat" ok.

Item 9: "Udang hias kecil" for dwarf shrimp; use "udang kerdil/udang hias" consistently; mixed untranslated English names (pygmy Cory, clown killifish, vampire shrimp) should use Indonesian forms where common (e.g., "udang vampir", "ikan rasbora harlequin").
Item 2: "New Ireland", "New Hebrides" left in English; use "Irlandia Baru", "Hebrida Baru". Also "Papua (New Guinea)" should be "Papua Nugini" — Papua alone is a different region (added fact).
Item 1/4: "Batman snail"/"Ear snail" left in English in item 1 while body uses "keong Batman"; use "keong Batman (disebut juga keong telinga)".
Item 7: "substrat soil" – use "tanah" or "soil (tanah)" naturally; "batu-batu berwarna hijau" should be "berubah hijau".

oliotius-oligolepis.name: Checker barb
notes: Item 7: "well-researched community aquarium" is translated as "penghuninya dipilih dengan cermat". It is passable, but "akuarium komunitas yang dirancang dengan baik" is closer to the source.
Item 9: "burayak" is a less common term among Indonesian hobbyists. Consider "anakan" or "larva", or give "burayak (fry)".
Item 9: "air matang" for "mature water" is ambiguous, because it reads as boiled water. Use "air yang sudah matang (berumur/terkondisi)" or "air akuarium yang sudah matang".
Item 9: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is clumsy. Use "filter spons yang digerakkan udara (aerator)".
Item 10: "genus 'keranjang sampah'" is a literal calque of "catch-all". Use "genus penampung (wastebasket taxon)".
Item 6: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but ambiguous. Consider "Daphnia (kutu air)".

oryzias-javanicus.name: Ikan padi Jawa
notes: Item 6: "sekitar 41 liter" — 45×30 cm base volume depends on the English's own figure, and conversion seems fine; no change needed unless the source differs. Skip.
Item 12: "pita kuning di dekat tepi" for 'submarginal bands' is a bit clumsy; consider "pita kuning submarginal".

Item 10: "Ikan ini sebagian besar tidak agresif terhadap spesies Oryzias lain" — 'mostly non-aggressive towards congeners' would read more naturally as "umumnya tidak agresif terhadap sesama Oryzias".
Item 16: "sedikit berlekuk (emarginate)" — 'lunate or emarginate' are two shapes; 'sedikit berlekuk' is acceptable, but "bulan sabit (lunate)" could be "menyerupai bulan sabit"; minor.
Item 2/16: 'blue-eyed ricefish' left in English without an Indonesian gloss (e.g., "ikan padi mata biru"); minor.
Item 11: "tepi sirip berwarna putih keperakan" for 'fin seams' is acceptable but "pinggiran sirip" is more natural; minor.
Item 9: "predator mikro" is stiff; "pemangsa kecil" is more natural.

oryzias-latipes.name: Medaka
notes: Item 8: "Sebagian besar tidak agresif terhadap Oryzias lain" is ambiguous. Say clearly whether it means the same species or other Oryzias species.
Item 11: "ikan gigi (toothcarp)" is not a common hobby term. Use "ikan gigi" with the Cyprinodontiformes context, or keep "toothcarp" alone.
Item 5: "Paling baik dipelihara di akuarium yang penuh tanaman air" is slightly stronger than "heavily planted". "Akuarium dengan banyak tanaman" would be more natural.

oryzias-sarasinorum.name: Buntingi Sarasin
notes: Item 8: "we strongly recommend maintaining it alone" is rendered as "sangat disarankan memeliharanya sendiri tanpa spesies lain". This is fine. The conflict with "six or more specimens" comes from the source, so leave it.
Item 11: "Rosen dan Parenti sudah mengklasifikasikan ulang mereka ke dalam Beloniformes, kelompok saudara dari cyprinodontiformes" should keep the capital letter, so write "Cyprinodontiformes".
Item 11: "toothcarp (ikan bergigi seperti killifish)" adds an explanation that is not in the source and is loosely worded. Use "ikan gigi-karper (toothcarp)" or just "toothcarp".
Item 1: "Sarasin's minnow" is left in English with no explanation. Add a local rendering or mark it as an English trade name, for example "(Sarasin's minnow)".

Item 1: "a broad silvery lateral stripe" is rendered as "Garis lateral keperakan", which could be read as the lateral line ("garis rusuk"). Use "garis memanjang di sisi tubuh" or "strip lateral keperakan" to avoid confusion.
Item 11: "Garis lateral keperakan" has the same ambiguity with "linea lateralis". Reword it as "strip keperakan di sisi tubuh".

Item 10: "pelvic brooding" is explained as "mengerami telur dengan sirip perut". "Mengerami" (incubating) is slightly misleading, because the female carries the eggs. Use "membawa telur dengan sirip perut".
Item 3: "Cagar Biosfer Dunia UNESCO" is acceptable. "kawasan konservasi berhutan" for "forested reserve" is fine. "Hidup berdampingan (simpatrik)" is fine.

oryzias-woworae.name: Daisy's Ricefish
notes: Item 14: "tends to look most effective and behave more confidently in a group of 8 or more" is fine, but "Corydoras kerdil" is OK; however "sedikit adu kekuatan" for "sparring" is OK. Main issue is in item 17: "Cukup mudah dipijahkan dan cukup produktif" repeats 'cukup' (the source has 'quite' and 'fairly'); only a style point.

Item 9: the source line "the seller keeps them in tap water with high TDS and pH" is shop talk and should be dropped; the translation keeps "penjualnya memelihara ikan ini di air keran...". Rephrase neutrally or omit.

Item 18: "Sirip ekornya berbentuk rata (truncate), bukan bulan sabit (lunate) atau sedikit bertakik (emarginate)" is acceptable, but "Japanese ricefish" and "toothcarp" are left in English; give local equivalents, e.g. "ikan padi Jepang" and "ikan gigi (toothcarp)".
Item 18: "Belum jelas apakah keduanya merupakan satu spesies atau bukan" loses the referent. The English means O. woworae and O. sp. 'Kendari'. Name them explicitly.
Item 1: the lifespan, size and other values are fine. Item 6: "mata air yang mengalir masuk" is vague for "affluent spring"; use "mata air yang menjadi anak sungai/aliran masuk".
Item 17: "spawning mop" is left in English; add the local term, e.g. "spawning mop (kumpulan benang sintetis)".

osphronemus-goramy.name: Gurami
notes: Item 1: 'Gurami, Osphronemus goramy' - 'giant gourami' translated as just 'Gurami'; use 'Gurami raksasa' or 'Gurame' to keep 'giant' (same in item 1 first sentence 'gurami berukuran besar').
Item 4: '72" x 24" x 24"' = 183 × 61 × 61 cm is correct, but 'Volume: ~681 liter' fine; no issue otherwise. Consider noting minimum tank depth/height explicitly.
Item 5: 'luar biasa jorok' is awkward/colloquial for 'exceptionally messy'; use 'sangat banyak menghasilkan kotoran'.
Item 5: 'Tanaman apung sebaiknya ada' is vague; the source says floating plants are preferable (as cover) - use 'Tanaman apung lebih disarankan'.
Item 8: 'ikan sapu-sapu (loricariid)' fine, but 'lele besar' for 'large catfish' acceptable; 'teman setangki' is non-standard, use 'ikan penghuni lain'.

Item 10: 'Pemijahan terjadi di sekitar sarang' fine, but 'burayak' for fry is OK; 'matang kelamin' acceptable. Item 10: 'Jantan membangun sarang ... (di alam termasuk rumput dan akar)' garbles 'including grasses and roots in nature'; use 'termasuk rumput dan akar di alam'.
Item 11: 'sangat membuat ikan stres' is awkward; use 'sangat membuat ikan stres' -> 'menyebabkan stres berat pada ikan'.

Item 11: 'Gurami sering dijual' - original says 'They' (O. goramy); also 'finnage' rendered as 'siripnya yang merah' loses 'red finnage' nuance slightly (fine). Item 11: 'dying' mistranslation check: 'varian yang diwarnai' correct but 'we strongly advise' became passive 'sangat disarankan' OK.

osphronemus-laticlavius.name: Giant Red Tail Gourami
notes: #7: "sama seperti sebagian besar tanaman air lainnya yang juga mungkin dimakan" is redundant and clumsy; use "seperti sebagian besar tanaman air lainnya".
#7: "batu sungai yang halus dan membulat" is wordy for "water-worn rocks"; "batu kali" is the usual term. "kayu bogwood" could be "kayu bogwood (driftwood)" or "kayu apung/akar kayu".
#1: added "gurame, Osphronemus goramy" was not in the source; remove the addition or keep it neutral.
#10: "catfish" and "barb" are left in English; use "ikan patin/lele-lelean" or "barb (Barbus)" and give a local term, e.g. "ikan berkumis".
#13: "cara berkembang biaknya" fine, but "pakan serpihan yang dihaluskan" is OK; "Burayak" for fry is fine. "memakan naupli artemia" fine.
#2: "antara biru kehijauan hingga hampir hitam" mixes "antara ... dan" with "hingga"; use "antara biru kehijauan dan hampir hitam" or "bervariasi dari ... hingga ...".
#2/#5: "arusnya lambat atau tenang" repeats "lambat"; for "sluggish or stagnant" use "arusnya sangat lemah atau menggenang".
#14: "karakter yang kuat" for "real personality" is slightly off; use "kepribadian yang nyata".

osteochilus-vittatus.name: Nilem
notes: Item 8: sentence 'While smaller tankmates are unlikely to be preyed on similarly-sized cyprinids... are better choices' is garbled. Translation 'tetapi pilihan yang mungkin lebih baik adalah cyprinid, characin, dan catfish yang ukurannya sebanding' loses the meaning that smaller tankmates are unlikely to be eaten, and that similarly-sized fish are the better choice. Rewrite it clearly.
Item 8: 'Ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama' is an awkward rendering of 'tankmates'. Use 'teman sekolam/penghuni akuarium lain'.
Item 8: 'sekolam' aside, 'shoaling' vs 'schooling' is explained with long glosses. 'bergerombol longgar' and 'berenang serempak dalam formasi rapat' are acceptable but wordy. Shorten them.

Item 8: 'Walaupun secara alami suka berkelompok' is fine, but 'develops a distinct pecking order' was changed to 'membentuk hierarki yang jelas'. Subject is ambiguous. Make it explicit that the fish form the hierarchy.

Item 1: 'Nilem (hard-lipped barb)' adds a local common name. Nilem is usually Osteochilus hasseltii/vittatus, so this is fine, but the ID text ends 'masih sering dijual dengan nama Osteochilus hasseltii' with no problem.

Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'Food is almost never taken from the surface' becoming 'hampir tidak pernah mengambil makanan dari permukaan' is fine. 'Daphnia' could stay as 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.
Item 5: 'diam melayang' for 'hang' is slightly odd. 'common beech' was rendered 'kayu beech (Fagus)', which adds a Latin genus name not in the source. Remove '(Fagus)'.
Item 11: 'sungut moncong (rostral)' is awkward. Use 'sungut rostral'. 'tenggorokan (isthmus)' is also loose. Use 'isthmus (pangkal dada/ruang antara insang)'.
Item 11: 'shark minnow' glossed as 'ikan hiu-hiuan kecil' is an invented gloss. Use 'shark minnow (sebutan umum)' without a new translation, or note that in Indonesia the usual term is 'ikan hiu'.

osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.name: Arwana Silver
