notes: Item 8: "buah yang jatuh ke air" adds "ke air", which isn't in the source ("fallen nuts and fruits"). Use "buah dan biji-bijian yang berjatuhan".
Item 8: "kacang-kacangan" for "nuts" is slightly off for forest fruit; "biji-bijian" or "buah berkulit keras" fits better.
Item 10/2: "anakan" and "burayak" are mixed for fry/juveniles. Use "burayak" for fry and "anakan" for juveniles consistently.
Item 11: "sirip dubur" is correct but hobbyists more often write "sirip anal".

oxyeleotris-marmorata.name: Ikan betutu
notes: Item 7: the English gives 'several inches in depth (about 7–15 cm)'; the Indonesian is fine, but check for consistency. No change needed.
Item 10: 'lancefish' is left untranslated; use 'ikan lancefish (sand lance)' or a local equivalent such as 'ikan teri/ikan kecil potongan'.

Item 6: 'Ikan ini tidak banyak bergerak' reads as 'does not move much'; 'sedentary' is better rendered 'ikan yang tidak aktif berenang / cenderung diam'. Also 150×60×60 cm = 540 L is correct, so keep it.

Item 9: 'Sekilas melihat mulutnya yang terbuka sudah menjelaskan segalanya' drops the 'more than a thousand words' idiom and sounds stiff; rephrase as 'sekali melihat mulutnya yang terbuka sudah cukup bicara banyak'.
Item 14: 'bertelur di dalam gua' for 'cave spawner' is a literal rendering; use 'memijah di dalam celah/gua persembunyian' ('cave spawner' is a hobby term).
Item 16: 'soon hock' is a trade name and is retained, which is fine. 'hutan yang tergenang' in items 2 and 5 is acceptable, but 'hutan rawa banjir / hutan yang kebanjiran' is more natural.

Item 12: 'ikan lain yang ukurannya serupa dan menempati bagian lain akuarium' is ambiguous and reads as if only the other fish occupy another part of the tank; make it 'yang menghuni bagian akuarium yang berbeda'.
Item 3: 'Juveniles were recently obtained from Thailand' became 'didatangkan', which adds the sense of import; use 'diperoleh dari Thailand'.

pangasianodon-hypophthalmus.name: Patin siam
notes: Item 10: "di peternakan ikan di Asia Timur dan Tenggara" adds "dan Tenggara", which the source ("Far Eastern fish farms") doesn't say. Use "Asia Timur", or a neutral "di Asia". Also prefer "tambak/kolam budidaya ikan" over "peternakan ikan".

Item 10: "akhir musim semi dan musim panas" is a literal rendering of the seasons. Indonesian readers may find it unnatural, since the Mekong's seasons are better described as the end of the dry season and the start of the rainy season. Consider a note or a neutral rewording.
Item 11: "sekitar satu meter" turns "a few feet" into one figure. "Beberapa kaki" is roughly 0.9–1.5 m, so "sekitar 1 meter atau lebih" is safer.

pangio-alternans.name: Ikan kuli
notes: Item 3: "sehingga sisa pakan dapat diandalkan tidak dibiarkan tergeletak" is garbled; rephrase as "sehingga sisa pakan tidak dibiarkan tergeletak" or "yang dengan andal mencegah sisa pakan menumpuk".
Item 3: "seolah memberi tanda perubahan cuaca" is weak. The English says the fish indicate the weather, so use "sehingga dapat menjadi penanda cuaca".
Item 3: "berenang panik" overstates "hectically". Use "berenang gelisah/tidak tenang".
Item 3: "kalau tidak ikannya akan kabur keluar" is colloquial. For a handbook, use "jika tidak, ikan akan keluar/kabur" in a more formal register.
Item 4: "Seberapa mudah perawatannya, sesulit itu pula identifikasi" is a wrong calque and illogical. Use "Semudah perawatannya, sesulit itu pula identifikasi spesiesnya".
Item 4: "Kuhli Loach" is inconsistent with the "ikan kuli" used elsewhere and with the English "Kuhlii Loach" spelling. Make the name consistent.
Item 4: "Di perdagangan, spesies-spesies ini hampir tidak pernah dibedakan" is awkward. Use "Dalam perdagangan, antarspesies hampir tidak pernah dibedakan".
Item 4: "satu-satunya cara membedakannya ... adalah bahwa P. alternans tidak memiliki" is clumsy. Rephrase as "hanya dapat dibedakan dari P. kuhlii karena P. alternans tidak memiliki ...".
Item 4: "garis vertikal" for "vertical strip" is probably fine, but "pita/belang vertikal" would match the original better.
Item 2: "indispensable" is rendered as "sangat dibutuhkan". That is acceptable, but "tak tergantikan" is closer.

pangio-anguillaris.name: Eel Loach
notes: Item 3: citation "Kottelat and Lim,1993; Tan and Kottelat, 2009" is left in English with 'and' and a missing space; use 'dan' / add the space (minor).

Item 12: "Beberapa anggota yang sudah dideskripsikan sebelumnya dimasukkan ke dalam genus Acanthophthalmus" loses the English 'previously included' meaning; use 'sebelumnya pernah dimasukkan' or 'dahulu dimasukkan'.
Item 10: "memiliki semacam punuk di tengkuk kepala" is awkward and drops 'appears to be' hedging in a different form; use 'tampak memiliki punuk tengkuk (nuchal hump) di kepala'.
Item 9: "kalah-mengalahkan dalam berebut makanan" is unnatural and adds 'makanan dan tempat' not in the source; use 'terlalu kompetitif'.
Item 12: "garis samping (lateral)" could be misread as the lateral line; use 'garis lateral di sisi tubuh' or 'garis memanjang di sisi tubuh'.

Item 12: 'burayak' and 'predator mikro' (item 8) are fine, but "Daphnia" translated as 'kutu air' is acceptable; 'micro worm, grindal worm' are left untranslated, so consider adding local forms like 'cacing mikro' (minor).

pangio-cuneovirgata.name: Dwarf Kuhli Loach
notes: Item 15 and 4: 'truncate caudal-fin' rendered as 'sirip ekor yang tegak lurus di ujungnya (truncate)' is awkward; use 'sirip ekor terpotong rata (truncate)'. Likewise 'berlekuk' for emarginate is vague; use 'bertakik/berlekuk dangkal (emarginate)'.
Item 6: 'perairan balik (backwater)' is a non-standard term; consider 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai' or keep the English term only.
Item 12: 'burayak' for fry is fine, but 'riset yang matang sangat penting' is stiff; use 'sebaiknya cari tahu dulu dengan teliti'.
Item 8: 'buah alder (alder cone)' is unclear; use 'kerucut alder' or 'alder cone'.
Item 9: 'Filter yang lembut' is awkward; use 'filtrasi yang lembut/arus filter pelan'.

pangio-malayana.name: Kuhli malayana
notes: Item 8: "terlalu agresif berebut makanan" adds "makanan" (food), which is not in the English "excessively competitive". Use "terlalu kompetitif" or "agresif berebut sumber daya".
Item 11: "genus cobitid dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak" overstates "among the most speciose". Use "salah satu genus cobitid dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak".

Item 11: "Beberapa anggota yang sudah dideskripsikan sebelumnya dimasukkan ke dalam genus Acanthophthalmus" shifts "previously" onto "described". The English means they were earlier placed in that genus. Use "Beberapa anggota yang telah dideskripsikan dulunya dimasukkan ke dalam genus ...".
Item 11: "garis lateral berwarna keabu-abuan" is ambiguous for "greyish lateral stripe", because "garis lateral" also means the lateral line organ. Use "garis samping/pita lateral keabu-abuan".
Item 11: "sirip ekor sedikit berlekuk" adds "sedikit" (slightly), which the English "emarginate" does not state. Drop it or keep only the term.

pangio-oblonga.name: Kuhli Hitam
notes: Item 3: 'kemerahmudaan' is not a natural Indonesian word; use 'kemerah-merahan' or 'berwarna merah muda' for 'pinkish'.
Item 12: 'jumlah spesies terbanyak' is slightly off for 'among the most speciose'; use 'termasuk genus cobitid yang paling kaya spesies'.
Item 12: 'tinggi tubuh 7,2–7,7 kali dalam SL' is awkward; write 'panjang standar (SL) 7,2–7,7 kali tinggi tubuh', and spell out SL once.
Item 12: the Indonesian says the fish is 'relatif lebih panjang dan lebih ramping' where the English says 'comparatively longer, slimmer'. This is acceptable but 'ikannya' is clumsy; drop it.
Item 11: 'gH 18–22, kH di atas 20' left without units. Use 'GH' and 'KH' with the dGH unit, or state which unit applies. The English gives no unit either, so do not add one that is not in the source.
Item 11: 'berhasil berkembang biak' overstates the English 'bred', since the fry were only found and no spawning was seen. Reword to 'pernah berbiak' and mention the uncontrolled conditions.
Item 9: 'riset yang matang' is stiff; use 'perlu mencari informasi dulu dengan cermat'. 'Teman setangki' should be 'penghuni akuarium lain' or 'tank mate', depending on the usual term.
Item 4: 'daya penyangganya (buffer) lemah' is fine, but 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' is an odd rendering; use 'danau tapal kuda/oxbow' consistently.
Item 2: 'diketahui suka melompat' is fine, but 'loach' is left untranslated across items. Use one consistent term, either 'loach' or 'ikan loach'.

pangio-semicincta.name: Kuhli
notes: Item 4: 'Kalimantan bagian Malaysia' is acceptable, but 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' is a little awkward; consider 'danau tapal kuda / oxbow' or 'lanau sungai mati'.
Item 12: 'hampir tidak pernah terdengar menjadi lokasi penangkapan komersial' is awkward; rephrase as 'dari sana nyaris tidak pernah ada penangkapan komersial'.
Item 8: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'Daphnia' is the usual term among hobbyists; 'cacing mikro (micro worm)' could be left as 'microworm'.
Item 12: 'jumlah ruas tulang belakang' is fine, but 'loach "Kuhli/coolie"' mixes the English and Indonesian forms. Use a consistent term.

pangio-shelfordii.name: Borneo loach
notes: Item 3: "pemakan sisa" for "scavengers" is slightly vague; consider "pemakan sisa/detritus" or "ikan pembersih".
Item 3: "tidak berbahaya" for "harmless" is fine, but "substrat pasir halus yang lembut" is slightly redundant; use "substrat pasir halus" or "pasir lembut".
Item 6: "sempat disinonimkan untuk sementara" is redundant ("sempat" and "untuk sementara" mean the same); use "untuk sementara waktu disinonimkan".
Item 6: the sentence "dengan P. muraeniformis biasanya memiliki..." is grammatically awkward; use "di mana P. muraeniformis biasanya memiliki..." or "sementara P. muraeniformis biasanya...".
Item 4: "air yang “sangat keras”" for "rock-hard" is acceptable, but "sangat keras sekali" would be wrong. Keep as is, or use "air sangat sadah" for hobby usage.

pao-palembangensis.name: Buntal Palembang
notes: Item 17: "tampangnya sama sekali berbeda" is colloquial for a handbook; use "penampilannya".
Item 15: "mengerami telur di dalam gua" is slightly misleading, since the fish does not incubate eggs in its mouth. Use "memijah di dalam gua (cave spawner)".

paracheirodon-axelrodi.name: Cardinal Tetra
notes: Item 9: EN says '20 gallons (about 75 litres)'. ID gives 'sekitar 75 liter'. This is acceptable, but the 54 L figure in item 8 conflicts with 75 L. That conflict is in the source, so ignore it.

Item 5: 'Since overfishing this quick-replenishing species would be nearly impossible' became 'hampir mustahil ditangkap berlebihan'. This is fine. However, 'anak Sungai Amazon' for 'Rio Negro tributary of the Amazon' is ambiguous. Reword it as 'Rio Negro, anak sungai Amazon'.
Item 20: EN says 'transfer them to the spawning tank in the evening'. ID says 'pada sore atau malam hari', which adds 'sore'. Use 'pada malam hari'.

Item 21: EN says 'They spawn in the evening'. ID says 'pada sore atau malam hari', which adds 'sore'. Use 'pada malam hari'. Also, 'paling banter bisa dibilang menantang' is awkward for 'challenging at best'. Use 'paling tidak menantang' or 'cukup sulit'.
Item 3: 'garis merahnya' is OK. 'tidak secerah aslinya' adds 'aslinya'. EN says 'isn't as vibrant', so leave it as 'kurang cerah'. Also, 'a hook protruding' in item 19 is fine.
Item 3: 'The red band extends the entire length of the body' and 'while in the neon tetra it runs only from mid-body to tail' are correct. No change needed.
Item 22: 'Hypessobrycon simulans' and 'P. inessi' keep source typos. Latin names must stay as they are, so no change.
Item 6: 'Pada musim kemarau... Saat hujan musim penghujan' is awkward. Write 'Saat musim hujan mulai'. 'Hampir sebagai ikan semusim (annual)' is acceptable.
Item 22: 'garis kromatofor ... yang meluas ke arah punggung' is acceptable. 'incertae sedis' is fine.
Item 17: Item 17's 'Lele kecil, terutama Corydoras' is fine. In item 16, 'tidak predator' is non-standard. Use 'bukan pemangsa'. 'lele callichthyid' is fine.

paracheirodon-innesi.name: Neon tetra
notes: #3 "warnanya tegas" for "robustly colored" is slightly odd; "warnanya cerah/pekat" is more natural.
#3 "farm/budidaya ikan" is mixed; use just "peternakan/budidaya ikan".
#9 "kimia airnya stabil" is stiff; "parameter air stabil" is more natural.
#22 "cukup memengaruhi vitalitas genetik" for "somewhat affected" is fine, but "garis lateral" for "lateral stripe" is confusing next to "gurat sisi" (lateral line); use "garis samping/pita biru".

paracheirodon-simulans.name: Green Neon Tetra
notes: Item 22: 'a lesser (vs. greater) amount of relatively duller red pigmentation' – the Indonesian reads 'warna merah ... lebih sedikit (bukan lebih banyak) dan relatif lebih kusam', which is fine; but 'lateral stripe' rendered as 'garis lateral' is confusable with the lateral line (garis rusuk). Use 'garis samping/pita lateral' consistently throughout.

Item 22: 'a stripe of dark brown or black chromatophores underlying and extending dorsally to the lateral stripe' became 'berada di bawah garis lateral dan memanjang ke arah punggung', which is garbled. It should say the dark stripe lies beneath the lateral stripe and extends dorsally to it.
Item 22: 'Kalau kebanyakan characid ... garis yang lebih terang di atasnya' is acceptable, but 'Hypessobrycon' is kept as the source's spelling. Check it against 'Hyphessobrycon'.

Item 3: 'smallest and tiniest species' was condensed to 'paling kecil'. Also 'This is the reason why some people call ... blue neon' loses the logic. Make clear that the confusion with the other 'green neon' is why people use 'blue neon'.
Item 1: 'garisnya yang hijau toska mengilap dengan warna pekat' is awkward. Use 'garis hijau toska iridesen yang intens'.
Item 12: 'biologically-immature aquaria' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable, but 'alder cones' as 'buah alder' is odd. Use 'kerucut alder (alder cone)'.
Item 20: 'Eggs are scattered among plants' is fine, but 'agar telur tidak dimakan' changes 'to prevent predation' slightly. Say 'agar telur tidak dimangsa'.
Item 21: The register shifts to 'Mereka tumbuh subur', while the preceding sentence says 'Ikan ini'. Make the pronouns consistent.

parakysis-notialis.name: Parakysis notialis
notes: Item 1: "absence of a light brown saddle" was translated as "tidak ada pola pelana cokelat muda". "pola" is added; use "tidak ada pelana cokelat muda".
Item 1: "adipose ridge" was translated as "punggung adiposa". This is misleading because it reads as the back. Use "lunas adiposa" or "rigi adiposa".
Item 1: "cryptically coloured" was translated as "memiliki warna kamuflase". Better: "berwarna samar/menyatu dengan lingkungan".

Item 3: "pebbles" was translated as "batu kerikil bulat", which is awkward. Use "kerikil/batu bulat kecil". "setup" and "hillstream" were left as English. Use "tata letak" and "arus deras/sungai pegunungan".

Item 4: "white worms" was rendered as "cacing putih (white worm)", which is fine. However, "Cyclops" is left lowercase, and "Daphnia" is written as "kutu air (daphnia)" but should be capitalised as a genus name.

Item 5: Brachydanio rosaeus and Barbus rhombocellatus are outdated names, but they are unchanged as in the source. "tank companions" as "teman satu akuarium" is slightly awkward. Use "penghuni bersama".

Item 6: "Area of Occupancy" was left in English. Use "luas wilayah hunian (Area of Occupancy)". "threat-based location" was translated as "lokasi berdasarkan ancaman", which is unclear. Use "lokasi berbasis ancaman".

parakysis-verrucosus.name: Parakysis verrucosus
notes: Item 3: "areas of pebbles" rendered as "kerikil bulat" while the substrate is also "kerikil"; better "kerikil halus/batu koral" or "batu bulat kecil" to distinguish gravel from pebbles.
Item 3: "setup" left in English; use "tata letak/penataan akuarium".
Item 3: "lele sungai berarus deras" is an awkward rendering of "hillstream catfishes"; "lele sungai pegunungan" is more natural.

Item 2: "Kepulauan Sunda Besar, yaitu Borneo, Indonesia dan Sumatra" keeps the source's odd listing (Indonesia is not an island); consider "Borneo dan Sumatra" only if corrected, otherwise flag as source error preserved.
Item 5: "AOO" is used without its expansion, though it was defined earlier in another section; consider repeating "luas area yang dihuni (AOO)".

parambassis-ranga.name: Ikan Kaca
notes: Item 10: 'in the evening' became 'di sore atau malam hari' – adds 'or night'; keep just 'pada sore hari'.
Item 10: 'burayak' is used for fry; it's acceptable, but 'anakan ikan' is more commonly used by hobbyists – consider consistency.
Item 10: 'kondisi air tetap sempurna' is stiff; use 'kondisi air tetap prima/optimal'.
Item 8: 'vigorous or aggressive species' rendered 'terlalu aktif atau agresif' – 'terlalu' is added; use 'aktif/lincah atau agresif'.
Item 11: 'secara buatan' (artificially) is awkward; and 'ikan yang dicat' for 'painted fish' loses the trade-name sense; keep 'painted' in quotes.
Item 1: 'peternakan ikan' for fish farms is odd; use 'tempat budidaya ikan' or 'farm ikan'.
Item 11: 'Ranga punya area gelap...' and 'Lala' lack species-name clarity; write 'C. ranga' and 'P. lala' for consistency.
Item 4: converted litres '72 liter' fine, but 'dimensions ... should be the smallest considered' is OK; nothing to fix.
Item 2: 'Diintroduksi' is stiff; use 'Diintroduksi' → 'Telah dimasukkan ke' (introduced to Japan and Hong Kong).

parambassis-siamensis.name: Parambassis siamensis
notes: Item 11: "Ikan ini tidak mau pakan kering" is fine, but it contradicts item 10, which comes from the source. Keep both as written; no change needed.

Item 9: the source gives pH 7.5–8.5 and the translation keeps it. It contradicts the pH 6.5–7.5 given for the same species elsewhere. This is a source inconsistency, so don't change the number. Optionally flag it for the editor.
Item 12: "vigorous" is translated as "terlalu aktif". The word "terlalu" (too) is added. Use "aktif/kasar" without "terlalu".
Item 16: "Induk tidak merawat telur maupun anakannya" is fine. "burayak" is mainly used for fry of fish like carp or gouramis, but it is acceptable. "Ikan kaca" for "glass perches" is fine.

Item 13: "wonderful" is translated as "luar biasa". This is slightly exaggerated; "menawan" or "bagus" is more natural. "Ten specimens should be the minimum" conflicts with the 6-fish advice in item 12, but that conflict is in the source.
Item 12: "Ikan jantan memang jadi agak teritorial" adds "memang". The source says "do become", so this is acceptable. Minor.
Item 2: "salah diidentifikasi" is slightly awkward. Use "keliru diidentifikasi" or "sering salah dikenali".

parambassis-wolffii.name: Seriding
notes: Item 1: "Duskyfin glassfish" begins the sentence without a local name or article. This is fine, but "ikan ambassid predator berukuran besar" could be smoother.

Item 7: "pakan jenis ini" is slightly stiff. "pakan kering" is fine, but "cacing darah" for bloodworm is ambiguous because it also means the frozen form. Consider "larva nyamuk merah (bloodworm)" or keep it consistent.
Item 8: "barb" is left in English. Consider "barb (ikan tebar)" or keep it as a trade name, but check consistency.
Item 10: "Diperkirakan belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan" is a bit stiff. Consider "Tampaknya belum pernah dibiakkan di penangkaran" to match "bred in captivity".

parosphromenus-anjunganensis.name: Paros Anjungan
notes: Item 5: "5 to 10 gallon (about 19-38 litre)" became "sekitar 19–38 liter" — conversion is correct, but "Albimarginata and Channoides" were rewritten as "Betta albimarginata dan Betta channoides". Keep the names as in the source or mark the genus addition clearly.

Item 16: "hampir satu abad" for "almost a century" is fine, but "sejumlah spesies banyak yang salah diidentifikasi" is clumsy and redundant. Use "sejumlah spesies banyak disalahidentifikasi" or "banyak spesies yang…".
Item 16: "subfamili dugaan Macropodusinae" is awkward for "putative subfamily". Use "subfamili yang diusulkan/diduga, Macropodusinae".

Item 16: "pita biru di bagian pangkal sirip anal" — "proximal band" is correct, but "sirip dada" for pectoral fins is fine. "The unique male colour pattern" is rendered "khas", which weakens "unique". Use "unik".
Item 13: "beberapa spesies tidak diragukan lagi mampu berhibridisasi" — "undoubtedly" is stated too strongly in Indonesian. Soften to "hampir pasti" or "tentu saja mampu".
Item 7: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" for "biologically-immature aquaria" is acceptable, but "alder cone" is left untranslated. Use "buah alder (alder cone)" consistently.
Item 4: "Ikan ini hanya hidup di habitat tertentu" for "stenotypic" loses the technical sense, but the meaning is intact. Item 2 repeats the same wording.

parosphromenus-bintan.name: Paros Bintan
notes: Item 3: 'Spesies stenotipik yang hanya menghuni' adds 'hanya' (only); the English says 'A stenotypic inhabitant' without 'only'. Also 'stenotipik' is a jargon calque and needs a gloss, e.g. 'stenotopik' or 'toleransi sempit'.
Item 3: 'Kandungan mineral terlarutnya umumnya nyaris nol' overstates 'negligible'. 'sangat rendah' would be more accurate.
Item 5: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically-immature aquaria' is acceptable but interpretive. 'Alder cone' left untranslated. Use 'kerucut alder (alder cone)'.
Item 5: 'Tambahan daun kering ... dan saat daun terurai akan tumbuh koloni mikroba' reads awkwardly and splits the original sentence structure. Rephrase.
Item 10: 'dikelompokkan secara arbitrer' for 'arbitrarily' is stiff. Use 'secara sembarang' or 'secara kasar'.
Item 10: 'Telur dan sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable, but 'burayak' is used for both fry and 'brood'. 'anakan' for brood is inconsistent.
Item 11: 'Dinamai demikian karena strukturnya yang mirip labirin, organ ini memungkinkan' is a dangling construction. Rewrite so 'dinamai demikian' attaches to the organ clearly.
Item 11: 'jari-jari keras' for 'spinous rays' is acceptable, but 'burayak artemia (nauplii)' is used for Artemia nauplii. Burayak means fry, so 'nauplius artemia' is better.
Item 11: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' is fine, but 'Selama hampir satu abad' reads as slightly altered from 'for almost a century'. Check it is consistent.

parosphromenus-filamentosus.name: Spike-tailed Licorice Gourami
notes: Item 4: 'Kesadahan: 18–72 ppm' is fine, no change needed unless the source unit is dGH; skip.
Item 1: 'sirip tunggal' for 'unpaired fins' is ambiguous (could read as 'single fin'). Use 'sirip tak berpasangan' (sirip punggung, dubur, ekor).
Item 1: 'tangguh' for 'hardy' is acceptable, but 'mudah dipelihara/tahan banting' is more common among hobbyists.
Item 1: 'filamen' for 'filament-like extension of its tail' is OK, but 'perpanjangan ekor berbentuk benang/filamen' reads more naturally.
Item 3: 'aliran air hitam (blackwater)' is slightly awkward. Use 'sungai/anak sungai air hitam (blackwater)'.
Item 5: 'hanya mau makan pakan hidup' adds a nuance of unwillingness. Use 'hanya memakan pakan hidup'.
Item 7: 'Siapkan habitatnya sebelum membeli ikan ini' is acceptable. 'Siapkan akuarium/habitat terlebih dahulu sebelum membeli' would be clearer for an aquarium handbook.

parosphromenus-linkei.name: Licorice Gourami Linkei
notes: Item 1: 'Kalimantan Tengah, Indonesia' drops 'Indonesian Borneo' (Kalimantan Tengah, Borneo Indonesia). Minor.
Item 1: 'jantan yang luar biasa bisa mencapai hampir 5 cm' is awkward; use 'jantan yang istimewa/terbesar'.
Item 1: 'kondisi saat pacaran' is awkward; use 'kondisi birahi/saat memijah'.
Item 5: pH range 'pH 3,5–6,5' is carried over faithfully, but 'mutlak diperlukan' overstates 'essential'; fine in meaning, minor.
Item 7: 'Ikan ini adalah predator mikro' is acceptable, but 'pastikan kedua ikan mendapat pakan' assumes a pair, as the English does. The English is from a pair-keeping context, so this is minor.

Item 10: Source says larvae become mobile 'four to six days' and free-swimming 'three to five days afterward'; translation keeps these numbers, but 'anakan' for 'brood' and 'larva' are used inconsistently with 'burayak'. Standardise the term.
Item 10: The translation correctly dropped the Vietnamese glosses; no fix needed there.
Item 4: 'kayu apung (driftwood)' is non-standard; hobbyists say 'kayu driftwood' or 'kayu rawa'. 'buah alder' for alder cones is acceptable.

parosphromenus-opallios.name: Opal Licorice Gourami
notes: Item 5: "Suhu: 22–28 °C; sekitar 24–26 °C cocok" fine, but "RO (reverse osmosis)" is acceptable; no major issue. "mutlak diperlukan" slightly strong vs "essential"; use "sangat penting".

Item 1: "berstatus Genting (Endangered) karena sangat terancam oleh..." is wordy and "Genting" is not the usual hobby term; "Terancam Punah (Endangered)" is the standard Indonesian IUCN term (also in item 11).
Item 6: "kerucut alder" is awkward; use "kerucut alder (alder cones)" or the trade name "cones alder". "kayu apung" for driftwood is misleading; use "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendaman".
Item 8: "ikan yang agresif berebut makanan" for "active feeders" adds 'aggressive'; better "ikan yang lincah/rakus saat makan". "rapuh" for "delicate" is okay but "sensitif" is more natural.
Item 10: "Saat berahi dan pacaran" adds 'berahi' not in the source; use just "Saat pacaran". "Burayak" for fry is fine, but hobbyists often use "burayak/anakan".
Item 11: "sirip menguncup" for clamped fins is fine; "Samakan kondisi akuarium semirip mungkin dengan air pengiriman" is slightly awkward.

parosphromenus-ornaticauda.name: Paro ornaticauda
notes: Item 8: 'Alder cones' rendered as 'Alder cone' left in English with no explanation. Add a gloss such as 'kerucut alder (alder cone)'.
Item 8: the English sentence 'The addition of dried leaf litter' is rendered as 'Tambahan daun kering'. It is acceptable but could use 'serasah daun kering'.

Item 15: 'yang masih diperdebatkan' was added to 'subfamili Macropodusinae'. The English says 'putative'. Keep it consistent, e.g. 'yang diduga/diusulkan'. Added emphasis on controversy is a slight shift.
Item 14: 'bubble nest' translated as 'sarang busa'. The usual hobby term is 'sarang gelembung'.
Item 14: 'dan jantan bisa beberapa kali memindahkan telur'. The English says 'brood'. 'Anakan' is used for brood/eggs, which blurs egg versus fry. Use 'telur' consistently.
Item 14: 'Sexually-active males' became 'secara seksual aktif'. 'Jantan yang siap memijah' is more natural.
Item 14: 'perilaku pacaran tambahan yang hanya dimiliki juga oleh P. parvulus' is awkward. Use 'yang hanya dimiliki bersama P. parvulus'.
Item 8: 'biologically-immature aquaria' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is an acceptable gloss, but 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis' is closer to the source.
Item 6: the 19 litre figure for '5 gallons' is fine. Item 3: the type-locality text mixes English and Indonesian, but this is acceptable.

parosphromenus-parvulus.name: Licorice gourami parvulus
notes: Item 7: "Pakan beku kadang-kadang mungkin mau dimakan" is redundant; use "Pakan beku mungkin sesekali mau dimakan".
Item 7: "kondisinya siap untuk berkembang biak" translates "conditioning" a bit loosely; "kondisi prima/persiapan pemijahan" is more precise.
Item 7: "kutu air (moina)" - moina is usually called just "moina" or "kutu air"; fine, but "pemangsa mikro sejati" for "obligate micropredator" is slightly awkward; consider "pemangsa mikro obligat".
Item 1: "Data Deficient" is left untranslated; add "(Kekurangan Data)" in brackets.
Item 10: "wadah film" is unclear; use "tabung rol film (film canister)".
Item 9: "warnanya lebih kalem" is fine, but "di atas pita-pita hitam" could be "pada pita hitam yang kontras".

parosphromenus-phoenicurus.name: Licorice Gourami Phoenicurus
notes: #9: "jauh lebih berwarna" is a bit stiff; "warnanya jauh lebih cerah/mencolok" reads more naturally.
#10: "sirip-sirip tunggalnya" for "unpaired fins" is understandable but stiff. "sirip-sirip tak berpasangan (punggung, anal, ekor)" is clearer.

pelvicachromis-pulcher.name: Kribensis
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very vigorous" shifts meaning; use "sangat aktif/lincah" (or "aktif dan agresif").
Item 8: "characin kecil (seperti tetra)" adds a gloss not in the source; remove it or just keep "characin kecil".
Item 7: "Mau menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" is stiff; use "Menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" or "Mau makan hampir semua jenis pakan".

pethia-conchonius.name: Rosy barb
notes: Item 2: temperature range converted to metric is fine, but 'Minimum tank size: 30 gallons (about 110 litres)' is converted correctly; however 'Adult size: 6 inches (15 cm)' is OK. No error there.
Item 7: '20-gallon' ≈ 76 L, so 'sekitar 75 liter' is OK, but the text is consistent only if 30 gallons = 110 L; fine.
Item 19: 'a 20- or 30-gallon aquarium' became 'sekitar 75 atau 110 liter'; fine. 'sexual maturity at approximately 6 cm (2.5 inches)' OK.
Item 15: 'swordtails' translated as 'platy pedang (swordtail)' is wrong; platy and swordtail are different fish. Use 'ikan pedang (swordtail)'.
Item 15: 'angelfish' translated as 'manfish (angelfish)'; manfish is the Indonesian name for Pterophyllum, but 'ikan manfish' could be ambiguous. Minor: keep as is or write 'angelfish (manfish)'.
Item 15: 'knifefish, ropefish' and 'dither fish' left in English without Indonesian explanation; add a brief gloss (e.g. 'ikan pengalih/dither fish').
Item 15: 'Rosy barbs are agile and can outswim' is rendered OK. 'Teman satu akuarium' fine.
Item 20: 'it's possible that small numbers of fry' OK. 'one or two pairs should then be introduced' became passive without 'should'; the instruction 'induk harus dipindahkan' is OK.
Item 20: 'half a dozen specimens of each sex' rendered 'masing-masing enam ekor dari tiap jenis kelamin' is fine.
Item 22: 'infraorbital 3 deep' translated 'tulang infraorbital 3 lebar' - 'deep' means tinggi/dalam (depth), not 'lebar'; change to 'tinggi'. Also 'preoperculum' → 'preoperkulum' acceptable.

phalacronotus-apogon.name: Phalacronotus apogon
notes: Item 1: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" – the IUCN category Least Concern is standardly "Berisiko Rendah"/"Risiko Rendah" (acceptable), but the bigger issue is below.
Item 3: "Provide plenty of vegetation for it to hide in during the day" is rendered fine, but "tanaman" is OK; no change needed except none.
Item 7: "Belum pernah dilaporkan berhasil dipijahkan di akuarium" adds "berhasil dipijahkan"; the source only says "Not reported in captivity". Use "Belum dilaporkan dalam penangkaran".
Item 7: "Anakan yang lahir pada tahun yang sama" – "Young of the year" means juveniles of the year; "anakan tahun ini" is more natural and avoids the added "lahir".
Item 1: "700 mm (70 cm) SL" – keeping the metric figure twice is redundant; give "70 cm SL" only.
Item 2: "Chao Praya" was changed to "Chao Phraya"; this is correct, so no further change needed.

phenacogrammus-interruptus.name: Congo Tetra
notes: Item 17: "sirip yang lebih megah" and "sirip megah" for "elaborate fins" is slightly odd. Use "sirip yang lebih panjang dan rumit" or "sirip yang lebih indah".
Item 4: "Galur ini stabil secara turun-temurun" for "breed true" reads stiffly. Something like "sifat warnanya menurun dengan baik pada keturunannya" would be more natural.

phractocephalus-hemioliopterus.name: Red Tail Catfish
notes: "ikan lancefish": English name left untranslated; use "ikan sandeel/lancefish (Ammodytes)" with a short gloss, or a local equivalent.
"batu koral besar yang halus": "koral" suggests coral. Use "kerikil/kerakal besar yang halus" or "batu sungai besar yang halus".
"ikan monster" for "tankbusters": unclear. Use "ikan raksasa/ikan besar yang biasa dipelihara (tankbuster)".
"sampai mereka menolak menerima lagi": "mereka" is ambiguous. Say "sampai akuarium publik menolak menerima lagi".

piaractus-brachypomus.name: Bawal air tawar
notes: Item 1: "Akibat ikan yang dilepas oleh para penghobi, kini ada populasinya" is awkward. Say instead "akibat pelepasan oleh penghobi, populasinya kini ditemukan di Amerika Serikat dan tempat lain".
Item 1: "Red-bellied pacu" is left in English as the sentence subject. Use an Indonesian name such as "Pacu perut merah", with the English name in brackets if wanted.
Item 6: "sudah oke" is too casual for a handbook. Use "sudah sesuai" or "dapat diterima".
Item 11: "Karena itu, penjualan spesies ini kemudian dilarang" adds a causal link the English does not have. Use "Spesies ini kemudian juga dilarang dijual...".
Item 11: "Giginya bertonjolan" is a poor rendering of "cusped". Use "bergerigi/berpuncak" or "memiliki tonjolan (cusp)".
Item 5: "dipasang kuat pada akuarium dengan cara tertentu" is clumsy. Say "difiksasi/dikunci pada akuarium dengan cara tertentu".

poecilia-latipinna.name: Molly Sailfin
notes: Item 1/4: "125 mm SL" kept in mm; fine, but "Max size" bracketed 5 in dropped is okay. No issue.
Item 5: "cukup sadah atau lebih sadah" is awkward; use "berkesadahan sedang hingga tinggi".
Item 5: "mineral \"sadah\"" is awkward; use "mineral penyebab kesadahan" for the "hard" minerals.
Item 5: "gerakan bergoyang-goyang di tempat (shimmying)" is fine, but "sirip yang menguncup" is better as "sirip menguncup/mengatup" - minor.
Item 7: "Di alam, ikan ini hampir sepenuhnya herbivor" okay; "pakan serpihan sayuran" fine. "menunya" is slightly colloquial.
Item 8: "Teman setangki" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain / tank mate". "catfish" is acceptable, though "ikan lele-lelean" is less common.
Item 10: "Masa bunting" is used for mammals; use "masa kehamilan/masa mengandung" or "induk bunting" is common among hobbyists, so minor. "burayak" and "anakan" are mixed; keep consistent ("anakan").
Item 10: "hingga 50 anak" okay; "kemungkinannya memakan anaknya sendiri" ok. "tipe liar ... bentuk domestik" is fine.
Item 3: "yang banyak vegetasinya" modifies awkwardly; use "yang banyak ditumbuhi vegetasi".
Item 2: "mapan" for "established" is unusual; use "telah berkembang biak dan menetap".

poecilia-reticulata.name: Guppy
notes: Item 7: "sekitar 1,5 liter air untuk setiap 1 cm panjang ikan" – the conversion is wrong. 1 gallon per 1 inch is about 3.8 L / 2.54 cm ≈ 1,5 L per cm, so this is actually fine. However, 'tanpa heater' text is OK. The real problem is 'minimal sekitar 40 liter': the English says 'Minimum 10 gallons', so drop 'sekitar'.

Item 20: "sebaiknya induk dipindahkan setelah burayak lahir" – the English says remove the young ('remove them' = fry), and the Indonesian says move the parent fish. Change to 'sebaiknya burayak dipindahkan'/'induk dipisahkan' to match; as written it reverses the meaning and the 100% survival logic.
Item 20: "gestation takes between 4-6 weeks" – 'masa kehamilan' is OK, but 'Excess viable sperm ... preserved' is rendered fine. 'Seekor betina bisa menghasilkan 5–100 anak' is OK.
Item 9: "soft décor items" translated as "dekorasi yang lembut" – unnatural; use 'dekorasi yang tidak tajam/halus'.
Item 9: "banyak sekat plastik tipis" – 'many flimsy plastic dividers' means most flimsy dividers; rephrase as 'sekat plastik tipis pada umumnya'.
Item 16: "sumatra (tiger barb)" – OK, but 'serpae tetra' leaves English; acceptable.
Item 3: "hasil ternakan" and 'Fantail' etc. are fine; 'yang katanya tidak ada di tempat lain' adds a skeptical nuance ('katanya') not in the source – use 'yang tidak ditemukan di tempat lain'.
Item 22: "membeli indukan berkualitas" – English says 'quality stock'; 'indukan' (broodstock) narrows the meaning; use 'ikan berkualitas'.
Item 15: "zebrafish" rendered as "zebra danio" – acceptable, but 'ikan yang aktif berbiak' is an addition; use 'guppy betina yang beranak'.

poecilia-sphenops.name: Molly
notes: Item 1/10: "tidak sadah dan tidak basa" is awkward; use "tidak sadah dan tidak beralkali (pH rendah)", e.g. "air tawar yang lunak dan cenderung asam"; "not hard and alkaline" means soft/acidic water.
Item 4: "wajib dipelihara" is too strong for "must be maintained"; "harus" would be more natural.
Item 4: "sirip menguncup" is fine, but "clamped fins" is usually "sirip mengatup/menguncup"; keep it consistent.
Item 4: "mineral 'kesadahan'" is slightly awkward; use "mineral penyebab kesadahan".
Item 3: "Alas akuarium" is unusual; use "Ukuran dasar akuarium" or "Dimensi alas".
Item 3: The final "90 × 30 × 30 cm" is left bare; clarify it as the tank dimensions.
Item 9: "dipijahkan" is imprecise for livebearers; use "dikembangbiakkan".
Item 9: "kotak beranak" for breeding traps is fine, but "jaring" should read "jaring pembesaran".
Item 10: "menjalankan siklus akuarium laut" is awkward; use "mematangkan (cycling) akuarium laut baru".
Item 10: "cacat" for "malformed" is fine, but "bentuk tubuhnya tidak normal" is more neutral.

poecilia-wingei.name: Guppy Endler
notes: Item 5: "sangat hangat dan sadah" is fine, but item 8: "tidak cocok... dipelihara sendiri" okay; main problem in item 4: "unto Carupano" -> "hingga Carupano" is fine, but "Hidup di perairan tawar" fine.

Item 7: "Ukuran akuarium minimal 19–38 liter" - fine; item 14: "yang tidak cukup besar untuk memangsa mereka" reverses meaning; English says fish too big to eat them -> "yang cukup besar sehingga tidak memangsa mereka / terlalu besar untuk dimakan" (should be 'terlalu besar untuk dimakan Endler'? actually: fish big enough that Endlers cannot eat... clarify: 'cukup besar sehingga tidak memakan mereka').
Item 18: "Induk memakan anaknya sendiri" drops nuance; ok. "Burayak Endler biasanya awalnya hanya sedikit berwarna" redundant 'biasanya awalnya' - reword.
Item 17: "produktif" fine; "pelihara beberapa betina untuk setiap jantan" fine. 'anakan baru' vs 'burayak' inconsistent term.
Item 15: "bunting" for fish is inappropriate; use "bunting" -> "hamil/mengandung (gravid)" common hobby term 'bunting' is acceptable but better 'bunting' consistent.

Item 19: "Dr. Endler ... lokasi pengambilan" okay; "ditetapkan secara jelas" for "unequivocally defined" ok. "Kedua spesies ini asli wilayah" missing "adalah" -> "Kedua spesies ini asli dari wilayah".
Item 1: "hobiis" is non-standard; use "penghobi" or "kalangan hobi akuarium".
Item 2: "Males ... carry the vibrant colours" ok. Item 3: "Endler liar" ok; "strain" fine.
Item 8: "Arus air bukan masalah" fine; redundant repeated "dipelihara" in last sentence.

polypterus-senegalus.name: Polypterus Senegal
notes: Item 11: "melengkungkan sirip anal dan sirip ekornya di sekitar alat kelamin betina" – 'cupping' is better rendered as 'membentuk cekungan/mengapit' with the fins; 'melengkungkan' is slightly off.
Item 12: "kelompok polypterid 'rahang atas'" – 'tribe' is rendered vaguely; consider 'suku/kelompok berahang atas'.
Item 9: "Tidak bisa dipercaya bersama teman setangki yang muat di mulutnya" is awkward; better 'Tidak boleh dicampur dengan ikan yang muat di mulutnya'.
Item 12: "Seperti spesies Anabantoid" – use the common term 'ikan labirin (anabantoid)'.
Item 2/12: 'Senegal bichir' left untranslated, fine, but 'cichlid' in item 8 could be 'pelet untuk cichlid'; minor.
Item 12: 'meridionalis ... Perlu dicatat' fine; 'indra penciumannya yang sangat tajam' ok.

poropanchax-normani.name: Normani Lampeye
notes: "asal jangan salah memelihara terlalu sedikit ekor" is awkward; better: "hindari kesalahan memelihara terlalu sedikit ekor" or "jangan memelihara terlalu sedikit"."
"Kalau sendirian... Tapi" is rather colloquial for a handbook; use "Jika dilihat satu ekor saja... Namun"."
"akuarium bergaya nature aquarium" is redundant; use "akuarium bergaya alam (nature aquarium)"."
"hasil budi daya dari Indonesia" is fine, but "Mata birunya melayang-layang" slightly changes "drift"; consider "melayang".

prionobrama-filigera.name: Glass Bloodfin Tetra
notes: Item 14: 'pada sore/malam hari' – English says 'in the evening'; 'sore/malam' is a hedge, use 'pada malam hari' (or 'menjelang malam').

Item 14: 'Ukuran sekitar 46 × 25 × 25 cm' – 18x10x10 in = 45.7×25.4×25.4 cm, OK; but 'enam ekor dari masing-masing jenis kelamin' drops 'half a dozen specimens ... being a good number' nuance (minor).
Item 11: 'cenderung kurang berkembang baik' is awkward; better 'cenderung kurang baik/kurang sehat bila persaingan ... ketat'.

Item 11: 'angelfish' rendered as 'manfish' – Indonesian hobbyists say 'manfish' but 'angelfish' is also common; acceptable, though 'lele Loricariidae' for Loricariid catfish is odd; use 'ikan lele Loricariidae/sapu-sapu kecil'.
Item 8: 'Penambahan ... bisa menghasilkan tata akuarium' fine; 'ranting beech dan oak yang sudah dikupas juga boleh' ok. 'agak mudah kaget' acceptable.
Item 9: 'Hardness: Up to 30 °H' kept as '°H' – fine; 'Kesadahan' ok.
Item 3: 'Hardly ever a wild-collected specimen' – ok.
Item 15: 'Spesies itu kemungkinan belum pernah diimpor' – English 'probably never been imported'; 'belum pernah' is fine, but 'ikan ikutan' for bycatch is non-standard; use 'tangkapan sampingan'.

pristella-maxillaris.name: X-ray tetra
notes: #8: "teman setangki yang sangat agresif" changes "boisterous" (rowdy, lively). Use "sangat lincah/heboh" instead of "agresif".
#10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore". The English says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "menjelang malam".
#7: "Ikan ini mikropredator" is missing the copula. Write "Ikan ini adalah mikropredator" or "Ikan ini seorang pemangsa mikro" is not needed, so use the first.
#5: "Di setup yang sangat polos" leaves "setup" in English. Use "penataan" or "tata letak".
#1: "karasin" is an unusual term for "characid". Use "ikan karasin (characid)" or "tetra".

pseudeutropius-brachypopterus.name: Ikan riu
notes: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)": the IUCN Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah"/"Resiko Rendah"; the gloss is slightly non-standard, so prefer "Least Concern (Berisiko Rendah)".
"eu = baik": the original says "well", so "baik" is acceptable, but "lunas (keel)" is awkward. Consider "lunas/keel (rusuk perut)" or leave the Greek gloss clearer.
"Lokasi tipe": the usual term is "Lokalitas tipe" or "Lokasi tipe (type locality)".

pseudomugil-gertrudae.name: Gertrudae
notes: Item 6: 'Tank size: 10 gallons (about 38 litres) or larger' became 'sekitar 38 liter atau lebih besar'. This is fine, but it conflicts with item 7's 41 L minimum. Check consistency.

Item 18: 'sister group bagi Melanotaeniidae' changes the cladistic statement. The original says Pseudomugilidae plus M. ladigesi form the sister group to Melanotaeniidae. The rewrite is acceptable but wordy. Check that it stays accurate.
Item 18: 'Melanotaeniidae dari Australia dan Papua' for 'Australian and New Guinean'. 'Papua' may be read as the Indonesian province only. Use 'Nugini' or 'Papua Nugini/Pulau Papua'.
Item 8: 'untuk menyebarkan dan melembutkan cahaya' adds 'melembutkan' (soften). Also, '(siklus nitrogennya belum stabil)' is an added gloss. Both are minor additions.
Item 15: 'terutama saat makan' is added and absent from the English ('easily outcompeted'). Remove it.
Item 14: 'gerakan berkilat-kilat yang khas' adds 'yang khas'. Item 16: 'seiring bertambahnya usia' for 'as they mature' should be 'seiring kedewasaan'. Both are minor.

Item 4: 'Rivulet in sago forest...' is left untranslated. Fine as a quoted type locality, but 'sungai dengan Papua bagian barat' is loosely worded. In 'Lokasi yang diketahui', 'sungai Moyle' should be 'Sungai Moyle'.

Item 17: 'bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'ikan tangkapan alam' and 'penangkar' are fine. The sentence 'Metode koloni ini biasanya menghasilkan lebih sedikit burayak' is an interpretation of 'the latter approach is normally less productive', and the referent is ambiguous. It is acceptable.
Item 2: 'dari satu strain hias' is fine. Item 12: 'omnivora' should be 'omnivor' (the common form).

pseudomugil-luminatus.name: Red Neon Blue Eye
notes: "kutu air" for daphnia is ambiguous (kutu air can mean other things); use "daphnia" or "kutu air (daphnia)".
"corydoras dwarf/pigmi" is awkward; use "corydoras kerdil (dwarf corydoras)" or just one term.
"Teman satu akuarium" is a bit stiff; "penghuni akuarium lain" / "ikan teman sekolam" is more natural.
"mengalahkan mereka dalam berebut pakan" is awkward; use "kalah bersaing mendapatkan pakan" phrasing, e.g. "yang membuat mereka kalah bersaing dalam mendapatkan pakan".
"Spesies ini merupakan hasil budidaya" - "tank-bred" is better as "umumnya hasil penangkaran/pembiakan di akuarium".
"rainbowfish lain yang kalem": "kalem" is colloquial; use "yang jinak/tenang".
"tetap berwarna" for "still colorful" is flat; use "tetap berwarna menarik".

pterophyllum-scalare.name: Manfish
notes: Item 2: "tinggi 20 cm atau lebih" ok, but "mencapai panjang badan 15 cm" fine; main issue elsewhere.
Item 12: "From this a pair is sure to form" translated "hampir pasti" – softens the claim; use "pasti" (faithful) or keep consistent.
Item 7: added "idealnya ... rapat" – "Well planted" means ditanami dengan baik, not "rapat" (densely); added fact.
Item 7: "Amazon Sword" fine, but "minimal 50 cm" refers to tank height; ok. Item 3: "kota/kabupaten (munisipalitas)" is clumsy; use "munisipalitas Santa Isabel" only.
Item 4/5: "Far East" -> "Timur Jauh" is unnatural in Indonesia; use "Asia Timur/Asia Tenggara" or keep "Timur Jauh" cautiously.
Item 12: "saat sedang birahi" is an odd term for fish in breeding condition; use "siap memijah".
Item 13: "berbiak" and "berjodoh" slightly non-standard; use "berkembang biak/memijah" and "pasangan yang sudah terbentuk".
Item 14: "menunjukkan warna merah yang cukup banyak" — "high degree of red" is stronger; use "banyak sekali/dominan"; "kuat" for "stable" is loose.

pterygoplichthys-joselimaianus.name: Pleco L001
notes: Item 4: 'Least Concern (LC)' rendered as 'Risiko Rendah' is acceptable, but 'Di alam spesies ini memang jarang dijumpai' is fine; no issue. Real issue is in item 14: 'peculiar' genera rendered as 'unik' (unique) changes meaning; use 'aneh' or 'khas/tidak lazim'.

Item 14: 'drew the first author's attention' -> 'penulis pertama' keeps the reference to the source's authors; use neutral wording e.g. 'yang menarik perhatian para penulis pertama deskripsi' or drop the reference, as the translator is told to be neutral.

Item 6: 'Glycopterichthys' in the EN is a source variant; fine, but 'catfish yang gagah' leaves English 'catfish' in; use 'ikan lele-lelean/ikan kucing' or 'ikan berkumis'—or at least keep hobby term 'plecos/ikan sapu-sapu'.
Item 8: 'makin ribut' for 'boisterous' is awkward; use 'makin agresif/lincah dan aktif'.
Item 11: 'pakan serpihan, pakan tablet, pakan hidup, dan pakan beku' is repetitive; use 'serpihan (flake), tablet, pakan hidup, dan beku'.
Item 10: 'patut dicatat' is stiff; use 'sangat rakus' / 'nafsu makannya besar'.
Item 3 and 4 name inconsistency Glyptoperichthys vs Pterygoplichthys is from source; fine.

pterygoplichthys-pardalis.name: Ikan sapu-sapu
notes: Item 9: "Dengan ukurannya (lebih dari 40 cm), jumlah pakan yang dihabiskan sangat banyak" is awkward; use "Mengingat ukurannya ... ikan ini menghabiskan pakan dalam jumlah sangat banyak".
Item 3: "makin menyenangkan kalau bisa mendapatkan" is a loose rendering of "All the more beautiful is it to obtain"; consider "terlebih menarik".
Item 10: "setelah besar tidak terlalu" is elliptical; write "tidak terlalu banyak memakan alga".
Item 11: "keliru dijual" is fine, but "peternakan ikan di Timur Jauh" is dated; consider "Asia Timur".

puntigrus-anchisporus.name: Puntigrus anchisporus
notes: Item 4: 'Barcalaya' in the source is corrected to 'Barclaya'. This is a silent change to a Latin name, so keep the source spelling or flag it.
Item 1: 'Ikan sumatra (tiger barb)' is fine, but 'Barbus atau Puntius tetrazona' reads as if only Puntius is the wrong name. Make clear that both genus names are wrong.
Item 2: 'cyprinid' is left in English. Use 'famili Cyprinidae' or 'ikan sebangsa karper/cyprinid'.

Item 9: 'extreme play instinct' became 'naluri bermainnya yang sangat kuat'. 'Bermain' is a literal rendering and is odd. Use 'sangat lincah/agresif'. 'Extended fins' as 'bersirip panjang' is acceptable.
Item 13: 'sport' (a mutation) is rendered 'varian'. Prefer 'mutasi' or 'varian hasil mutasi'. 'Petarung nekat' for 'swashbucklers' is slightly off. 'Jagoan yang berani' is closer.
Item 8: 'Daphnia' became 'kutu air'. This is the common local term, but give 'Daphnia' (kutu air) for precision. 'Mengais' for 'browse' is acceptable.

Item 14: 'Genus Puntius ... keranjang sampah' is an OK translation of 'catch-all', but 'polifiletik' needs no change. The phrase 'kerabat satu genusnya' is a bit awkward. Use 'spesies sekerabat dalam satu genus'.

puntigrus-navjotsodhii.name: Puntigrus navjotsodhii
notes: Item 1: "Kalimantan Tengah, Kalimantan (Borneo bagian Indonesia)" is a bit redundant; "Kalimantan Tengah, Borneo Indonesia" would read more naturally.
Item 4: "perdagangan sebagian besar bergantung pada 'tiger barb' hasil budidaya komersial" is slightly stiff; "hasil produksi komersial" or "sumber asalnya tidak jelas" would be more natural.
Item 4: "sungut moncong" and "sungut rahang atas" are literal; common terms are "sungut rostral" and "sungut maksilar".
Item 4: "kelompok 'penampung'" for "catch-all" is awkward; "kelompok 'keranjang sampah' (wastebasket taxon)" is clearer.
Item 5: "bibiography" typo is left in the source reference; this is acceptable as a reference list but could be kept as is.

puntigrus-pulcher.name: Puntigrus pulcher
notes: Item 1/11: 'tiger barb' (ikan sumatra) — 'ikan sumatra' is the common name for Puntigrus tetrazona, which is fine; but "Considered a synonym ... for decades following Alfred (1963)" rendered as 'Sejak Alfred (1963)' is ambiguous and reads as if Alfred started it; rephrase as 'Setelah Alfred (1963), ... dianggap sinonim'.
Item 11: 'of questionable origin' is rendered OK in item 11 but omitted in item 1 summary; fine only if intended. Item 1 drops 'of questionable origin'.
Item 2: 'Kalimantan Utara (North Kalimantan) province' — 'Kalimantan Timur' lacks 'Provinsi' for consistency; minor.

Item 11: 'jari-jari keras terakhir' for 'last simple dorsal-fin ray' is acceptable, but 'sungut maksila' and 'saringan insang' are fine; 'polifiletik ... menampung banyak spesies (catch-all), dengan lebih dari 100 spesies' redundant: 'catch-all' should be 'keranjang sampah/kelompok serba campur' and 'banyak spesies' duplicates 'lebih dari 100 spesies'.
Item 11: 'sejak awal abad ini' ('since the turn of the century') is ambiguous in a handbook; better 'sejak pergantian abad'.
Item 8: 'para jantan saingan terus-menerus bertarung' — 'battling' is overstated; 'bersaing' is more natural; 'pembelian paling sedikit' is slightly stiff.
Item 10: 'dipijahkan' is acceptable, but 'Has been achieved' = 'breeding' — consider 'Pernah berhasil dibiakkan'.
Item 12: reference list left untranslated, which is correct.

puntigrus-tetrazona.name: Ikan sumatra
notes: Item 14: 'A minimum of seven is highly recommended, and more than 12 is preferred' is kept as is, but it contradicts item 13 (8–10 minimum). This is the source's own inconsistency, so it's fine.
Item 14: 'angelfish (manfish)' is wrong. 'Manfish' is not a standard term for angelfish in Indonesia. Use 'angelfish' or 'ikan manfish' only if that is the established trade name.
Item 14: 'loach dari genus Botia' is slightly off for the English 'Botia loaches'. Fine, but 'Lingkungan seperti ini bisa terlalu membuat stres' is awkward. Use 'terlalu menimbulkan stres'.
Item 12: 'Repashy gel food' is rendered 'pakan gel Repashy', which is fine. 'Roughage' is translated as 'pakan berserat', which is acceptable.

Item 1/19: 'Puntigrus tetrazona' is called 'ikan sumatra' throughout. The usual hobby name is 'ikan sumatra' or 'tiger barb', so this is acceptable. 'cyprinid' is left untranslated; consider 'ikan famili Cyprinidae'.
Item 13: 'boisterous' is translated 'lincah dan bandel'. 'Bandel' (stubborn) adds a meaning not in the source; use 'lincah dan gaduh/ribut'.
Item 13: the English says 'at least 8-10 specimens ... minimum purchase', which is translated correctly. 'Teman setangkinya' is odd; use 'penghuni akuarium lain'.
Item 17: 'six of each sex' is stated as 'masing-masing enam ekor per jenis kelamin'. This is redundant ('half a dozen specimens of each sex'); tidy to 'enam ekor untuk tiap jenis kelamin'.
Item 17: 'air-powered sponge filter' is translated 'filter spons bertenaga aerator'. 'Bertenaga udara' is more accurate.
Item 6: the volume '~72 litres (~19 US gal)' was converted correctly. In item 7, '110-litre (29-gallon)' is kept as 110 liter, which is fine.

puntius-titteya.name: Cherry Barb
notes: Item 21: "half a dozen specimens of each sex" became "enam ekor dari tiap jenis kelamin"; this is acceptable, but "in a mature aquarium" -> "air matang" ("mature water") is ambiguous. Use "air dari akuarium yang sudah matang/established".

Item 23: "free uroneural present" and the "gill rakers" clause are fine, but the item "infraorbital 3 slender" etc. are ok. However "no antrorse predorsal spinous ray" was rendered as "jari-jari duri predorsal yang mengarah ke depan" without the negation scope being clear. Check it.
Item 8: "Kombala" and "wet, evergreen jungle" -> "hutan hujan basah yang selalu hijau" adds "hujan" (rain), which is not in the source. Use "hutan basah yang selalu hijau".

Item 8: "Reports suggest ... have altered" is fine, but "That said, very little of the country's forest cover remains" -> "Meski begitu" loses the contrast with the previous sentence about collection impact. Rephrase it to say that habitat loss is the bigger threat.

Item 6: "leading to overfishing of the most colorful individuals" -> "individu yang paling berwarna banyak ditangkap secara berlebihan" is stiff. Use "ikan yang warnanya paling cerah ditangkap berlebihan".
Item 20: "gender differentiation and development of reproductive products" -> "perbedaan kelamin dan perkembangan sel reproduksi" is odd. Use "pembedaan jenis kelamin dan perkembangan gonad/telur".
Item 2: "top and mid-dweller" -> "Area renang: bagian atas dan tengah" is fine. The imperial figures were dropped as instructed.
Item 4: The translation is left out. The source paragraph about the German breeder, stocklist code 372634 and wholesale-only supply is shop talk, so omitting it is acceptable.
Item 16: "Buenos Aires Tetra" is lowercased as "buenos aires tetra". Capitalise it as "Buenos Aires tetra".
Item 14: "frozen treats" -> "pakan beku sebagai selingan" is fine. "mau menerima" is slightly awkward; use "menerima".

radix-rubiginosa.name: Keong telinga
notes: Item 1: "Nama: Ear snail" is left in English, but the rest of the text uses "Keong telinga". Use "Keong telinga (juga disebut European ear snail, Pokemon snail)" for consistency.

rasbora-argyrotaenia.name: Wader pari
notes: Item 4: "kolam-kolam sungai" for pools of forest streams is slightly awkward; "lubuk" or "kolam alami di aliran sungai hutan" reads better.
Item 11: "burayak" and "anakan" are used for fry in the same text; pick one term.
Item 9: "ikan lele/catfish" is odd for the group "catfish" in general; use "ikan berkumis (catfish)" or just "catfish".

rasbora-caudimaculata.name: Greater Scissortail
notes: Item 2: 'Kalimantan' for English 'Borneo' narrows the range, because Borneo also includes Sarawak, Sabah and Brunei. Use 'Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo)' or 'Borneo'.
Item 3: 'Kepulauan Sunda Besar, yaitu Kalimantan dan Sumatra' has the same problem. The next sentence also mentions Sarawak and Brunei, so 'Borneo' is more accurate.
Item 9: 'lele/catfish' is too narrow, since 'lele' means Clarias. Use 'catfish' or 'ikan berkumis (catfish)' for the general group.
Item 6: 'Seperti banyak spesies lain yang berasal dari lingkungan alam yang masih murni' reads a little stiff. 'Perairan alami yang masih asri/bersih' would be more natural. This is minor.

rasbora-cephalotaenia.name: Porthole Rasbora
notes: Item 3: 'Taloek' changed to 'Taluk' and 'Moesi' to 'Musi', and 'Kalimatan' spellings normalised. This is acceptable, but check that 'Taluk' is the right modern name for the Riau locality.
Item 6: 'kayu beech atau oak biasa' leaves 'beech' and 'oak' in English. Use 'kayu bukit/ek' or add the local term, because most readers won't know them.
Item 6: 'pelompat yang andal' is odd for 'accomplished jumper'. Use 'pelompat ulung'.
Item 6: 'tampak sangat menarik' for 'look particularly effective' and 'Yang jelas' for 'Certainly' are loose. Rephrase to 'tampil sangat serasi' and 'Memang'.
Item 11: 'anakan' and 'burayak' are used for fry in the same passage. Use one term consistently.
Item 12: 'garis keturunan polifiletik' is clumsy. Use 'kelompok polifiletik'.
Item 12: 'pangkal sirip punggung di tengah tubuh' is acceptable, but 'sirip dubur' is a rare term. Use 'sirip anal', which hobbyists know better.
Item 2: 'Butuh tutup akuarium yang rapat' is slightly informal. Use 'Perlu penutup akuarium yang rapat'.

rasbora-dusonensis.name: Seluang
notes: Item 1: "Akuarium perlu tutup yang rapat" is fine, but "Rasbora dusonensis adalah ikan dari famili Cyprinidae" is acceptable. No real issue here.
Item 5: "setup" is English; "set-up/aquascape" is common, but "susunan akuarium" or "aquascape" would read more natural.
Item 10: "microworm" and "Paramecium" are left untranslated; consider "cacing mikro" for microworm.
Item 8: "yang seru" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "menarik".
Item 3: "kolam alami" for "pools" is slightly loose; "genangan" or "kolam" is closer.

rasbora-einthovenii.name: Rasbora einthoveni
notes: Item 12: "garis lateral yang memanjang melewati mata hingga ke depannya" – English says "through and beyond the eye"; fine, but "pinkish" rendered "kemerahmudaan" is awkward; use "kemerahan muda/merah jambu".
Item 12: "Sebagian besar bentuk ini belum pernah terlihat di hobi karena mayoritas ikan ... hasil penangkaran untuk tujuan tersebut" – awkward; clarify as bred for the trade.
Item 12: "monofili kelompok tersebut tidak terbukti" and "disinonimkan" are stiff; use "tidak didukung" and "digabungkan (sinonim)".

Item 12: "para penulis ... Boraras, Horadandia, ... yaitu" – 'i.e.' list is attached to preserving monophyly of existing groups; the sentence structure is ambiguous. Also 'the first two clades' translated 'dua klad pertama' fine.
Item 2/6: "garis itu sendiri tepinya jelas tidak rata" – 'noticeably' attached awkwardly; say 'tepinya tampak jelas tidak rata'.
Item 2/6/9: 'ikan hias paling populer' for 'most popular fish in the hobby' ok; 'Brilliant rasbora' kept in English without local name is acceptable but could add 'rasbora brilian'.

Item 11: 'dipindahkan setelah beberapa hari' lacks object clarity ('induk sebaiknya dipindahkan'); 'penyebar telur' should be 'penebar telur' (egg-scatterer) and 'tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan induk' could be 'tidak menjaga telur/anakan'.
Item 11: 'Masa inkubasi telur Rasbora ... anakan' – 'anakan' vs 'burayak' inconsistent; use 'burayak'.
Item 6: 'Substrat pasir yang lembut mungkin pilihan terbaik' – 'lembut' should be 'halus'; 'berwarna kecokelatan karena tanin' ok.

rasbora-elegans.name: Rasbora elegans
notes: Item 4: '~243 litres' for 120 × 45 × 45 cm is correct (243 L), fine. Item 10: '120 × 30 × 30 cm (113 litres)' is wrong; the actual volume is 108 L, so correct the figure. The English figure of 113 is itself questionable, but the translation should note this.
Item 1/4/8/10: 'bisa bersikap gelisah' is unnatural. Use 'mudah gugup/stres' or 'menjadi tegang'.
Item 10: 'rapat tanamannya' is awkward. Use 'ditanami lebat'.
Item 10: 'Filter internal bertenaga' for 'internal power filter' is awkward. Use 'filter internal (power filter)'.
Item 10: 'telur betina habis' is awkward. Use 'betina kehabisan telur'.
Item 10: 'sedikit air yang lebih dingin' loses 'cool'. Fine, but 'sehingga wadah perlahan-lahan terisi penuh' is okay.
Item 7: 'pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran kering' is redundant for 'dried flakes and granules'. Use 'flake dan granul kering'.
Item 5: 'Java fern' and 'Java moss' are left in English without Indonesian equivalents. Add 'pakis java' and 'lumut java'.
Item 11: 'Kepekatan tanda' is an awkward choice for 'intensity'. Use 'Intensitas/ketajaman tanda'.
Item 1: 'adalah ikan cyprinid' is fine, but 'jago melompat' is colloquial for a handbook.

rasbora-kalochroma.name: Clown Rasbora
notes: Item 7: "kayu common beech (Fagus sylvatica)" adds a Latin name that is not in the source. Remove it, or use "kayu beech" only.
Item 7: "setup" and "common beech" are left in English. Consider "penataan" and "kayu beech".

rasbora-patrickyapi.name: Rasbora patrickyapi
notes: Item 3: "pH air di rawa gambut sangat rendah" is fine, but the English says only "The pH"; this is acceptable, no change needed beyond optionally "Nilai pH".
Item 4: "jumlah bakteri dalam air harus ditekan" is a bit loose for "bacterial pressure"; consider "tekanan bakteri (kepadatan bakteri) serendah mungkin".

rasbora-sarawakensis.name: Rasbora sarawakensis
notes: Item 13: "45 × 20 × 20 cm (29,5 liter)" – the English figure is 29.5 L for a half-filled container? Volume 45×20×20 = 18 L; the original figure is inconsistent, but the translation keeps it unchanged. Consider checking it.

Item 13: "The adults ... are best removed after a couple of days" became "jadi sebaiknya dipindahkan setelah beberapa hari" – 'a couple of days' is closer to 'beberapa hari' but 'dua hari' is more faithful; also the 'jadi' adds a causal link not in the source.
Item 13: "diisi air setengahnya" is slightly awkward; use "diisi setengah penuh dengan air".
Item 13: "Pemijahan bisa dipicu...sehingga akuarium perlahan-lahan terisi penuh" – 'topped up' is a gradual refill to the original level, not necessarily 'penuh'; use "terisi kembali".
Item 1: "sangat kaya spesies" is fine, but "Ikan ini cantik, hidup bergerombol" – 'completely undemanding' rendered as "tidak rewel" is OK; no real issue.

Item 7: "Filter tidak perlu terlalu kuat" – 'tends to hail from' is fine; but "akar atau cabang kayu (driftwood)" fine. 'diffuse the light' translated as "meredam cahaya"; "menyebarkan/menyaring cahaya" would be more exact.
Item 11: "Trichogaster trichopterus" – the Latin name is retained, good; "Rasbora lain yang ukurannya serupa" leaves Rasbora/Puntius in capital genus form, fine.
Item 9: "seperti anggota genus lain yang serupa" is ambiguous; use "seperti anggota genus ini lainnya yang mirip".

rasbora-trilineata.name: Rasbora ekor gunting
notes: #9: "ikan cyprinid lain" adds "lain" (other), which the English does not have. Use "cyprinid" or "ikan cyprinid" only.
#11: "setelah dua hari" turns "a couple of days" into an exact number. "beberapa hari" or "sekitar dua hari" is closer.

rasbora-vulcanus.name: Rasbora Vulcanus
notes: "biologically immature tank" → "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" adds a specific claim (nitrogen cycle) not in the English; use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" (or "belum matang" only).
"Dissolved 'filter listrik'" for "power filter": use the term hobbyists use, e.g. "filter eksternal/power filter" or "filter hang-on"; "filter listrik" is unnatural.
"setengah" water fill: "half-filled with water" is fine, but "Rasbora ... lele/catfish": "lele" is a different fish (Clarias); use "ikan lele-lelean/catfish" or just "catfish".
"Pemijahan ... telur betina habis" and "burayak": "burayak" is a Malay term; Indonesian hobbyists use "burayak" less often, so prefer "anakan" or "larva ikan".

"Saat itu" ... "Induk akan memakan telur apa pun": fine; but "hanya itu informasi yang tersedia" in #5 omits nothing. In #1, "anterior centers of the scales" → "bagian tengah depan sisik" is ambiguous; use "bagian tengah sisik yang menghadap ke depan (anterior)".

"sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine; but "predator mikro" for "micropredator" is acceptable. Fix #1: "Nama spesiesnya yang 'panas'" – the English refers to the species epithet "vulcanus", so say "nama spesiesnya (vulcanus) yang 'panas'".

#14 "dimasukkan oleh Liao et al. ke dalam spesies yang belum terklasifikasi, yang mungkin bukan Rasbora": "possibly not Rasboras" is plural/general; render as "kelompok spesies yang belum terklasifikasi (incertae sedis), yang mungkin bukan Rasbora".

rocio-octofasciata.name: Jack Dempsey
notes: Item 10: "lateral stripe" is rendered "garis samping", which is easily confused with the lateral line ("gurat sisi"). Use "garis memanjang di sisi tubuh" or "pita lateral".
Item 9: "Bertelur di substrat, dan kedua induk ikut menjaga telur dan anakan" adds detail the source lacks (eggs and fry). Prefer "Pemijah substrat dengan perawatan biparental (kedua induk)".
Item 5: "soft, sandy substrate" is rendered "pasir yang halus", which is fine grain, not soft. Use "substrat pasir yang lembut" or "pasir halus tanpa sisi tajam".
Item 10: "Karena itu namanya rupanya dipakai ... karena" repeats "karena". Rephrase, for example "sehingga namanya rupanya dipakai ... mengingat raut wajahnya ...".

sahyadria-denisonii.name: Denisoni
notes: Item 5: "sekitar 243 liter" – 120×45 cm base alone doesn't give volume; the English figure (about 243 litres) is kept, but check it was derived correctly from the source (likely original gallons/height). Verify the conversion.
Item 11: "gumpalan moss jawa" – use the hobby term "java moss" or "lumut jawa" consistently, not a half-translated form.
Item 13: "garis merah tua" for "scarlet body stripe" – scarlet is bright red ("merah menyala/merah scarlet"); "merah tua" means dark red and contradicts the next clause "lebih cerah".
Item 13: "tidak adanya tanda hitam di sirip punggung (pada D. chalakkudiensis ada)" – awkward, rephrase as "tanpa tanda hitam di sirip punggung (vs. ada)".
Item 1/12: "Terancam (Endangered)" – Indonesian IUCN term for Endangered is "Genting"; "Terancam" is generic (Threatened).
Item 9: "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan baik" – "well-researched" means well-planned/researched; acceptable but "burayak" in item 11 is archaic for fry; "anakan" is more common.
Item 2: omitted text includes customer stocklist info (code 369498, wholesale only) – acceptable as shop talk, no fix needed beyond confirming.

scatophagus-argus.name: Ikan kiper
notes: #4: "tidak perlu diberi pakan kotoran" is weaker than the English "should not feed them feces". Use "jangan diberi pakan kotoran" or "sebaiknya tidak diberi".
#4: "Tentu saja" is added and not in the source. Use a neutral connector such as "Namun".
#6: "dahinya yang sangat curam" is slightly awkward. "dahinya yang sangat landai/miring tajam" or "dahi yang sangat membulat/tegak" may read more naturally for a steep forehead profile.

scleropages-formosus.name: Arwana Asia
notes: Item 1/2/3: 'extirpated' is rendered 'punah'; 'punah' means extinct. Use 'hilang dari / tidak lagi ditemukan di sebagian besar wilayah sebarannya' (or 'punah secara lokal').
Item 5: 'biologically-immature aquaria' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable, but 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)' is closer to the source.
Item 5: 'completely bare set-ups' is rendered 'kosong tanpa dekorasi'. 'Tanpa substrat dan dekorasi' would be more precise.
Item 7: 'small goldfish' is rendered 'ikan mas koki kecil'. Mas koki is the fancy goldfish. Use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish kecil' to be safe.
Item 7: 'feeder fish' is rendered 'ikan umpan'. 'Ikan pakan (feeder)' is the term hobbyists use.
Item 8: 'Termasuk pengeram mulut, dan yang mengerami adalah jantannya' is wordy. Use 'Pengeram mulut oleh induk jantan'.
Item 9: 'dikoleksi dari Pegunungan Schwaner' should read 'ditangkap/diambil dari'. Also, 'masing-masing' is ambiguous about which variant belongs to which province pair.
Item 9: 'Varian green' mixes English and Indonesian. Keep the form names consistent, e.g. 'varian green' in quotes like the others.
Item 6: The °F values are dropped, which is fine because the metric conversion was requested.

scleropages-jardinii.name: Arwana Irian
notes: Item 1: "Ikan lidah tulang" is a literal rendering; hobbyists more commonly use "arwana/ikan lidah tulang (bony tongue)"; consider adding the English term in brackets.
Item 1: "lempeng-lempeng benua yang bergeser" adds the idea of shifting plates; the source says "continental floes" (bongkahan/pecahan benua). Minor.
Item 2: "Keduanya paling jarang diimpor dibandingkan semua jenis arwana lainnya" is awkward; better "Keduanya adalah arwana yang paling jarang diimpor".
Item 2: "akuaris" is non-standard; "aquascaper" or "penghobi akuarium" is more natural. "tempat penangkaran" is fine, but "breeding facilities" could also be "fasilitas penangkaran".
Item 4: "peternakan di Australia" for "breeding farms" is slightly off; use "tempat/penangkaran budidaya" or "farm pembenihan".
Item 3: "agak suka bertengkar" is a bit colloquial; "agak agresif terhadap sesamanya" is more natural for hobby text.

sewellia-breviventralis.name: Sewellia
notes: Item 1: "warnanya berbeda dibandingkan ikan impor yang masih hidup" is slightly awkward; better "ada perbedaan warna dibandingkan ikan impor hidup".
Item 1: "bentuk warna" for "colour form" is awkward; use "varian warna" or "morf warna".
Item 1: "ditangkap di provinsi Hue" is fine, but "Karena itu ... tetap digunakan" is slightly clumsy; consider "tetap dipertahankan".
Item 4: "mau makan" is colloquial; "memakan" or "menerima" is more natural in a handbook.
Item 4: "pelet butiran" is redundant; use "granul" or "pelet".
Item 4: "dirangsang" for "promoted" is slightly off; "didorong" or "dipicu" fits better for algae growth.
Item 3: "hanya sedikit tercemar bahan organik" is acceptable but wordy; "rendah polutan organik" is more natural.

sewellia-lineolata.name: Reticulated Hillstream Loach
notes: Item 13: 'goldfish' translated as 'ikan mas koki'. Use 'ikan mas koki' only if that is meant; fine, but 'river manifold tank' is left as 'akuarium model river manifold'. Explain it in Indonesian or give a proper term.

Item 16: 'Pseudogastromyzon pun bisa kesulitan menunjukkan dominasinya' follows 'jika wilayah terbatas'. The English says 'if the latter resources are limited', meaning food and territory. Write 'jika pakan dan wilayah terbatas'.
Item 20: 'mencucup-cucup permukaan punggungnya' for 'mouthing of the dorsal surface' is awkward. Use 'menyentuh/mengisap-isap dengan mulut'.
Item 20: 'to dislodge her into open water' is rendered as 'terlepas ke kolom air'. Say 'perairan terbuka'.

Item 20: 'Pacaran ... mengepak-ngepakkan sirip' is fine, but 'fry' appears as 'burayak' in 'Initial reports ... recovering fry'. That is fine. 'woollen mops' became 'spawning mop dari benang wol'. Acceptable.
Item 6: 'arus deras sekali' for 'torrential' is awkward. Also 'air terjun kecil' for 'cascades' is okay. Rephrase the torrential part as 'arus sangat deras'.
Item 22: 'tuberkel' and 'balitorid' are fine. 'pipih ke bawah (depressed)' is OK. 'sirip dubur' for 'anal fin' is stiff. Use 'sirip anal'.
Item 22: 'one simple and 19–26 branched pectoral-fin rays' is rendered 'satu jari-jari sirip dada tunggal dan 19–26 bercabang'. Use 'satu jari-jari tak bercabang (simple)'.
Item 15: 'frozen spirulina brine shrimp' is rendered 'artemia beku yang diperkaya spirulina'. This is fine, but 'sayuran yang direbus sebentar (blanching)' is okay.
Item 3: 'Spesies Sewellia bisa dibilang yang paling mudah dipijahkan ... di antara semua loach' is fine. The 'tutup yang rapat mutlak diperlukan' repetition mirrors the source.

silurichthys-hasseltii.name: Hassel's Leaf Catfish
notes: #1: "Dibedakan dari kerabatnya" adds "from its relatives", which is not in the English; use "Dibedakan oleh ...".
#2: "Least Concern/Risiko Rendah" is a non-standard mix; use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" or "Berisiko Rendah".
#2: "Diketahui terdapat di DAS Mekong" is slightly awkward; "Diketahui dari DAS Mekong" is closer to the source.
#4: "kayu (driftwood)" is vague; use "kayu apung" or "kayu driftwood", which hobbyists use.
#6: "gurami" for gouramies is fine, but "hidup bergerombol" for shoaling would more naturally be "berkelompok".

sphaerichthys-osphromenoides.name: Chocolate Gourami
notes: Item 6: "Kutu air hidup atau beku" for daphnia – "kutu air" is the common name for Daphnia, but "daphnia" is also widely used; consider "daphnia (kutu air)" for clarity.
Item 1: "Data Deficient (kekurangan data; ...)" is acceptable, but "Chocolate gourami" in lowercase vs capitalised trade name is inconsistent; consider "Chocolate Gourami".
Item 5: "buah-buahan kering" adds "kering" to fruits; the English says only "fruits" (dried applies to leaves). Use "buah" or "buah-buahan".
Item 8: "sekitar 20–40 telur mungkin dikumpulkan" is awkward; use "sekitar 20–40 telur dapat terkumpul dan dierami".
Item 4: "siklus nitrogennya sudah matang" is fine, but "Masukkan hanya ke" is stiff; consider "Masukkan ikan hanya ke akuarium yang sudah matang secara biologis".

sphaerichthys-selatanensis.name: Crossband Chocolate Gourami
notes: Item 8: "ikan yang hiperaktif/riuh" is a slash-hedged rendering of "boisterous fish". Pick one term, e.g. "ikan yang terlalu aktif".
Item 7: "daphnia/kutu air" gives two alternatives joined by a slash. Use one, e.g. "daphnia (kutu air)".

Item 5: "Akuarium blackwater yang sudah matang dan stabil sangat disarankan sebelum ikan dimasukkan" is a little stiff. "Disarankan menyiapkan akuarium blackwater yang sudah matang dan stabil sebelum ikan dimasukkan" reads more naturally.
Item 6: "Sangat disarankan arus yang lembut..." is awkward. "Sangat disarankan menggunakan arus lembut dan akuarium yang ditanami rapat serta berpencahayaan redup" is better.
Item 2: "rentan" for "delicate" is acceptable but could be "sensitif/peka". It also sits close to "sensitif" in the next sentence, so the wording repeats.

sphaerichthys-vaillanti.name: Samurai Gourami
notes: Item 3: "Ukuran akuarium minimal 75 liter" is fine, but the translation is consistent; no fix needed except wording below.
Item 1: "saat baru diterima" is ambiguous/awkward; use "saat baru tiba/baru dibeli" for "when you first receive them".
Item 1: "Kesadahan: Lunak hingga agak lunak" is slightly clumsy; consider "Lunak hingga cukup lunak".
Item 4: "pengecekan parameter air" is a bit loose for "water testing"; use "pengujian air".
Item 6: "Hindari juga ikan besar... seperti tetra dan rasbora" - "mereka akan menghabiskan" is slightly unnatural; use "ikan-ikan itu akan menghabiskan".

stigmatogobius-sadanundio.name: Knight Goby
notes: "Monos" is left in English and capitalised. Write it lowercase as "mono", or give the genus Monodactylus, as in "ikan mono (Monodactylus)".

"S. sadanundio sejauh ini yang paling umum di antaranya di dunia akuarium" reads awkwardly because it has no verb. Use "S. sadanundio adalah yang paling umum di antara spesies tersebut di dunia akuarium".

stiphodon-ornatus.name: Stiphodon rainbow
notes: Item 5: 'males are hard to define' (item 12) was rendered 'ciri jantan sulit dipastikan' - fine, but 'dasar kaca' for 'tank base' is fine; however 'kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' adds 'halus' (smooth) not in the source; use 'batu dan kerikil bulat bekas aliran air'.

Item 12: 'perbedaan jantan dan betina sangat jelas' with 'ciri jantan sulit dipastikan' is a contradictory reading; better 'dimorfisme seksual sangat nyata, namun pada spesies ini jantan sulit dicirikan (warna jantan sulit ditentukan)'.
Item 14: 'Selama musim dingin tahunan' - English says 'annual cool spell'; Indonesia has no winter, use 'musim sejuk/periode dingin tahunan'.

Item 14: 'kantung kuning telur terserap dalam 3–4 hari, dan dalam periode itu mereka harus sudah mencapai laut' is OK, but 'burayak' used for larvae/post-larvae and fry inconsistently; 'jantan di akuarium' for 'captive males' is fine.
Item 15: 'selama hampir setengah abad ke-20' - source says 'almost half of the twentieth century', i.e. 'hampir separuh abad ke-20' (not 'half a century'); rephrase.
Item 15: 'Sicyopus ... sicydiine lain cakram melekat di antara kelima jari-jarinya' ambiguous; use 'di antara kelima pasang jari-jari'.
Item 10: 'hillstream loach' added untranslated English term not in source; use 'loach penghuni arus deras sejati'.
Item 16: 'Sumara' typo left in reference (acceptable as untranslated list).

striuntius-lineatus.name: Lined Barb
notes: Item 1: "ikan suku Cyprinidae bergaris memanjang di sisi tubuh" is fine, but "punya paling banyak satu pasang sungut" is awkward; use "paling banyak satu pasang sungut" or "tidak lebih dari satu pasang sungut".
Item 2: Sarawak is a Malaysian state and the translation is right. However, "Kalimantan Barat/West Kalimantan" lost the English form; this is minor.

Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "pelet/flake kering" is wrong: the English says flakes and granules, so use "serpih dan butiran kering" or "flake dan granul". The slash form is awkward.
Item 8: "cobitids" was rendered as "ikan loach". Use "ikan loach (Cobitidae)" for accuracy; the term is also loose.
Item 5: "setup" is left in English; "tata letak" or "rancangan akuarium" reads more naturally.
Item 3: "Kandungan mineral terlarutnya umumnya nyaris tidak ada" overstates the English "negligible"; use "sangat rendah".
Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but the volume of an 80 × 30 cm base depends on height. The figure is carried over from the source and is fine.

Item 11: "0–1 pasang sungut ... ketiga spesies lainnya punya 2 pasang" conflicts with item 1's "paling banyak satu pasang". The meaning is the same, but wording should be consistent. Also "Puntius spp. lain" is fine.
Item 1: "Namun" was added to join the sentences. The English says "but it has no more than one pair", so the contrast is preserved; this is fine.

sulcospira-testudinaria.name: Keong Susuh Kura
notes: Item 9: "Burrowers: Yes" is listed as "Penggali: Ya", which contradicts the preceding statement in the same item that they are not obligate diggers and generally do not move under the substrate. This is faithful to the source, so only check whether it should be clarified. The text itself is fine.

Item 6: "does not tolerate salinity well" became "kurang tahan terhadap air payau/asin". This adds the idea of brackish water, which the source does not mention. Use "tidak tahan terhadap salinitas tinggi" or stay closer to the source wording.

Item 6: "regain activity immediately" was rendered as "segera aktif kembali". This is acceptable. However, "When moved to freshwater" is untouched, so the source's logic stays confusing. No fix is needed beyond checking the sentence.

Item 7: "do not burrow much or too deep" was rendered as "tidak banyak menggali dan tidak terlalu dalam". This reads awkwardly. Use "tidak banyak menggali dan tidak terlalu dalam" only if the subject is made clear, e.g. "tidak banyak menggali, dan galiannya pun tidak dalam".
Item 1: the original "Optimal tank size: 10 gallons (about 40 litres)" is correct at 40 L. Item 1 leaves "Javanese snail" untranslated in "Nama lain". Give the Indonesian form, e.g. "keong Jawa".
Item 9: "Danio rerio" and "Endlers" are fine. "Least Killifish", "Pygmy Swordtail" and "Ghost Glass Catfish" are left in English with no local name. Add Indonesian names or brackets for readability.
Item 5: "Cycle the tank" became "Selesaikan siklus nitrogen di akuarium". This is fine. "tidak ribet" is colloquial for a handbook; use "tidak rumit".
Item 11: "embryonic shells" became "cangkang embrio". It is literal but unclear. Say "embrio bercangkang".

sundadanio-axelrodi.name: Rasbora Axelrodi
notes: Item 5: "12,5 liter saja" — the English says "as low as 12.5 liters (3 gallons)". The Indonesian is OK on the figure, but "saja" shifts the nuance; use "sekecil 12,5 liter" or "paling kecil 12,5 liter".
Item 8: "Pelet juga digunakan sebagai pakannya." is passive and vague. The English says the keepers feed pellets. Use neutral wording such as "Pelet juga dapat diberikan sebagai pakan."
