Item 6: "Ikan ini dipelihara di air dengan TDS sekitar 60." turns the keepers' own practice into a general statement. Reword it as "Dalam pemeliharaan, ikan ini dijaga pada TDS sekitar 60" and keep the unit (ppm) if the source implies it.
Item 7: "filter bertenaga pompa" is a mistranslation of "power filters". Use "filter tenaga listrik/power filter yang arusnya kuat" or "filter eksternal/hang-on yang arusnya kuat".
Item 4: "tumbuh baik" for "thrive" suits plants better than fish. Use "berkembang baik" or "hidup baik". "tumbuhan yang membusuk" is acceptable.
Item 9: "Corydoras" alone for "Corydoras catfish" drops "catfish". This is minor. Use "ikan Corydoras".
Item 3: "Kalimantan" for "Borneo" is acceptable. Keep it consistent with the rest of the handbook.

symphysodon-aequifasciatus.name: Discus
notes: Item 4: EN says 'around 6"' (≈15 cm) - this is fine, but the original 'few juvenile fish or a pair' fine; however item 1 says wild fish reach 14 cm and item 4 gives 15 cm, consistent with source, no change needed.
Item 8: 'Di antara semua discus, yang paling istimewa' loses 'kings of the discus fishes' (raja discus); consider 'Rajanya discus adalah varian "Royal"'.
Item 8: 'Royal asal Tefé ... dikenal sebagai yang paling cantik' drops 'legendarily'; add 'secara legendaris/dikenal luas'.
Item 8: 'yang di mata para penghobi jauh kurang menarik' - source says 'in our eyes' (neutral); 'kawin satu sama lain sebagai satu populasi' is acceptable but 'form a reproductive community' fine.
Item 8: 'Saat ini ikan-ikan tersebut berukuran 12-15 cm' - 'Currently' fine; but 'banyak di antaranya juga punya' changes 'additionally' slightly; ok.
Item 8: 'cincin iris kuning maupun merah' - 'maupun' implies both in same fish; use 'kuning atau merah'.
Item 2: 'mengikuti Rio Solimões' - source 'extends down'; use 'membentang di sepanjang Rio Solimões'. Also mixed 'Rio Putumayo' / 'Sungai Amazon' fine.

symphysodon-discus.name: Discus
notes: Item 6: "burayak" for fry is regional/less common among Indonesian hobbyists; "benih" or "anakan" is more common, and the text mixes "burayak" with "anakan" (item 9). Use one term consistently.
Items 2 and 9: "manfish" for Angelfish (Pterophyllum) is a common name, but "angelfish" is the more widely understood term; consider "ikan angelfish (manfish)".
Item 8: "yang sudah ahli" is awkward; use "hanya oleh ahli" or "hanya dapat dibedakan oleh orang yang berpengalaman".
Item 8: "musim kawin" for "breeding time" is inconsistent with "memijah" elsewhere; use "saat musim pemijahan".
Item 9: "mencabik 'makanan'" is too strong for "breaking off"; use "mengerat/menyobek sedikit 'makanan'".
Item 1: "dipopulerkan ke seluruh dunia" and "akuaris" are acceptable but "penghobi akuarium" is more natural.

syncrossus-hymenophysa.name: Langli
notes: Item 4: 'structural components of housing' was translated as 'bagian dari struktur rumah', which is misleading. Use something like 'bagian struktur bangunan/permukiman (mis. tiang rumah)'.
Item 12: 'Syncrossus ... the former alteration ... the latter' is fine, but 'meskipun studi yang kedua' is ambiguous. Name Šlechtová et al. (2006) explicitly.
Item 12: 'Yasuhikotakia ... berkerabat lebih dekat dengan Sinibotia maupun Syncrossus' should read 'baik dengan Sinibotia maupun Syncrossus'.
Item 6: 'kerikil halus' is used for both 'fine gravel' and 'pebbles', which is repetitive. Use 'kerikil' for pebbles.

Item 6: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically immature set-ups' is acceptable, but 'disukai' is better than 'seperti yang disukai' for 'favoured'. Also 'ruang depan gelembung renang' should be 'ruang anterior'. Minor.
Item 10: 'seharusnya tampak jelas lebih gemuk' turns 'should be' (expected) into a prescriptive 'seharusnya'. Use 'umumnya tampak jelas lebih gemuk'.
Item 12: 'ikan alfa' and 'ikan yang bertarung' are fine, but 'dengan Botia tampaknya sebagai garis keturunan paling basal' is awkward. Rephrase.

Item 8: 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex is fine, but 'zukini' for courgette is fine too. 'kalau ada pilihan makanan lain, ikan ini akan memilih yang lain itu' misreads the English 'if other options are available they will take them'. It should say that the fish will still eat snails even when other food is available, so they should not be relied on to clear an infestation. As translated, it has the fish avoiding snails, which reverses the meaning.

synodontis-eupterus.name: Synodontis Featherfin
notes: Item 13: 'udang besar, udang kecil' for 'prawns, shrimps' adds an invented size distinction; use 'udang' / 'udang kecil'.
Item 20: 'kurus atau sangat kurus' is redundant for 'thin or emaciated'; use 'kurus atau sangat kurus kering' or just 'kurus kering'.
Item 16: 'quarrelsome' rendered as 'agresif' is slightly too strong; use 'suka berselisih' or 'galak'.
Item 12: 'bekas luka yang buruk' is awkward; use 'bekas luka yang jelek/permanen'. 'kayu bogwood/akar' is redundant.
Item 17: 'cichlid yang kekar' is odd; use 'cichlid bertubuh tangguh'.
Item 4: 'di farm' is awkward; use 'hasil budidaya (farm bred)'. Items 1 and 22 'farm budidaya ikan' could be 'tempat budidaya ikan'.

systomus-orphoides.name: Mata merah
notes: Item 1/5/8: 'cukup heboh' for 'boisterous' is colloquial; use 'cukup aktif dan gaduh' / 'bertingkah kasar'.
Item 4: 'Volume: ~720 liter' is fine, but 'dibutuhkan akuarium berukuran minimal' is OK; no real issue beyond the ones below.
Item 5: 'batu-batu sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu sungai berbagai ukuran yang telah halus terkikis air'.
Item 5: 'Arus sederas air terjun' overstates 'torrent-like'; use 'arus deras seperti torrent/jeram'.
Item 11: 'ukuran dewasa lebih dari 80 mm SL' is fine, but 'sungut moncong' for rostral barbel is acceptable; consider 'sungut rostral'.
Item 11: 'keranjang sampah' for 'catch-all' is overly literal; use 'kelompok penampung'.
Item 10: 'Kemungkinan belum pernah tercatat berhasil dipijahkan' adds 'berhasil dipijahkan'; the source says possibly unrecorded in aquaria.

tanichthys-albonubes.name: White Cloud
notes: Item 20: "hide most of the time" is rendered "lebih sering bersembunyi"; this is weaker than the source, so use "hampir sepanjang waktu bersembunyi".
Item 28: "musim semi hingga musim gugur" is awkward for Indonesian readers, who have no such seasons; consider "sepanjang musim kawin (musim semi hingga musim gugur di habitat asalnya)".
Item 12: "African dwarf frog" is left in English; add a local term such as "katak kerdil Afrika" with the English name in brackets.
Item 27: "betina tampak bunting telur" is odd for fish; "betina tampak penuh telur" is more natural.

telmatherina-bonti.name: Bonti-bonti
notes: #4 "pakan kering maupun pakan beku apa saja" is slightly awkward; better "Ikan ini mau memakan semua jenis pakan kering maupun beku."
#6 "hidup bercampur dalam warna-warni" is awkward; better "hidup bercampur dengan berbagai warna".
#6 "saling kawin" for interbreed; "kawin silang" or "berbiak satu sama lain" is more natural.
#6 "ras" for breeds; "varian" or "strain" is more usual in the hobby.
#8 "Asal nama" for Lexicon is fine, but "silverside" is left in English; consider the local term "ikan perak" or "silverside" with a short gloss.

thayeria-boehlkei.name: Penguin Tetra
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very boisterous" shifts the meaning. Boisterous means rowdy or very active, not aggressive. Use "sangat aktif/heboh".
Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "atau malam". The source says only "in the evening", so use "pada sore hari".
Item 10: "sperma" for "milt" is acceptable, but "cairan sperma" or "air mani ikan" would read more naturally for fish.
Item 8: "Selalu beli dalam kelompok" leaves out the object, so it reads abruptly. Use "Selalu beli ikan ini dalam kelompok...".

thorichthys-meeki.name: Firemouth
notes: Item 7: "(dipakai seperti cetakan)" is added to the pipette instruction and isn't in the source. Remove it.
Item 11: "subopercle" and "preorbital" are left untranslated. Consider "suboperkulum" and "praorbital", or add a gloss.
Item 2: "Sungai Río Tonalá" says "river" twice (Sungai and Río). Use "Río Tonalá" or "Sungai Tonalá".

toxotes-jaculatrix.name: Ikan sumpit
notes: Item 1: "archerfish" is left in English in "jenis archerfish" and "di antara archerfish lainnya". Use "ikan sumpit" consistently.
Item 11: "dijual di Inggris" keeps the UK context, which is fine. "setup" could be "penataan" or "tata akuarium", but this is optional.

trichogaster-lalius.name: Colisa
notes: Item 3: 'Minimum tank size: 15 gallons (~60 litres)' is fine, but the 'Nitrate: less than 60' line is left without a unit (mg/L). Add the unit or keep as in the source.

Item 28: 'Nests ... reaching several inches across (roughly 7–15 cm)' is fine, but 'Mencabut tanaman karpet' etc. are OK. The real problem: 'Sirip perut' vs 'ventral' is mixed up, so 'touches her ventral side' became 'bagian perut betina'. This is acceptable, but 'menyentuh punggung atau ekor jantan' is fine too.
Item 10: 'sudah pas-pasan cukup' is awkward. Use 'cukup untuk sepasang, asalkan ditata dengan benar'.

Item 14: 'manfish' for angelfish is non-standard. Use 'angelfish' or 'ikan manfish/angel'. 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish is acceptable. 'corydoras pygmy' and 'rasbora harlequin' use inverted English order. Use 'rasbora harlequin' or 'Rasbora hengeli' consistently.
Item 9: 'sirip ekornya membulat hingga tegak lurus di ujungnya' is a poor rendering of 'rounded to truncate'. Use 'membulat hingga tumpul/terpancung'.
Item 17: 'pantulan cahaya dari dasar kaca' adds 'kaca' (glass) that is not in the source. Also 'Anacharis' and 'Elodea' are listed as two plants, as in the source.
Item 27: 'Jantan sama sekali tidak bisa lagi menerima keberadaan pasangannya' is stiff. Use 'tidak lagi menoleransi pasangannya'. 'Anakan gurami' mixes terms with 'burayak'. Keep one term.

Item 16: 'Suhu yang mematikan 50% populasi' is fine, but 'kematian hanya 1%' at 20 and 25 °C is faithfully kept. The listed range 20–26 °C against the 22–27 °C elsewhere is a source inconsistency, not a translation error.
Item 1: the 'Max size: 88 mm SL' line dropped '(3.5 in)', which is permitted. 'Pembiakan massal juga mungkin telah menyebarkan' is fine, so no change is needed here.

trichopodus-leerii.name: Sepat mutiara
notes: Item 8: 'Minimum tank size: 20 gallons (about 76 litres)' – 20 US gal is ~76 L, fine, but '40-gallon (about 150 litres)' is fine too; no issue here. Real issue: item 2 'Life expectancy: 4 to 5 years' vs item 1/21 '8 years' is a source inconsistency, translation faithful – ignore.

Item 6: 'sepat mutiara tumbuh baik, dan begitu pula di akuarium dengan kondisi serupa' is awkward and slightly changes meaning; rephrase to 'Di habitat aslinya yang penuh vegetasi... sepat mutiara berkembang baik di akuarium dengan kondisi serupa'.
Item 14: 'pakan kering beku (freeze-dried)' is a clumsy term; use 'pakan freeze-dried' or 'pakan beku-kering'. 'jentik kaca' for glass worms is okay but 'cacing kaca' is more common.
Item 15: 'it will become withdrawn' translated as 'menjadi pemalu' – better 'menarik diri/stres dan bersembunyi'.
Item 17/18: 'blander' translated as 'lebih pucat' is acceptable; 'Jantan dewasa jauh lebih berwarna' is awkward, use 'warnanya jauh lebih cerah'.

Item 19: 'air-powered filters' rendered 'filter bertenaga aerator' – use 'filter udara (filter busa/sponge berpenggerak udara)'. 'gaya berpelukan khas anabantoid' is stilted; use 'pelukan pemijahan khas anabantoid'. Also '6-8"' converted to 15–20 cm and '10"' to 25 cm are correct.
Item 20: 'sirip perut ... berbentuk seperti antena peraba' – 'antena' is odd for fish; use 'sungut/filamen peraba'. Also 'after four days' ambiguity fine.
Item 22: 'efek seperti kerang mutiara' for mother-of-pearl should be 'kilau mutiara/induk mutiara', not 'kerang mutiara'. 'Bagian bawah kepala' fine.
Item 4: 'Pulau Sumatra serta Kalimantan' acceptable; 'Hampir Terancam' good.
Item 7: 'Panjang standar: 120 mm SL' – 'SL' redundant; fine otherwise.

trichopodus-trichopterus.name: Sepat rawa
notes: Item 7: "omnivora yang cukup umum" is a loose rendering of "fairly generalised omnivores". Use "omnivora generalis" or "pemakan segala yang tidak spesialis".
Item 8: "loricariid" is left in English. Consider "ikan lorikarid (suckermouth catfish)" or "ikan sapu-sapu dan kerabatnya" so readers recognise it.

trigonopoma-pauciperforatum.name: Rasbora redline
notes: Item 6: 'Volume: sekitar 81 liter' is fine, but the 90 × 30 cm base with 81 L is retained; OK. No issue.

Item 14: 'dideskripsikan ulang sebagai R. gracilis oleh Kottelat' — wording ok; but 'Ikan tersebut ... Ikan ini pernah ditampilkan' ambiguity: second 'Ikan ini' should be 'Ikan tersebut' to avoid confusing it with T. pauciperforatum.
Item 10: 'Beberapa spesies dari Kalimantan yang lebih umum diekspor' — fine; but 'bisa kalah bersaing dengan mereka' is ambiguous; say 'ikan ini bisa kalah bersaing mendapatkan pakan'.
Item 1: 'tetra glowlight' — Latin/common name fine; 'sirip lemak (adiposa)' is awkward, use 'sirip adiposa'.
Item 3: 'perairan hitam (blackwater)' is awkward; use 'perairan blackwater' or 'air hitam'.
Item 7: 'ketapang' leaf given as 'daun ... ketapang' — fine; 'untuk lebih meredupkan cahaya' better 'untuk menyebarkan/meredam cahaya lebih jauh' (diffuse, not dim).
Item 7: 'tampak sangat menarik' — 'look particularly effective' okay; 'Substrat pasir yang lembut mungkin merupakan' fine.
Item 12: 'jumlah yang baik sekitar enam ekor jantan dan enam ekor betina' — 'half a dozen of each sex' correct.
Item 11: 'polanya lebih tegas' — 'more-intensely patterned' better 'pola lebih intens/mencolok'.
Item 13: 'perairan hitam Sundaland' OK; 'ini hanyalah yang paling terkenal' is stilted; use 'itu hanyalah yang paling dikenal'.

trigonostigma-espei.name: Rasbora Lambchop
notes: Item 10: 'sebaiknya pada sore atau malam hari' – English says only 'preferably in the evening'; 'atau malam hari' is added.
Item 10: 'kesadahan 1–5°H' – use 'dGH' for consistency; '°H' is ambiguous.
Item 10: 'ganti air besar ... dengan air yang lebih dingin' – fine in meaning, but 'peternak' for breeders is odd; use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi'.
Item 10: "sejumlah 'latihan'" for 'dry runs' is unclear; use something like 'percobaan/gerakan pemijahan palsu tanpa telur'.
Item 10: 'Alas plastik jenis rumput' fine, but 'Rupanya perilaku memijah' is stiff; 'jumlah telurnya juga lebih sedikit' fine.
Item 3: 'dasarnya dipenuhi daun gugur' – the English says the substrate is scattered with leaves; 'dipenuhi' overstates it; use 'bertebaran'.
Item 1: 'cyprinid' left untranslated; Indonesian hobby usage is 'ikan cyprinid/suku Cyprinidae' – acceptable but 'lambchop' in quotes is not explained.
Item 5: 'Daun boleh dibiarkan ... atau diangkat dan diganti' is fine; 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan' is awkward; use 'tidak terlalu krusial'.

Item 8: 'ikan hias paling populer' – 'in the hobby' is rendered loosely; and 'catfish, loach' are untranslated trade terms where 'lele-lelean/ikan sapu-sapu' type terms are not intended; 'gugup' for nervous is odd, use 'stres/penakut'.

trigonostigma-hengeli.name: Rasbora hengeli
notes: Item 4: "in the current post" is dropped. Add something like "dalam artikel ini" or "yang dibahas di sini" before the Trigonopoma example.
Item 2: "buah alder (alder cone)" is slightly odd. "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder" is more accurate than "buah", because alder cones are catkin-like cones.

Item 1: "tubuh bagian depan T. espei berwarna (pada T. hengeli terang/transparan)" is clumsy and hard to parse. Rephrase it, for example "bagian depan tubuh T. espei berwarna, sedangkan pada T. hengeli terang/transparan".

trigonostigma-heteromorpha.name: Rasbora Harlequin
notes: Item 5: 'Kalimantan' for 'Borneo' narrows the meaning (Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part). Use 'Pulau Borneo (Kalimantan)' or 'Borneo'.
Item 11: 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan' is stiff. 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu penting' reads more naturally.
Item 8: 'Sebagai patokan jumlah ikan' is an added phrase that is not in the source. It can be dropped.
Item 22: 'peternak' for 'breeders' reads as livestock farmers. 'Pembudidaya' or 'breeder' is the usual hobby term.

urocaridella-antonbruunii.name: Clear cleaner shrimp
notes: Item 8: the Vietnamese 'thức ăn đông lạnh' was left in the English list; the Indonesian should be 'pakan beku' (the translator wrote 'pakan beku' in the ID, so check the source), but flag that the EN source contains Vietnamese text that the ID rendered silently.
Item 8: 'No direct feeding is necessary' is rendered 'Tidak perlu diberi makan secara langsung', which is ambiguous. Clarify it as 'tidak perlu diberi pakan langsung ke udang (target feeding)'.
Item 5: 'temperature-acclimate' is translated as 'aklimatisasi suhu' only. Consider 'aklimatisasi suhu (dan salinitas) secara perlahan', but do not add facts. The wording is acceptable.
Item 4: '"tenggelam" (jarang terlihat)' is an odd rendering of 'get lost'. Use 'tidak terlihat / hilang di antara dekorasi'.
Item 9: 'kemampuan bertahannya yang terbatas' for 'limited defensive capability' is wrong. Use 'kemampuan pertahanan diri yang terbatas'.
Item 3: 'terumbu berdasar keras' is clumsy. Use 'terumbu dasar keras'.

vaillantella-maassi.name: Dragon Loach
notes: Item 6: "yang bisa saja atau tidak sedikit berwarna kecokelatan karena tanin" is awkward and unclear; use "yang mungkin berwarna kecokelatan karena tanin, mungkin juga tidak".

Item 14: "Unreported in aquaria" became "Belum pernah dilaporkan berkembang biak di akuarium". This adds "berkembang biak" (breeding) which the English does not say. Keep it literal, e.g. "Belum ada laporan pemeliharaannya di akuarium", unless the section heading makes the breeding sense clear.
Item 6: "di lingkungan dataran yang lebih tinggi" is clumsy for "higher altitude environments"; use "di daerah dataran tinggi" or "di habitat berketinggian lebih tinggi".

vittina-waigiensis.name: Nerite Waigiensis
notes: Item 3: "Semua hal yang umumnya berlaku untuk siput nerite juga berlaku untuk perawatan spesies ini" is slightly redundant; simplify to "Perawatannya sama seperti siput nerite pada umumnya".
Item 5: "ahli yang kompeten" is a bit stiff; "ahli yang berkualifikasi" or just "ahli" is more natural.

Item 5: "Spesimen tipe yang ditampilkan di basis data ilmiah WoRMS warna dan bentuknya lebih mirip..." has awkward syntax; add "yang" or "dalam hal", e.g. "...dari segi warna dan bentuk lebih mirip...".
Item 5: "Semua V. waigiensis dewasa tidak memiliki ujung cangkang" should read "Semua siput V. waigiensis dewasa tidak memiliki ujung cangkang (puncak cangkangnya hilang)" for clarity.

wallago-leerii.name: Tapah
notes: #8 "ikan teman yang lebih besar" is awkward; use "ikan penghuni lain yang lebih besar" or "ikan sekandang".
#7 "daging mamalia atau unggas" adds "unggas" to the source's "mammals" (chicken is a bird). The meaning is fine, but it departs slightly from the original.
#7 "predator sejati" is a bit stronger than "highly predatory"; "sangat bersifat predator" or "pemangsa agresif" is closer.
#11 "(yaitu ukuran yang laku dijual)": "ie." is better rendered "yakni" or "artinya". The phrasing is slightly clumsy.

xiphophorus-hellerii.name: Ikan Pedang
notes: Item 1: 'bentuk ikan hias yang membingungkan saking beragamnya' is awkward and over-translates 'bewildering array'; use 'beragam bentuk ikan hias yang sulit dihitung'.
Item 3: 'garis tengah lateral' for 'mid-lateral stripe' is confusing; 'dusky' rendered as 'gelap' is fine, but write 'garis lateral tengah' and 'garis kemerahan di atas dan di bawah garis tersebut'.

Item 19: 'posisi sirip dada lebih ke atas' for 'dorsal position of the pectoral fin' is okay, but 'tubuhnya berbentuk torpedo (fusiform)' adds 'torpedo' not in source; use 'berbentuk fusiform (ramping memanjang)'.

Item 26: 'Watak' for 'Temper' and 'Pilihan yang disarankan: platy' lose 'southern platyfish' (Xiphophorus maculatus); 'cupang (Betta)' is fine but 'Kekurangan pakan' fine. Name 'southern platy' rather than plain 'platy'.

Item 27: 'jantan "bongsor"' for 'real bulls' and 'peternak' for breeders; 'early/late males' rendered as 'jantan cepat/lambat' is non-standard; use 'jantan dewasa dini (early) dan lambat (late)' consistently and 'pembiak' instead of 'peternak'.
Item 31: source text is truncated ('sneakers',' and 'for months,'); the Indonesian mirrors it, but ensure the sentence is completed/ consistent with the source.

Item 33: 'memijahkan' is used for livebearers, which do not spawn; use 'mengawinkan' or 'membiakkan'. Also 'melahirkan sampai 9 kali berturut-turut' for 9 broods is fine, but 'mikroworm' and 'blackworm' should be 'cacing mikro' and 'cacing hitam'.
Item 36: 'Sumber aslinya menyebutkan' still references the source page, contrary to the neutral-writing rule; rephrase to 'Ada keterangan yang menyebut ... namun itu keliru'.
Item 2/13: 'Harapan hidup' for 'Life expectancy' is acceptable, but 'Area berenang' is nonstandard; use 'Lapisan air' or 'Zona berenang'.
Item 12: 'ukuran alas' conveys 'surface dimensions' ok; but 'kutu air' for Daphnia (item 21, 23) is better as 'daphnia' to avoid confusion with other pests.

xiphophorus-maculatus.name: Platy
notes: Item 3: 'Nitrat: kurang dari 60' — unit (mg/L) missing in the source too, but the Indonesian gives no unit; add 'mg/L' only if the source had it, otherwise fine.
Item 25 Mating: 'Bila betina kawin dengan lebih dari satu jantan, biasanya kedua jantan sama-sama menjadi ayah' — 'kedua jantan' presumes exactly two males; use 'semua jantan tersebut'.
Item 25 Mating: 'saat ada jantan lain maupun saat tidak ada predator' — fine in meaning, but 'Pendekatan jantan (rayuan)' is awkward; use 'pacaran/rayuan jantan'.
Item 25 Incubation: 'para ilmuwan belum memiliki penjelasannya' is OK; but the heading 'Masa kehamilan' for 'Incubation' is acceptable. 'Betina tidak selalu mau kawin' is OK.
Item 20: 'Clown killifish', 'Garra panda' and 'Corydoras pygmy' are left or half-translated inconsistently; use 'Corydoras pygmy/kerdil' and a consistent common name for each.
Item 20: 'Lobster air tawar' for crayfish is acceptable, but 'Sebagian besar lobster air tawar' should say 'crayfish (lobster air tawar)' to avoid confusion.
Item 20: 'Perilaku teritorial baru dilaporkan pada satu poeciliid saja' — 'baru' adds a temporal nuance ('only so far'); use 'hanya dilaporkan pada satu poeciliid'.
Item 20: 'membutuhkan parameter air yang sama' — source says 'the same water parameters' (tank mates having); use 'memiliki kebutuhan parameter air yang sama'.
Item 15: 'Ikan ini lebih suka air sadah' repeated 'Ikan ini' — minor; also 'Ikan ini bisa hidup di air apa pun' is a loose rendering but meaning is intact.
Item 8: 'sungai kecil dan sungai' is clumsy; use 'anak sungai dan sungai'.

yasuhikotakia-modesta.name: Botia Modesta
notes: Item 10: 'all botias are somewhat sensitive to the spot disease ... but tolerate medication against it only poorly' is rendered 'namun kurang tahan terhadap obat'. This is acceptable, but 'Ichthyophtirius' and the inserted '(white spot, ...)' are fine, so no change is needed here.

Item 17: 'Ambastaia ... dua spesies yang dulu pernah menjadi anggota Botia maupun Yasuhikotakia' is fine, but 'Ada varian ... The former name' is mistranslated. The English 'The former name' refers to 'blue fin', but the English text itself is ambiguous. The translation adds 'Nama 'blue fin''. This is acceptable.
Item 17: 'ikan ... juga membayangi'. 'Shadowing' is left in English, with 'membayangi' used inconsistently. Add a Indonesian gloss or keep the term consistent.
Item 17: 'Pertunjukan seperti ini' for 'Such displays' is awkward. Use 'Perilaku unjuk diri seperti ini'.
Item 13: 'Beberapa loach dari famili Cobitidae dan Nemacheilidae' alters 'cobitid and nemacheilid loaches'. This is acceptable.
Item 13: 'That said they seemingly require regular contact' is rendered 'Bagaimanapun'. This is minor, but 'Selain itu' fits the flow better.
Item 3: The first sentence is duplicated in the source, and the translation keeps both. This is faithful.

Item 16: 'Anakan memiliki serangkaian garis vertikal gelap' changes 'They have' to 'Anakan'. This is an addition that is not in the source, since the English says 'They' and implies juveniles. It is plausible, but flag it.
Item 11: 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex is fine. 'moluska obligat' for 'obligate molluscivores' loses the meaning 'pemakan moluska obligat'. Use 'pemakan moluska obligat'.
Item 8: 'kerikil halus yang licin' for 'pebbles' repeats 'kerikil halus' (fine gravel) from the preceding clause. Use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali kecil' for pebbles.
